# Battery External Normal Malfunction

1. Housing is cracked

(a) Housing cracked is the most serious and destructive malfunction. When vehicle is subjected to strong vibration, lead acid battery overheating, too high pressure or electrolyte frozen expansion, the housing of lead acid battery will be damaged. For such malfunction, replacing battery is the sole way for treatment.

2. Electrode is loose

(a) The cause of loosen electrode is that excessive force is applied during removal and installation of wire harness and inspection of contact. It is necessary to replace the battery assembly.

3. Connecting part of electrode is corroded or burnt (a) The cause is that anti-corrosive solvent is not applied when installing battery. You can apply vaseline oil after cleaning up. If the electrode is seriously corroded or burnt, replace it with a new one.

4. Battery swells

(a) Check if the generated electricity is normal and if the charging voltage is too high. (b) The causes are that battery is aging and resistance is excessively high. It is necessary to replace the battery.

# Charging System Charging Voltage Inspection

1. Leave vehicle under no load test condition and idle the engine. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter. Standard voltage: 13.5 V - 14.8 V If result is not as specified, replace the alternator.

2. Leave vehicle under load test condition and idle the engine. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter.

Load test condition:

Set headlight to high beam;   
Turn on blower and adjust blower speed to the highest.   
Turn on the "A/C" switch.

Standard voltage: 13.5 V - 14.8 V

If result is not as specified, replace the alternator.

# Usage of Battery Tester

1. Check the battery with battery tester to gain the condition of battery. Replace or charge as necessary.

(a) Connect the tester to battery.

# Caution:

Connect red tube clamp to battery positive terminal while black tube clamp to battery negative terminal.

(b) Operate tester to select "Battery Test" and click "Enter".

![](images/134c2d77b2902c46a4ea8a7f4b5a518f2f7e2058cf4b0550b089afe2c9c96a61.webp)

(c) Select "CCA" and click "Enter".

(d) Operate "L and R buttons" on tester to adjust and set the battery capacity (such as 560CCA, this value indicates the battery low temperature starting performance) and click "Enter".

![](images/651713a1adf0d8b5d105983ca8eae5f445df85c204e65d431e4b091edfd5d8f2.webp)

(e) The battery condition is displayed on tester.

Hint:   
Recharge or replace battery according to the tested data.

# Battery Fluid Leakage Test

1. Test method

(a) PH paper is used for judgment. PH paper model definition: PH 1 - 14

![](images/b35928b84f7512d7e6a3af5b34e4b1d3a8e8b304e31c1f9b2a378997f60409cd.webp)

2. Judgment method

(a) Take a piece of PH paper (never allow it contacting with other fluid before test) to wipe the leaking area, so as to make the fluid adhere on the PH paper. Then compare it with the color bar to judge the PH value.   
(b) If the PH value is less than 7, it is an acidic liquid, which indicates battery leakage.   
(c) If the PH value is 7 or higher, it is non-acidic liquid (neutral or alkaline) which indicates "Petroleum jelly" fluid or other fluids leakage on battery surface.

# On-vehicle Inspection

1. Check that battery terminals are not loose or corroded. If battery terminals are corroded, clean them.

2. Check battery for damage, deformation or leakage. If damage, deformation or leakage is found, replaced the battery.

Check battery voltage.

(a) Turn ENGINE START STOP switch to ON, and turn it off 20 to 30 seconds after turning on headlight. Release the surface charge on battery. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter.

Rated Voltage 12 V - 13 V

# Battery Charging Method

Because the battery has the characteristic of self-discharging, even if the battery is not in use, it is necessary to perform regular charging maintenance. When the discharging ratio for battery capacity is lower than 50%, the capacity cannot restore to 100% if charging with small current while the battery temperature increases and the plate active material will fall off easily if charging with large current, affecting the performance and life of battery.

Charging with constant voltage: Voltage is limited at 14.40 V. During charging, make sure the charger is connected to the maximum charging current so as to get the preset voltage value (14.40 V) according to the current battery status and temperature. After the voltage reaches the limiting value, the charging current will drop gradually until it closes to 0 A (maintain the condition charging current).

# Battery Handling/ Warning Description and Safety Specification

1. Following the related specifications on appliances connected with battery, in repair manual and owner's manual.

2. There is risk of corrosiveness (burns). Battery acid is highly corrosive, so it is necessary to wear protective gloves and goggles when working. Do not dump the battery, because acid may spill from vent hole.

3. Keep away from open fire, spark, light devices without protective measures and no smoking. Never generate any sparks when operating cable/wire and electrical devices. Avoid short circuit in battery.

4. Wear eye protective mask/glasses.

5. Never allow the children approaching acid and battery.   
6. Recycle the battery.   
Deliver the used battery to designated recycling site.   
7. Never throw the used battery into household garbage.   
8. There is risk of explosion.

# Precautions

# System Overview

Fuel System Components Diagram

![](images/3c6935e393f7464ad9bfec1eb0dc16efccdbeb63f1f47b9ff9ea42a993236194.webp)

![](images/a9312b6687fb1319571b197508c1b5c24294eb564b2cc20efaba191dfd69e172.webp)

Charging system is consist of battery, alternator, adjuster and charging state indicator device. Alternator is the main power supply component while vehicle is operating. It is used to supply power to all the electric equipment (except for the starting system) and charge the battery. Since alternator is rotated through drive belt which is driven by the engine, voltage will changes depending on engine speed. To meet electric device power supply and battery charging requirements, charging system is equipped with voltage regulator. The voltage regulator maintains voltage output stability of alternator by adjusting exciting current in alternator while engine speed and load is changing. Charging state indicator is used to show the charging system operation and indicate whether the battery is in a charging or discharging state.

System Schematic Diagram Charging System Schematic Diagram

![](images/01d40cb6029702911065f22d57211e3741b20d55cfa297408fc6b2020a4d4486.webp)

Three-phase alternating current generated by alternator is converted to direct current from alternating current by rectifier, and direct current is transmitted to the vehicle electrical system and battery.

# Component Operation Description

Provide starting current large enough to starter when starter is to be started; When alternator is overloaded, it can help alternator to supply power to electric device; When starter is not started, temporarily supply power to electric device; Moreover, battery is a large capacity capacitor which protects vehicle electrical device.

# Alternator Assembly

Alternator is a silicon rectifying alternator, which mainly consists of rotor, stator and rectifier.

# Battery Operation/ Warning Description and Safety Specification

1. Following the related specifications on appliances connected with battery, in repair manual and owner's manual.   
2. Battery acid is highly corrosive, so it is necessary to wear protective gloves and goggles when working.   
3. Keep away from open fire, spark, light devices without protective measures and no smoking. Never generate any sparks when operating cable/wire and electrical devices. Avoid short circuit in battery.   
4. Wear eye protective mask/glasses.   
5. Never allow the children approaching acid and battery.   
6. Deliver the used battery to designated recycling site. Never throw the used battery into household garbage.

# Inspection and Adjustment

Battery Specification 12V 60AH

Check the charging system charging voltage

Leave vehicle under no load test condition and idle the engine. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter. Standard Voltage: 13.5V - 14.8V.   
Hint:   
If result . not as specified, replace the alternator.

Standard voltage: 13.2V - 14.8 V

# Usage of Battery Tester

1. Connect the battery tester to battery.

# Hint:

2. Operate tester to select "Battery Test" and click "Enter".

![](images/544156b57a0d4ede92d1dcac1e573f8dbc86e18028024988806ced5615867790.webp)

3. Select "CCA" and click "Enter".

4. Operate "L and R buttons" on tester to adjust and set the battery rated CCA (such as 560CCA, this value indicates the battery low temperature starting performance) and click "Enter".

![](images/765490f400875964c52ca8886db5251aa2d132731aa362daba291df85aa9406b.webp)

5. The battery condition is displayed on tester. Hint: Recharge or replace battery according to the tested data.

# Battery Fluid Leakage Test

1. PH paper is used for judgment. Hint: Paper Model: PH 1 - 14.   
2. Take a piece of PH paper (never allow it contacting with other fluid before test) to wipe the leaking area, so as to make the fluid adhere on the PH paper. Then compare it with the color bar to judge the PH value.   
3. If the PH value is less than 7, it is an acidic liquid, which indicates battery leakage. If the PH value is 7 or higher, it is non-acidic liquid (neutral or alkaline) which indicates "Petroleum jelly" fluid or other fluids leakage on battery surface.

![](images/6618bde70e1a8953b1d49df9d18ec809db3d575e7dda285d10a36050ccf2706a.webp)

# Alternator Assembly

When removing alternator assembly, be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents.

Appropriate force should be applied, when removing alternator assembly. Be careful not to operate roughly.

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Remove the engine hood trim cover assembly.

4. Remove the engine trim cover assembly.

5. Disconnect the alternator assembly connector (1) and remove alternator positive cable harness fixing nut (2).

6. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow) from alternator assembly. Torque: 40 + 5 N·m

![](images/1b875b80c9b2c167c27a0c5fbcb4e3f9d2189b216ca2e3d711541c0629d9db4c.webp)

7. Remove the engine accessory belt.

8. Remove the alternator assembly.

# Installation Caution:

Be sure to tighten coupling bolts and nuts to specified torques. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

# Operation

This transmission has six forward gears and one reverse gear, which is achieved by three sets of synchronizers and two shafts (input shaft and output shaft). All forward gears use conventional engagement, and reverse gear uses a sliding idler gear device. Corresponding gear will engage with gear hub separately when transmission is shifted to each different gear position, thus realizing the power transmission. Drive gear of final drive, which is on the output shaft, drives the driven gear of final drive and the differential assembly to rotate, thus propeller shaft is driven to rotate wheels. All forward gears use an inertial synchronizer gearshift mechanism, thus providing smooth and easy gear shifting and longevity. Shift fork adopts alloy steel material and resinous material to achieve high wear resistance. Gearshift mechanism of transmission makes gearshift flexible, accurate and clear by equipped locating steel ball and spring. In addition, pre-synchronizing mechanism is used for reverse gear, enhancing the ride comfort and reliability.

# Proper Use and Maintenance for Transmission Correct Operation for Transmission

1. Gently shift the shift lever and never apply excessive force.   
2. Never start off at high speed.   
3. Do not always put hand on shift lever during driving, to prevent premature wear of shift fork.

# Assembly Standards and Precautions for Transmission

1. Wash all parts (except for rubber part, gasket, oil seal and bearing) before assembly.

2. Various oil seals, shaft retainers and elastic pins cannot be reused.   
3. Apply lubricant to each friction surface and apply grease to each oil seal lip.   
4. Never transmit pressure through rolling body when assembling each bearing.   
5. Never tilt the lip oil seal during assembly.   
6. Openings of spring expander on both sides should be staggered when assembling synchronizer set.   
7. There should be no lubricant leakage at each area when transmission is in normal operating position.

# Transmission Oil Level Inspection

1. Raise vehicle with a lift

# Warning:

Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents.   
Check if safety lock of lift is locked when repairing or inspecting the lifted vehicle.

2. Remove transmission filler bolt (arrow) and bolt washer.

![](images/9f6af87c66453c894658c22965b308bf239ce80dbbf9f0cecb49075dd8d673b2.webp)

# Caution:

• Drain bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal. 3. Check that oil level is 0 to 5 mm from lower lip of limit bolt opening.

![](images/e857a11052907f7ccdfd7319b92810a7c550a87dd5e0ae92375fee1934d44f3c.webp)

# Caution:

If oil level is too low, inspect oil for leakage. 4. Install new bolt washer and filler bolt (arrow).

![](images/41e62664935027e513f07abef6bcef9bc3dc118751e214d42007cfdc5e32063f.webp)

# Transmission Oil Replacement

Transmission Oil Draining Warning/Caution/Hint

Replace transmission oil only when engine stops and transmission cools down. Replace drain/limit bolt washers with new ones before installation.   
1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch.   
2. Raise vehicle to a proper height.   
3. Place a recovering container under transmission drain hole.   
4. Use a tool to remove transmission limit bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer.

![](images/492789356d12e2952cdb92a08eb8d70e35fbf17575579ea35c458edece5b3eb5.webp)

# Caution:

Limit bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

5. Use a tool to remove transmission drain bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer. Replace drain bolt washer and tighten drain bolt after draining transmission oil.

![](images/0b9868d071d665eef9d94b181c95c1687d3cffda2ff24352c67f4227e19906aa.webp)

Tightening torque 39 ± 11 N•m

# Caution:

Drained transmission oil should be collected with a recovering container.   
Only use transmission oil approved by Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.   
Drain bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

# Transmission Oil Filling

1. Make sure that drain bolt is tightened in place.   
2. Use a socket wrench to remove transmission filler bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer.

![](images/24a171cc78a9fed0b81e11d8a9f9cb3b97bfabfcda1d68789610c7a24177dfa1.webp)

Caution: • Filler bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal. Add lubricant through filler bolt port until oil level is 0 to 5 mm from lower lip of limit bolt opening.

![](images/f756f61eb50ba39a583615c1c093aab53fb0290def2a100d4fb08d1de18494d1.webp)

![](images/1e8a4b6c192280c417a9c59a818e3c12e94b91d2898599bb62d397f9fda586b4.webp)

#

Caution: An excessively large or small amount of oil may affect proper functioning of transmission. After filling oil, run vehicle and then check oil level.

4 After filling oil, replace filler bolt washer and tighten filler bolt. Tightening torque 39 ± 11 N•m

# Select and Shift Cable, Shift Control Mechanism

Shift the select and shift mechanism of transmission to 1st gear and secure it with dowel pin. Stand at engine compartment, clamp gear select cable on left side (joint is smaller) and clamp gear shift cable on right side (joint is larger), never cross them. • Openings of 2 lock pins should face the same direction and need to be locked in place. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch. 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 34. Remove the battery. Remove the air filter assembly. 5. Remove the battery tray. 6. Rotate shift lever knob counterclockwise along shift lever to remove it. 7. Remove the boot assembly. 8. Remove the auxiliary fascia console assembly (See page 58-7). 9. Shift shift lever to 1st gear and install dowel pin.

(a) Install the shift control mechanism dowel pin (arrow).

(b) Install the transmission 1st gear dowel pin (arrow).

![](images/f529b2007ba8240e967ed6388b9591b637df34e9f76ac2a1ff599637620acedd.webp)

10. Remove select and shift cable from gear shift control mechanism.

(a) Disconnect connection (1) between shift cable joint and shift lever ball-and-socket, remove cotter pin (arrow) between select cable of shift mechanism and select swing arm of control mechanism, then disconnect connection.

![](images/b03c1dea32ac871e0dbc93d3dd55c5b8a866c378a0dbd29a0072ebd8351dbcd3.webp)

(b) Remove dampers (arrow) between select and shift cable and shift control mechanism.

![](images/ad40ef721156f09b25951b1cc20b7c8020aec6f38a9afc625cf133b2555a69a0.webp)

11. Disconnect connection between select and shift cable and transmission.

(a) Remove fixing lock pin and disconnect connection (arrow) between shift cable and transmission shift swing arm; remove fixing lock pin and disconnect connection (arrow) between select cable and transmission select swing arm, then disengage select and shift cable dampers (1) from flexible shaft bracket limit hole.

# Warning:

Make white marks on both joints face downward (toward transmission) during installation.

![](images/5efa635b888fa6abba4406ba90b2868d77a499b84c147050993f8e32be0212d4.webp)

12. Remove 3 fixing bolt and plate washer sets (arrow) between transmission and flexible shaft bracket.

![](images/157ec599d4d5779032a6aee89a41c9b9124ebee6dd714c65e888e85b82083527.webp)

13. Raise vehicle to a proper position, remove 3 fixing bolts (arrow) between select and shift cable and body dash panel.

![](images/aa7a56b09d4c846c68b962ea81e8bc0f36ee16602dad95ecc4d19c810c5f1803.webp)

14. Remove select and shift cable from body.   
15. Remove 4 fixing bolts (arrow) between shift control mechanism and body, then remove shift control mechanism.

![](images/4bde63b037e392aa8d89a65a2a012041505e2fc5f14517709661d1410252f0c7.webp)

Tightening torque 20 ± 3 N•m

# Warning/Caution/Hint

Make sure that transmission is at 1st gear when installing select and shift cable. Be sure to push out select joint adjusting block and keep it unlocked before and after assembling cable. DO NOT install select and shift cable in a wrong position during installation. Red cable (shift cable) and green cable (select cable) must pass through the bottom of cushion "cross recess". Red cable (shift cable) crosses with green cable (select cable), and red cable (shift cable) is at lower position. 1. Secure shift control mechanism on body, and install and tighten 4 fixing bolts (1, 2, 3 and 4).

![](images/d2601b2cf366a871ba6dac31078ffc141c0c5daebe34a77fec03d9487580e05a.webp)

Tightening torque 20 ± 3 N•m Installation sequence (1)-(2)-(3)-(4)

2. After raising vehicle to a proper height, pass select and shift cable through slot on body dash panel under auxiliary fascia console, and insert it into a proper position in vehicle from outside.

3 Install select and shift assembly plug, install and tighten 3 fixing bolts (arrow), and secure select and shift cable to body dash panel.

![](images/26707ad093b5b01536a7b69007796dff46cd5b316cb8593f4c88e4d059ab7889.webp)

Specified torque 9 ± 1 N•m

Install select and shift cable flexible shaft bracket and 3 fixing bolts (arrow).

![](images/c1a08507b7e7348626f9d519c64176962fc477ed6b602b90e8e3c605ebefe14e.webp)

5. Install select and shift cable to transmission assembly.

(a) Install select and shift cable damper to limit holes (1) of flexible shaft bracket, then install select and shift cable joint to transmission swing arm and tighten it with lock pins (arrow).

# Caution:

Be sure to clamp damper locating device into flexible shaft bracket locating hole when installing select and shift cable damper to flexible shaft bracket. Make white marks on both joints face downward (toward transmission) during installation.

![](images/aa01a3945ff220dfdbb531c21036dfc2f714b12fbc0eeaccf54a6e1101d95eb5.webp)

6. Install select and shift cable to shift control mechanism.

(a) Respectively clamp select and shift cable dampers into corresponding slots (arrow) on shift control mechanism.

(b) Push out select cable adjusting block and keep it unlocked.

(c) Pull out select lock pin, drag select cable joint until select cable pin hole aligns with select arm pin shaft, assemble cable joint and mechanism pin shaft, then insert lock pin (arrow) into small hole of select arm.

![](images/76a160782d4c8b5f13b54fadc0876851d44b3f68af58133d7637c379a4c9221e.webp)

1st gear dowel pin is a metal pin with diameter of φ5.95° 0.07 mm. Service stations can make it by themselves, but also can use the metal pin with same specification.

8. Remove shift control mechanism 1st gear dowel pin (arrow), and shift the shift lever to neutral.
