# Shift Knob and Boot Assembly

1. Remove the shift knob.

(a) Rotate shift lever ball counterclockwise until shift knob is removed.

2. Remove the shift knob boot assembly.

(a) Using an interior crow plate, separate shift knob boot assembly and auxiliary fascia console. (b) Move shift knob boot upward until it separates from shift mechanism R gear slider, then remove shift knob boot assembly.

# Installation

Install boot assembly onto conical surface of lifting lever of shift mechanism, then clamp boot onto auxiliary fascia console vertically.

2. Rotate shift lever ball clockwise along shift lever, make word on ball face straight ahead when a larg rotating force is felt obviously, then stop rotating.

# Caution:

Boot assembly and auxiliary fascia console are engaged in place.   
Make word on shift lever ball face straight ahead.   
After assembling shift lever ball, be sure to raise the lifting lever to the maximum stroke and release it, observe if lifting lever is stuck by internal circle of ball, then repeat the operations 5 times, if lifting lever moves smoothly in this process, it is qualified.

# Transmission Assembly

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.   
1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.   
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
3. Remove the battery.   
4. Remove the air filter assembly.   
5. Remove the battery tray.   
6. Remove the engine lower protector.   
7. Remove front left and right tires.   
8. Drain transmission fluid.   
9. Remove ground wire above transmission case.   
10. Disconnect connection between select and shift cable and transmission.

# Warning:

Make white marks on both joints face downward (toward transmission) during installation. (b) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) between select and shift cable fixing bracket and transmission case.

![](images/ac1ebbebfc037ef271f43734db3099aaa958f180fa91263ef6537b2d7d176ff3.webp)

![](images/a44fc5ee051167b9ce8083dbcf3da53ed1a8ed4a34215e4e82d83a5e87ff0cf5.webp)

11. Disconnect the reverse switch connector (arrow).

![](images/18355e78dc88afb24278e7c81bbdc5d9c241dfa3cd89b2da3db7302c78e27dd7.webp)

12. Remove the turbocharger intake pipe.   
13. Remove the vacuum pump.

# 26-30

14. Remove the starter.

15. Remove the crankshaft position sensor.

(a) Disconnect the crankshaft position sensor connector. (b) Remove fixing bolt (arrow) and crankshaft position sensor.

![](images/a3172f614a55f96b929e7ccbc0b2a642fb770c8c1d72c87df17c0005f6871d0f.webp)

16. Using a tool, pry off clip (arrow) from clutch release bearing joint to separate clutch pipe and transmission.

![](images/b9ea0b9098d1153ba8130bb1d140bda5c4f1c1746ef39a38c0253ed606a8e2a4.webp)

17. Remove the drive shaft.   
18. Remove the left side rail welding assembly.   
19. Remove the rear mounting.   
20. Use an engine equalizer to hang the engine.   
21. Remove the left mounting.   
22. Remove the transmission.

(a) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) from upper part of transmission. Tightening torque 50 ± 5 N•m

![](images/9d5cb1d56d698a0187be01b9174b42c797f6ab3787b821fbef1c255c32ec82c0.webp)

(b) Raise vehicle and use a transmission carrier to support transmission assembly.

(c) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) from lower part of transmission, and remove sealing plate. Tightening torque 60 ± 5 N•m

(d) Remove coupling bolts (arrow) between engine and transmission from both sides.

![](images/27cb5d47ec29f24cbe82bb2c49ec4f14dab448b0db9bea872740d0f8b3707e2f.webp)

Tightening torque 60 ± 5 N•m

(e) Pull transmission to separate it from engine.

# Disassembly

1. Remove the filler bolt.

(a) Remove filler bolt (arrow) and bolt washer (1) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Filler bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/44804fbc901a65241cf0e1afab2208228ad3d92a444efa74ff18f6f0372a3ed3.webp)

(b) Remove limit bolt (arrow) and bolt washer (1) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Limit bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/e6bf790738f22c28fc03b52b9678c57dec00539956fcfee1d9e5de1deb4e7a19.webp)

2. Remove the drain bolt.

(a) Remove drain bolt (arrow) and bolt washer (1) from clutch case.

# Caution:

Drain bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/531cb4732e3b1b1fd3d9326f6202a106d8ca4dc1024caf4d046ea7b1ab9e3c79.webp)

3. Remove the reverse switch.

(a) Using a tool, remove reverse switch (arrow) and bolt washer (1) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Reverse switch bolt washer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/5470c364a420060641568d87fb626b7647e2402c3742351030c211b2b9d9e2a4.webp)

4 Remove the locating mechanism set.

(a) Remove locating mechanism set (arrow) from transmission case.

![](images/c54f0d1a397fb532ffca976557f62185f81af003e93489dbaf4295f3ffc33c56.webp)

5. Remove the reverse idler gear shaft bolt.

(a) Remove reverse idler gear shaft bolt (arrow) and bolt washer (1) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Reverse idler gear shaft bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/e6210970218df539cdb013ea1466a1c0d5c3a32df95d99d3a4f7a5a89c92bbb6.webp)

6. Remove the steel ball dowel pin.

(a) Remove inner hexagon head bolt (arrow) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Inner hexagon head bolt is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/adeb03aa493069f83bc28ecd4b059cec02ce100ad1e4a30ef019f2761712a550.webp)

(b) Remove spring and steel ball dowel pin from transmission case.

7. Remove the self-locking set.

(a) Remove self-locking bolt (arrow) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Self-locking bolt is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/bde8d56bda667ad8ba67f22ad17b7c89f1de5f77fabe60d1ac02e8c0f712c787.webp)

(b) Remove self-locking spring and self-locking steel ball from transmission case.

![](images/f10d44508f620377ce348b7eba4ca70e46a6c1b59b06e4425737dd1a040361d7.webp)

8. Remove the outer shift lever E type retainer.

(a) Remove E type retainer (arrow) from outer shift lever.

# Caution:

E type retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/becefaf484f4e710ffb93b1ba42ed5086537444bba1d09571e4e9b4b293332c1.webp)

9. Remove the transmission case.

(a) Remove 16 coupling bolts (arrow) from transmission case.

(b) Using a screwdriver wrapped with protective tape (a), separate transmission case.

DO NOT damage transmission case and clutch case.

# Warning:

![](images/150e076ed8e75376ab74e6a57cd7d5b7f68a7ce92675e33ff2b7de59b6aa2c01.webp)

(c) Rotate outer shift lever clockwise until it contacts with boss (a).

(d) Push outer shift lever and remove transmission case.

![](images/e2d8e5987e51d5b6b4e98d992d72a2de5329ffc771b6242ef9b3738e8c249c67.webp)

SM0136002

10. Remove the reverse idler gear set.

(a) Remove reverse idler gear set, idler gear thrust washer and reverse idler gear shaft from clutch case.

![](images/cb368a114f94a35ee0211a90e62be789b4ab9b0f419f3c17820ae69daee1293a.webp)

11. Remove the reverse gear fork set.

(a) Rotate reverse gear fork set clockwise and remove it from clutch case.

![](images/980d950728ca043722430d2db650652248e4a5b1210e5fbc43cc93a2eb266c7c.webp)

12. Remove the reverse gear arm bracket set.

(a) Remove 2 bolts (arrow) and reverse gear arm bracket set from clutch case.

![](images/adb0ce6313b35dde352984284d1888ee27d8c0637f8ba999a5c687aed276d6ee.webp)

13. Remove the select and shift shaft assembly.

(a) Using a hexagon wrench, remove inner select lever fixing bolt (arrow).

![](images/01f7946e7bc24d7f100ce15cd33331e86376f5d693036ffe580cd179f55251af.webp)

(b) Rotate select and shift shaft sub-assembly clockwise and remove it from clutch case.

(c) Remove lock plate from clutch case.

![](images/99ad702037fbcbfbeed3ab665653d09641c63ac43f20253e84f2d5384978af49.webp)

14. Remove the outer select lever.

(a) Remove outer select lever and inner select lever from clutch case.

![](images/8f8f732d81cf7a2111aad973b322cc8dff72631943447ca00e7fa54a200da7ab.webp)

15. Remove the outer select lever oil seal.

(a) Using a screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, remove outer select lever oil seal (arrow) from clutch case.

# Warning:

DO NOT damage the installation surface. Outer select lever oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/e34f5339730eb25f1b1e7cb94a9d13fab924048e5d61ac7681e0ca82b4819fc0.webp)

16. Remove the shaft set.

(a) Remove input shaft sub-assembly, output shaft subassembly, No.1 fork shaft sub-assembly, No.2 fork shaft sub-assembly and No.3 fork shaft subassembly from clutch case.

![](images/a97ff2412d2bee38b3390af54fcb0e12018f87cb8ff4f38f8ab3c8a171bc354a.webp)

17. Remove the differential sub-assembly.

(a) Remove differential sub-assembly (arrow) from clutch case.

![](images/90189c62c7fb1fceec9023af825f6d37758777d042e7032852536be64830314a.webp)

18. Remove the differential right bearing outer race.

(a) Using a special tool, remove differential right bearing outer race and oil seal deflector from clutch case.

![](images/834a6819ef5c7f3f4318c4fb9379fb1d8ada689d2b8500c25405b540998a2c2e.webp)

(b) Install special tools, hold (a) and rotate (b) to remove right bearing inner race from differential sub-assembly.

![](images/08b99be9855fdc4398db503ec850b8cc64f7e0354250c4d644296d0c8b1e700c.webp)

19. Remove the differential left bearing outer race.

(a) Using a special tool, remove differential left bearing outer race and adjusting shim from clutch case.

(b) Using special tools, hold (a) and rotate (b) to remove left bearing inner race from differentia subassembly.

![](images/d6ad524ea88254c77e235fb2bda1ce170cb522863a0f70d662d633ef89c775f3.webp)

20. Remove the transmission magnet.

(a) Remove magnet (arrow) from clutch case.

![](images/ef4e6674ab5b0a0f269078181d69a978249b81d69dff53e4f56e7503242a5bf7.webp)

21. Remove oil separator from clutch case.

(a) Remove 4 bolts (arrow) and oil separator from clutch case.

# Caution:

4 oil separator fixing bolts are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/76abeb71483dc5be4eea8d504d98b97e589357918f9048561836bd555cbcc856.webp)

22. Remove the breather plug.

(a) Remove breather plug (arrow) from clutch case.

# Caution:

Breather plug is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/ffc5f6c33060640994b3a76728f618b5757ec578bd41770f40fee5fd0acc471b.webp)

23. Remove the output shaft front bearing outer race.

(a) Using a special tool, remove output shaft front bearing outer race from clutch case.

![](images/eba54189b723cbd96b8701c328e66b90380eb1fe135e6d532feb25916fe8d4ba.webp)

(b) Remove output shaft oil guide nozzle (arrow) from clutch case.

![](images/3b053f5104c1460f2e99d39ab64b6a5225c108b969e904da4493e1c16de8d146.webp)

24. Remove the input shaft oil seal.

(a) Using special tool and hammer, remove input shaft oil seal from clutch case.

# Caution:

Input shaft oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/7a4612c6ef64845577c6a65c9f50eadec9d7734fbb57d96217112fdf9aeed732.webp)

25. Remove the dowel pin.

(a) Remove 5 dowel pins (arrow) from clutch case.

![](images/3a3f4558e0e3b26d44c7d9075f5cbba15502f11e2096561c3f2d8b099f2df7c9.webp)

26. Remove the input shaft adjusting shim.

(a) Remove input shaft adjusting shim (arrow) from transmission case.

# Caution:

Adjusting shim is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/93fd0c515d43b3939075ea7af7d1a63b6fb3737fddbcdf9cd6c41e1e49f5c1f4.webp)

(a) Remove input shaft oil guide nozzle (arrow) from transmission case.

![](images/ab1a3d0749041187188926963577a93d9a10c08fbefaa01046f59075a80d2b2f.webp)

28. Remove the oil guide.

(a) Remove oil guide (arrow) from transmission case.

![](images/c7397367574d995bb914dcccfe282efbbd9c1e59454a338b6e64828da1e7440f.webp)

29. Remove the oil separator.

(a) Remove 2 bolts (arrow) and oil separator from transmission case.

![](images/d6e7870ee91b44499723a55d34a0ece663edbfe7abe42d40695096047598049a.webp)

30. Remove the oil separator set.

(a) Remove 4 bolts (arrow) and oil separator set from transmission case.

# Caution:

4 oil separator fixing bolts are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/88ae36a1c5887843fbef59f94da96193adde1bd1c2a314a1f7bbfc2efb39eaad.webp)

31. Remove the outer shift lever.

(a) Using 5 mm pin punch and hammer, remove elastic cylindrical pin from shift guide block.

# Warning:

Elastic cylindrical pin should be aligned with installation hole of locating mechanism set when removing elastic cylindrical pin. Elastic cylindrical pin is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/e1d2c9058a4596eec2bdd366f49045226dcf87c747e39bb014a341997c383b27.webp)

(b) Remove shift guide block, spacer and outer shift lever from transmission case.

32. Remove the outer shift lever oil seal.

(a) Using a screwdriver (a) wrapped with protective tape, remove outer shift lever oil seal (arrow) from transmission case.

# Warning:

DO NOT damage the installation surface. Outer shift lever oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/7fab1d34bc4b0941bbc3443dca113830a9198ca54d0f62114d25c0fdbbc85fc1.webp)

33. Remove the output shaft rear bearing outer race.

(a) Using a special tool, remove output shaft rear bearing outer race and adjusting shim from transmission case.

![](images/0797bb03d9ac437db2f1cda1e204dd00a8cbce5a64be17bccd8a7827c2f150a6.webp)

34. Remove the differentia oil seal (left).

(a) Using special tool and hammer, remove differential oil seal from transmission case.

# Caution:

Differential oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/92d2abdc38adcc1572462a26dd14d9cb6b39b97afa2ee5231d6a622979b57bc1.webp)

35. Remove the differentia oil seal (right).

(a) Using special tool and hammer, remove differential oil seal from transmission case.

# Caution:

Differential oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/5c3db504365d633a98e64425e5f54d73faba09b0b53781faa49d2ce0807803b4.webp)

# Reverse Idler Gear Set Inspection

Using a feeler gauge, check reverse idler gear set. Standard inner diameter 25.056 \~ 25.074 mm Maximum inner diameter 25.074 mm If inner diameter is more than maximum value, replace reverse idler gear set. 2. Using a micrometer, check reverse idler gear shaft.

![](images/bfccb5fa018a1e7d88a48524b5626cc4dbcfb8efb993d3bea6d773b91f3bf953.webp)

Minimum outer diameter 24.984 mm   
If outer diameter is less than minimum value, replace reverse idler gear shaft.

# Warning/Caution/Hint:

Before assembling components, wash them clean.   
Remove seal gum residues from cases.   
Make sure that joint surface of cases is clean and free of oil, then uniformly apply seal gum.   
Make sure joint surface of case and shift assembly is clean and free of oil, then uniformly apply seal gum.   
Tighten bolts to specified torque.

1. Install the differential right bearing inner race.

(a) Using special tool and press, install new differential right bearing inner race to differential sub-assembly.

![](images/52f86a244f39887d9f6385fbe54194d51e335caf79bc5d4e2ff863d89837ccc8.webp)

(b) Using special tool and press, install oil seal deflector together with differential right bearing outer race to clutch case.

![](images/2b48b1afa19d7a95c0807572756012c2dd45d8e75fc51c49046318a2a0081b1f.webp)

2. Install the differential left bearing inner race.

(a) Using special tool and press, install new differential left bearing inner race to differential sub-assembly.

![](images/d80ff593e7e1c65d850d3239e629d53f50f3d3d7260a4de0abd646cea610f319.webp)

(b) Using special tool and press, install adjusting shim together with differential left bearing outer race to clutch case.

![](images/8f1908f1c718b3d3970fdae353cd3093cf12632cce08fe7870294fbc12ff455b.webp)

3. Adjust the differential bearing preload.

(a) Apply gear oil to differential sub-assembly (arrow) and install it to clutch case.

(b) Install transmission case with 16 bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 29.4 ± 5.9 N•m

![](images/4745b7300c6bad19d4e819a97ea625d894c94a296c9204118678e445b186796c.webp)

(c) Using special tool and torque wrench, rotate differential sub-assembly clockwise and counterclockwise 2 or 3 times to seat the bearing.

(d) Using special tool and torque wrench, measure preload. Preload for new bearing 0.98 \~ 1.69 N•m Preload for used bearing 0.795 \~ 1.372 N•m

If preload is not as specified, replace adjusting shim with one of different thickness which can make preload within specified range.

![](images/45d11e55fc69c5989ca29819c4537b634b69cc0b4d22e8d96182f640b6dd51e8.webp)

# Warning:

Select thicker adjusting shim to increase preload, or select thinner adjusting shim to decrease preload. Make a record, as torque value is needed when adjusting output shaft bearing preload.

(e) Remove 16 coupling bolts from transmission and separate transmission case.

(f) Remove differential sub-assembly from clutch case.

4. Install the output shaft front bearing outer race.

(a) Install output shaft oil guide nozzle (arrow) to clutch case.

# Caution:

Align output shaft oil guide nozzle boss (a) with groove on clutch case.

(b) Using special tool and press, install new output shaft front bearing outer race to clutch case.

![](images/e0489a14ae9fd6d72f758799703553f5c99bcf95260d359c671c23f884f84798.webp)

5. Install the output shaft rear bearing outer race.

(a) Using special tool and press, install adjusting shim and new output shaft rear bearing outer race to transmission case.

![](images/932ee030dc75be599400957572e18768584866ba141dc6cc27d4ddf60f135ac5.webp)

6. Adjust the output shaft bearing preload.

(a) Apply gear oil to differentia case (arrow) and install it to clutch case.

(b) Apply gear oil to output shaft sub-assembly (arrow) and install it to clutch case.

![](images/36bb6ae4d49071510f90c0d0f17f0978c8f1c4a1e50c9cd57d5c52ac7cfa4962.webp)

(c) Install transmission case with 16 bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 29.4 ± 5.9 N•m

![](images/5cd69164bea12f6fab83bd66deac48d0045aa73fe4b8af5310a64282bad9f152.webp)

(d) Using special tool and torque wrench, rotate differential sub-assembly clockwise and counterclockwise 2 or 3 times to seat the bearing.

(e) Using special tool and torque wrench, measure preload. Preload for new bearing 0.98 \~ 1.69 N•m Preload for used bearing 0.795 \~ 1.372 N•m If preload is not as specified, replace adjusting shim with one of different thickness which can make preload within specified range.

![](images/5679cf0589622f9a33bb7c972766c8f78fa2719bff5e79825a45f018df67b28a.webp)

![](images/c86b169dc84f47c41dfa9f82b28fcb88ce20498db27245d3e07873d9e360dc47.webp)

# Caution:

Select thicker adjusting shim to increase preload, or select thinner adjusting shim to decrease preload.

7. Install the outer shift lever oil seal.

(a) Using special tool and hammer, install new outer shift lever oil seal to transmission case. Standard depth 0.5\~1.0 mm   
(b) Apply MP grease to outer shift lever oil seal lip.

![](images/8bbd38d9906bd4503ce7973e898a526f65b6d08524fb705b86f883d0b1d2e91f.webp)

8. Install the outer shift lever.

(a) Install shift guide block, spacer and outer shift lever to transmission case, and secure them with elastic cylindrical pin.

Standard depth – 0.5 \~ 0.5 mm

# Caution:

Install shift guide block with its mark face outside of transmission case.

![](images/12516f6b2b8b50c28236796af9dfd04fb29c9a20ed3101899eb89176aa53d5ef.webp)

(b) Using 5 mm pin punch and hammer, secure shift guide block and outer shift lever with elastic cylindrical pin.

9. Install the oil separator set.

(a) Install oil separator set to transmission case, then install 4 fixing bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 17 ± 6.8 N•m

# Warning:

Make sure that sealing plug on end of oil separator set is inserted into groove on transmission case. 4 oil separator fixing bolts are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/da4e245ae80827c29b94094921d70debd55436a1f11f49c47c55dea3cc53904e.webp)

10. Install the oil separator.

(a) Install oil separator set to transmission case, then install 2 fixing bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 17 ± 6.8 N•m

# Warning:

Make sure that end of oil separator is inserted into groove on transmission case. 2 oil separator fixing bolts are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/a680a2d5f1bce6f623b2b84ec410c561c9f2cae25f1021361237134edcda2553.webp)

11. Install the oil guide.

(a) Install oil guide (arrow) to transmission case.

![](images/f040b8c6d91df5da85493560770471149b3a7904cf3a0d42d7736b910b29eaab.webp)

12. Install the dowel pin.

(a) Using a rubber hammer, install 5 new dowel pins (arrow) to clutch case until it reaches specified protrusion height.

Protrusion height 8.5 \~ 9.5 mm

Warning:

Cylindrical pin is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/3a4acf769b9740ce5335f8229627f765994431804b19042762d984f865489a14.webp)

13. Install the breather plug.

(a) Using special tool and hammer, install breather plug to clutch case.

# Warning:

Breather plug is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/6a3892bed36c97c3a646a65ec506de1402f19fc3c2e0682e7270358f24399c0b.webp)

14. Install the oil separator.

(a) Install oil separator to clutch case and secure it with 4 fixing bolts.

Tightening torque 17 ± 6.8 N•m

# Warning:

4 oil separator fixing bolts are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/df8643882b8314b944c84cf509f2dac26846d4c5d532dd51014511984d39512f.webp)

15. Install the input shaft oil seal.

(a) Apply MP grease to input shaft oil seal lip. (b) Using special tool and hammer, install new input shaft oil seal to clutch case.

Standard depth 1.0 \~ 2.0 mm

# Warning:

Input shaft oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/a611ad1af225f0a57fbc1a713a0f0b4619c60cd126d5ed09224768700f6c7d9a.webp)

16. Install the magnet.

(a) Clean magnet (arrow) and install it to clutch case.

![](images/f1a26c1f1af876607fb350f922a0c37d2d7fb3b623d9deadf258b48951f06957.webp)

17. Install the input shaft oil guide nozzle.

(a) Install input shaft oil guide nozzle (arrow) to transmission case.

# Caution:

Insert boss of input shaft oil guide nozzle into groove on transmission case.

![](images/123d1a7a97edfa6f23e229e01403d41f2b9cab8ec33ab638ee99a44cf692a0dc.webp)

18. Install the adjusting shim.

(a) Install adjusting shim (arrow) to transmission case.

# Caution:

Apply MP grease to adjusting shim to prevent it dropping from transmission case during   
reassembly.   
Adjusting shim is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.   
Select adjusting shim with proper thickness to install.

![](images/4003c90fc287132fda69c27324204d695cef5aa33d3871edd0919b1c2193d998.webp)

(b) Measure distance (dimension a) between transmission case joint surface and adjusting shim installation surface.

![](images/1f5e318b5d1d7be0b47be5d52fc5f57db7eb35531766cea3e1e10e04b7c26da3.webp)

(c) Measure distance (dimension b) between clutch case joint surface and input shaft right bearing installation surface.

![](images/83b4514f6bc652f0464460ee3aba79c1cd77860f75a55bd0af93ddec497ab6f2.webp)

(d) Measure distance (dimension c) between two input shaft bearings.

# Caution:

Measure dimension c when there is no axial clearance for each bearing.

![](images/1e8628483f0107b8afed4cc1f7c1f2cdc9732a53ad2f20975e5d04baca7576e9.webp)

(e) Calculate thickness value of adjusting shim with following formula, select adjusting shim which can make preload within specified range.

# Formula

(Dimension a + dimension b) Dimension c - Adjusting shim thickness = 0.02 \~ 0.14 mm Adjusting Shim Selection

![](images/e633a5afc915d5f387abb446e7a9ca95de60a121710144331abf46b5c1cce5ae.webp)

If preload is not as specified, replace adjusting shim with one of different thickness.

(f) Apply MP grease to adjusting shim and install it to transmission case.

# Caution:

DO NOT apply MP grease to oil groove.   
Clean adjusting shim before assembly.

19. Install the outer select lever oil seal.

(a) Apply MP grease to outer select lever oil seal lip. (b) Using special tool and hammer, install new outer select lever oil seal to clutch case.

Standard depth 0.5 \~ 1.0 mm

# Warning:

Outer select lever oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/b89577e91b6540255d63e9cd0513f94406af15d7e767f3bbee43a9c6921e751d.webp)

20. Install the differential sub-assembly.

(a) Apply gear oil to differentia case and install it to clutch case.

21. Install shaft set and fork shaft.

(a) Apply gear oil to all sliding and rotating parts. (b) Apply gear oil to No.1 fork shaft sub-assembly (1) and install it to output shaft sub-assembly.

(c) Apply gear oil to No.2 fork shaft sub-assembly (1) and No.3 fork shaft sub-assembly (2), then install them to output shaft sub-assembly (3).

![](images/f3f8e08ae058fc2fb3778ab756aa00ba668db24939cb9df2ed0c5363563c046b.webp)

![](images/7801c8b667b0c0d8094b81dc7940eb28acf73bf3432e87b7c311d5054c2bc823.webp)

(d) Temporarily install output shaft sub-assembly, input shaft sub-assembly, No.1 fork shaft subassembly, No.2 fork shaft sub-assembly and No.3 fork shaft sub-assembly.

(e) Install output shaft sub-assembly, input shaft subassembly, No.1 fork shaft sub-assembly, No.2 fork shaft sub-assembly and No.3 fork shaft subassembly to clutch case.

![](images/ce199e770021735901e11d2ed9864adaf8dcf29c9247d7625c3af16fa06512d6.webp)

22. Install the outer select lever.

(a) Install outer select lever and inner select lever to clutch case.

# Caution:

Install inner select lever with its mark "a" face outside of clutch case.

![](images/9af4b7f2479272fff2b3791f5115412c66e86d740fc632847d0df9930ee39912.webp)

23. Install the select and shift shaft sub-assembly.

(a) Rotate select and shift shaft sub-assembly (1) and lock plate (3) counterclockwise, then install them to clutch case.

# Caution:

Make sure to engage inner select lever (2) to lock plate during installation.

![](images/1e1bd6d703800b0d80e2ba2daed1ffb8d1c5a5e429dd160ead60f4d94dc82fe0.webp)

(b) Using 6 mm hexagon wrench, install bolt (arrow) and secure inner select lever and outer select lever. Tightening torque 28 ± 5.6 N•m

![](images/d01565ee968a0310e75ccc97c4f761f7433d4536655c66fdab08a588bdafabb7.webp)

24. Install the reverse gear arm bracket set.

(a) Install reverse gear arm bracket set to clutch case with fixing bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 17 ± 3.4 N•m

![](images/e1f229cfd12a550f304c8c80b0c5bb63551a8661e7cc091336525edecb04ee6a.webp)

25. Install the reverse gear fork set.

(a) Apply gear oil to reverse gear fork set (arrow) and install it to clutch case.

![](images/cdbdc2cf7cae98930a869b2e30b68de64643e532b52b488b8efab3acd815472f.webp)

26. Install the reverse idler gear set.

(a) As shown in illustration, apply gear oil to reverse idler gear set, idler gear thrust washer and reverse idler gear shaft, then install them to clutch case.

# Caution:

Make sure that notch (a) plane on reverse idler gear shaft is aligned with dowel pin (c) on clutch case. Lift up edge of reverse gear arm bracket set and install it to reverse gear fork set.

![](images/2011729e15a2a0606b52dfe207887751c1b9d5790ace9c3da16f0876d7e4f1ce.webp)

27. Install the transmission case.

(a) As shown in illustration, apply seal gum to joint surface (a) between transmission case and clutch case.

# Warning:

Remove any oil from contact surface. Install parts within 10 minutes after application. Otherwise, it is necessary to remove seal gum and reapply.

![](images/06007b8d6559f0f67744cff0bebdd12c373d8459a8c22727a996c553943e54f8.webp)

(b) Push outer shift lever and temporarily install transmission case.

(c) Pull out outer shift lever and rotate it counterclockwise.

(d) Install transmission case with 16 bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 29.4 ± 5.9 N•m

![](images/c5c4997cc61966b6cca2658607581d93db9150aa84e601b3b625f6ae48de7a32.webp)

28. Install the outer shift lever E type retainer.

(a) Install E type retainer (arrow) to outer shift lever.

# Caution:

E type retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/f6e443e834fb003e6e3285055cc0b93acd4a95eda1ae3e76fdb5ee81d4af9f42.webp)

29. Install the self-locking set.

# 26-62

(a) Install 2 steel balls and 2 self-locking springs to transmission case.

(b) Using a hexagon wrench, install 2 self-locking bolts (arrow) to transmission case.

Tightening torque 22.0 ± 6.6 N•m

# Caution:

Be careful not to drop steel ball into transmission.

![](images/2df3da6f0a64fa60e648e8f380f015e93175c798fa99859c45300c2900e4492e.webp)

(c) Install 1 steel ball and self-locking spring to transmission case.

(d) Using a hexagon wrench, install 1 self-locking bolt (arrow) to transmission case.

Tightening torque 22.0 ± 6.6 N•m

# Caution:

Be careful not to drop steel ball into transmission.

![](images/23314b888ff75f1d0472447f8305c3a55a734d8434f85752338de163fb912a6c.webp)

30. Install the steel ball dowel pin.

(a) Install steel ball dowel pin and spring to transmission case.   
(b) Using a tool, install inner hexagon head bolt (arrow) to transmission case. Tightening torque 24.5 ± 7.4 N•m

![](images/3cf592753ae2c689ff7343a73388564fd141d187ecb81e8afab5be4ee3a350d7.webp)

31. Install the reverse idler gear shaft bolt.

(a) Install new bolt washer and reverse idler gear shaft bolt (arrow) to transmission case. Tightening torque 30 ± 9 N•m Caution: Reverse idler gear shaft bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/a2295ff171fbf061647f50175f223a84086efcffe0473d6e94ae4940da22bbec.webp)

32. Install the locating mechanism set.

(a) Install new locating mechanism set to transmission case. Tightening torque 29.4 ± 8.8 N•m

![](images/a20839e8c06b58a6a68d8f88eb5e47619123c6319f3b82f8a43eac2ff4939df8.webp)

33. Install the reverse switch.

(a) Using a tool, install new bolt washer and reverse switch (arrow) to transmission case. Tightening torque 44 ± 8.8 N•m

# Caution:

Reverse switch bolt washer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/30937586c056f13d22aff7c9141f0be4db1c24f4b95ad6f61aa4c2ff5e6c7490.webp)

34. Install filler bolt and limit bolt.

![](images/79f53ef3e9d4c3b5eb0476023f190cd26a2be34eb9c65fe8e156b40416378634.webp)

(a) Install 2 new bolt washers and 2 new hexagon head bolts to transmission case. Tightening torque 39 ± 11 N•m

# Caution:

Filler bolt, limit bolt and bolt washer are nonreusable components, and replace them after removal.

35. Install the drain bolt.

(a) Install new bolt washer and new hexagon head bolt to clutch case.

Tightening torque 39 ± 11 N•m

# Caution:

Drain bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

![](images/06d3a3e72089de7bdf38bedd066aa79b47a68b55a8160e63f842c5b29c240657.webp)

36. Install the differential oil seal (left).

(a) Apply MP grease to oil seal lip. (b) Using special tool and hammer, install new differential oil seal to transmission case.

Standard depth 9.6 \~ 10.2 mm

# Caution:

DO NOT damage the oil seal lip. Differential oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/a20fdeae75ba1d8ce869ba207a649ce9116f6bfb933dc463c072c7fffffc1ca6.webp)

37. Install the differential oil seal (right).

(a) Apply MP grease to oil seal lip. (b) Using special tool and hammer, install new differential oil seal to transmission case.

Standard depth 3.9 \~ 4.5 mm

# Caution:

DO NOT damage the oil seal lip. Differential oil seal is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/ca2e638d073b82d81957b8a8f6a4fc3bc1d5f8483461a135c7401988bc2a67fa.webp)

# Installation

1. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

# Input Shaft Sub-assembly

1. Remove the shaft retainer.

(a) Using a snap ring expander, remove shaft retainer at input shaft rear bearing.

# Caution:

Input shaft retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/fc820208e8aa88ee90bdc72a9bce6343ab7e250111d33a1b69e8715f6b9548f6.webp)

2. Remove the 6th gear set.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove input shaft rear bearing and 6th gear set from input shaft.

![](images/b0de891e5a143878d3496d939837944446ea35e39e910eb6c94d67229a1e051a.webp)

3. Remove the 6th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 6th gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from 6th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/fb8844f57d186c518c2ee1078be1337df9aa59e8f7611fca549f7fd233d595c7.webp)

4. Remove the No.5 synchronizer gear ring (6th gear side).

(a) Remove No.3 synchronizer gear ring (6th gear side) (arrow) from No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/78545129fddb5d6148a5c75186e73d1c3f4ebb1a035a1b8bf7a6b7375914d4e9.webp)

5. Remove the 6th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Remove 6th gear shaft bushing (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/1ec84a4c8bfbd33930c9f92d3f978c3acdc28931c794de229a8d992acf562883.webp)

6. Remove the 6th gear shaft bushing locking ball.

(a) Using a magnetic finger (a), remove 6th gear shaft bushing locking ball (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/4cfb0244d8299b85dda7eb42ca291fe8a336b89ca502d9bcd99bd06e734ae2ff.webp)

7. Remove the No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Remove No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve (arrow) from No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/0fa6f377edc1aa0fe64c2f6323cf4abe839dc69b0c526d8bbe166c76f24b351e.webp)

8. Remove the synchronizer slider.

(a) Remove 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) from No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/b9977668a2993fffb8a714c80951e1584f04809744438e7ad75c691320b3be9e.webp)

9. Remove the 5th gear set.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove No.3 synchronizer gear hub, No.3 synchronizer gear ring (5th gear side) and 5th gear set from input shaft.

![](images/f2ace5fae2a050c20d50a47633d042364fc00a344a41db17173a4bf5d0009a61.webp)

10. Remove the 5th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 5th gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from 5th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/f1b4ddd9fcc288047ffcd6b2aa64c3a88245d58da99a933768687ed0f9cb458a.webp)

11. Remove the 5th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Remove 5th gear shaft bushing (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/d3bd728c5a78ea54fa2b2cb5585effe52325d0afc54481ee06936f02aed4efaa.webp)

12. Remove the 5th gear shaft bushing locking ball.

(a) Using a magnetic finger (a), remove 5th gear shaft bushing locking ball (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/6a44fc5fae0c383268e23a02c2d49e3aca511a5d2c9514e686b0d5c2bb21e362.webp)

13. Remove the 4th gear set.

(a) Remove 4th gear set (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/a25838940b4e3baaf0bf0e5ac6b0cde7da62e2f32b9178894e12e85b21d77041.webp)

14. Remove the 4th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 4th gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/e1f1a9bbf3fb2e9956cf7ee40e272fa278cf785c0b24039137825941cb82359c.webp)

15. Remove the No.2 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Remove No.2 synchronizer gear ring (arrow) from No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/c815a5f0964a57d6718fccc5c638c417ed907f2dbe28c7b82441068582fd27e1.webp)

16. Remove the spacer.

(a) Remove spacer (arrow) from No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/5e7dc9d7cf8e0eead19c4c91d6eed79cf5f46f7c8104435deb1e37d0317007e8.webp)

17. Remove the No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Remove No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve (arrow) from No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/52c48bc9fc7cddad283f30d21386cdd42de7c47199f3c5b55c7aa1019e45c158.webp)

18. Remove the synchronizer slider.

(a) Remove 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) from No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/527d636d8d7be37cbb39b5dd5299bda6e408bad66d60975d020ada1d9eee21fe.webp)

19. Remove the shaft retainer.

(a) Using a snap ring expander, remove shaft retainer at No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

# Caution:

Input shaft retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/cf519b1d50b9356637945be7a076a97a3da7330a54c1539b569686ec4dd8f445.webp)

20. Remove the 3rd gear set.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove No.2 synchronizer gear hub, No.2 synchronizer gear ring and 3rd gear set from input shaft.

![](images/fcf429bd96780e7e3b419a1a40f0c1e0cdc10d3631f4c77d01a4cf5603514104.webp)

21. Remove the 3rd gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 3rd gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from input shaft.

![](images/06a732fe061b8792b8fa61db950a4cdcc0cedda21420b75a09f1fd3710f87267.webp)

22. Remove the input shaft front bearing.

(a) Using a press, remove front bearing from input shaft.

![](images/8557df10939679ec0559aac363b097d8cd08737506b9b401e9442472a5639e75.webp)

# Assembly

1. Install the input shaft front bearing.

(a) Using a press, install input shaft front bearing to input shaft.

![](images/f0a28c8ca76d22cd3ac5b6318a6da93053d8f1ef4e988254678f5bd3181de833.webp)

2. Install the 3rd gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 3rd gear needle roller bearing, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/45659bf8edf6faebed08e3a446cb2b3ea2540e32f7ddf592ead654cba637a617.webp)

3. Install the 3rd gear set.

(a) Apply gear oil to 3rd gear set, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/fae2f8361ebb5fe98c2ef0ce1cd41c47d4904197b2840ab33da878564312d745.webp)

4 Install the No.2 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.2 synchronizer gear ring, and install it to 3rd gear.

![](images/291131eae2eec8d648e0b37443199be24ba553d5d51066d44ae9489d3411c8cb.webp)

5. Install the No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.2 synchronizer gear hub, and install it to input shaft.

(b) Using specia tool and press, install No.2 synchronizer gear hub to input shaft.

# Caution:

When installing No.2 synchronizer gear hub, align boss of No.2 synchronizer gear ring with notch of No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/c97bbcf7da3cfd7da5486cfc65b11fe866c667f114d0549161404cb59d43c2f8.webp)

6. Install the shaft retainer.

(a) Select a new shaft retainer that allows minimal axial clearance. Standard clearance Less than 0.1 mm   
(b) Using a snap ring expander, install a new shaft retainer.

![](images/8a90d6727c826561dfa18e877d5e9bcaca37784bfb7717b34357a9cc4bd02328.webp)

# Caution:

Be sure to properly install shaft retainer because it is easy to expand.

![](images/5502f084a11d19ffc2017b46b2266177b41afd26dd0b4820a337cb4c28429319.webp)

DO NOT damage journal surface of shaft   
retainer.   
Input shaft retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

7. Install the synchronizer slider.

(a) Install 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) to No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/ebb9f1cf66c9fcad1f4a688a7befef1f0d3998f35068e2496143b6cc371b805e.webp)

8. Install the No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve, and install it to No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

# Caution:

When installing No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve, align its missing teeth part with notch (a) of No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/5a5fd262c4a91f1934d74031d4db49c37a6a67590690cc33a89897adb2be1aa9.webp)

9. Install the spacer.

(a) Install spacer (arrow) to No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/23f436adc6081cc8b89771e7b6959a679b34df937ae68949ebda4230bb29fecc.webp)

10. Install the 4th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 4th gear needle roller bearing and spacer, and install 4th gear needle roller bearing (arrow) to input shaft.

![](images/c50f0dfed6e4bbb0b960b2cc86fd121b14da7f59c6f369c49b995819b4a49d33.webp)

11. Install the No.2 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.2 synchronizer gear ring, and install it to No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

# Caution:

When installing No.2 synchronizer gear ring, align its boss with notch of No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/3df078cff996ed08b58d71cd7c6464e4fd4c845a7cc05c75106edc85209bf02a.webp)

12. Install the 4th gear set.

(a) Apply gear oil to 4th gear set, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/4a523fdb2f4f9b899e565c63447d08641f09b025ba4f802e2e53df272de1723e.webp)

13. Install the 5th gear shaft bushing locking ball.

(a) Apply gear oil to ball, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/30e3d909c915e74452b2221f92dcc4f1fccbae1d7242663f12eba0f63308d1e6.webp)

14. Install the 5th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 5th gear shaft bushing, and install it to input shaft.

# Caution:

Align groove of 5th gear shaft bushing with ball.

![](images/26726112acafa53b5d534996ca476c402b2583f4f4c78e47187d414883f9b8e4.webp)

15. Install the 5th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 5th gear needle roller bearing (arrow), and install it to 5th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/b2829e8551c927c5749560c433b3a45ce7c9d4d56563648e5782ada120a6565c.webp)

16. Install the 5th gear set.

(a) Apply gear oil to 5th gear set, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/d11fcf89ae7cdde00590ebadb3d2842f4cfab5f6dc5a892fdc53e87577424736.webp)

17. Install the No.3 synchronizer gear ring (5th gear side).

(a) Apply gear oil to No.3 synchronizer gear ring, and install it to 5th gear set.

![](images/9f4a8bcd7161c4d435cef3d7df662a69ee835b0a9c90fa8c5036d3e920b7271d.webp)

18. Install the No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.3 synchronizer gear hub, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/a2d3d49af22fdc974ac07f995751261d6e6db7059641735e97c83ad1d05ab8d1.webp)

(b) Using specia tool and press, install No.3 synchronizer gear hub to input shaft.

# Caution:

When installing No.3 synchronizer gear hub, align boss of No.3 synchronizer gear ring (5th gear side) with notch of No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/40cfe680a594cec2c5b06c1842bb3f1432d7657de820c69c51ff526c30d0ed6e.webp)

SM0264002

19. Install the synchronizer slider.

(a) Install 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) to No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/ff2ebe8af6fd7db3238bc7a94e803da9f44afdc2aa1852bb00dfefe414af3895.webp)

20. Install the 6th gear shaft bushing locking ball.

(a) Apply gear oil to ball (arrow), and install it to input shaft.

![](images/a46c6450d074f866fb8150a5d17036bd5bb3a05e1dc9516ae5fb9bc3557c5a09.webp)

21. Install the No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve, and install it to No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/b0885dcfd12a0d56de233b6d4f71b07aea3ba6f4ae5b4d6a40ce1fd68cca0a33.webp)

22. Install the 6th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 6th gear shaft bushing, and install it to input shaft.

# Caution:

Align groove of 6th gear shaft bushing with ball.

![](images/3122f8e82f2b3c415a03ac532e9452614239b268f34502751616e75b8a346fac.webp)

23. Install the 6th gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 6th gear needle roller bearing (arrow), and install it to 6th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/3733999d6da99dd83fbacabc0b14d3d95023fa8c2d2a805af08c4f692f104e95.webp)

24. Install the No.3 synchronizer gear ring (6th gear side).

(a) Apply gear oil to No.3 synchronizer gear ring, and install it to 6th gear set.

# Caution:

When installing No.3 synchronizer gear ring (6th gear side), align its boss with notch of No.3 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/4e927d9fe403b7f5d3aa19e425d2a02373af79ca7db3e2c14582f9df072d7d1b.webp)

25. Install the 6th gear set.

(a) Apply gear oil to 6th gear set, and install it to input shaft.

![](images/7cfb7d6bbfcd5f54821cd307f5bc73a9d38570683fb6b0dc3e86323b4e3c1ddb.webp)

26. Install the input shaft rear bearing.

(a) Using special tool and press, install input shaft rear bearing to input shaft.

![](images/4ed769ddcfb130f72c874d3f6f005728c4b35ea0ad67bf9853b21184a880141b.webp)

27. Install the shaft retainer.

(a) Select a new shaft retainer that allows minimal axial clearance.

Standard clearance Less than 0.1 mm   
![](images/a6437ccc7fae5994bc46991bb5b8a467db3d3931d5041617f2d93b2809b1f5e5.webp)

![](images/a33c12798ae724b9857f9c4bd2b0c2a2807610de93cd94a0d7058e9ce569730d.webp)

(b) Using a snap ring expander, install a new shaft retainer. Caution:

Be sure to properly install shaft retainer because it is easy to expand.   
Input shaft retainer is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

# Input Shaft Sub-assembly Inspection

1. Check the 6th gear axial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 6th gear axial clearance.

Standard clearance 0.15 \~ 0.43 mm   
Maximum clearance 0.43 mm   
If clearance is more than the maximum, replace   
No.3 synchronizer gear hub, 6th gear set or input   
shaft.

![](images/1c43ca104ab2d9cc8831dfda4f9c34f3cb28d3140764caec7fc1829e9a3a7619.webp)

2. Check the 5th gear axial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 5th gear axial clearance.

Standard clearance 0.15 \~ 0.43 mm   
Maximum clearance 0.43 mm   
If clearance is more than the maximum value,   
replace No.3 synchronizer gear hub, 5th gear set or   
input shaft.

![](images/950188a336b3333c488950fe106501f4dc1256e9cb79f17f09fbd30d35c49f1a.webp)

3. Check the 4th gear axial clearance.

# 26-82

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 4th gear axial clearance. Standard clearance 0.15 \~ 0.56 mm Maximum clearance 0.56 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace No.2 synchronizer gear hub, 4th gear set or input shaft.

![](images/09d0a7878f3eb38919423534be1e68d4c022f73895a747d463410ba29598ccf1.webp)

4. Check the 3rd gear axial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 3rd gear axial clearance. Standard clearance 0.15 \~ 0.43 mm Maximum clearance 0.43 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace No.2 synchronizer gear hub, 3rd gear set or input shaft.

![](images/4510036508a21e3166cd131d553a2c02d0f9d48e4d3957d5b1655475b1416029.webp)

5. Check the 6th gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 6th gear radial clearance between 6th gear set and input shaft. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.045 mm Maximum clearance 0.045 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 6th gear bearing, 6th gear shaft bushing or input shaft.

![](images/dfd887f63b80d78401b0c32a280568b73a1dd3aee547af63b521f81db656d7fe.webp)

6. Check the 5th gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 5th gear radial clearance between 5th gear set and input shaft. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.045 mm Maximum clearance 0.045 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 5th gear set, 5th gear needle roller bearing, 5th gear shaft bushing or input shaft.

![](images/2cc1324e8dc14be5555a0549fbdaf31bd2294a357372f53f44ae41fd011fbfcf.webp)

7. Check the 4th gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 4th gear radial clearance between 4th gear set and input shaft. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.050 mm Maximum clearance 0.050 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 4th gear set, 4th gear needle roller bearing, 4th gear shaft bushing or input shaft.

![](images/dd09862c9439ae789304467759025772146b9a5122d505b7fa6e0f1f30fe7e30.webp)

8. Check the 3rd gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 3rd gear radial clearance between 3rd gear set and input shaft. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.050 mm Maximum clearance 0.050 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 3rd gear set, 3rd gear needle roller bearing, 3rd gear shaft bushing or input shaft.

![](images/3900dd0ad3b1405ecf357cb425d6578d8d80581261951e1a1e739fd7e6768af4.webp)

(a) Using a dial indicator, check the input shaft runout. Maximum runout 0.03 mm If runout is more than the maximum, replace input shaft.

![](images/1bcd4706cbfbd06e5851d380006f20afea00549981c7a040fae4c9c08108253b.webp)

(b) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of input shaft journal surface at specified locations.

![](images/cc56793a52a9460c58bffffb9ac94eed8266b475221b5096ebcbce56a4eefaf9.webp)

outer diameter at any location is less than the minimum value, replace input shaft.

![](images/82cb414003a7aeedea620639ac67473f0ee056e8b140a0511af387ed8dd1dcff.webp)

10. Check the 6th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of 6th gear shaft bushing. Standard outer diameter 35.09 \~ 35.10 mm Minimum outer diameter 35.09 mm If outer diameter is less than the minimum value, replace 6th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/df1fc4af21bcc59a64b9b0fbf8792297bae98fe9317598ccc38ae198e70a5f35.webp)

(b) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 6th gear shaft bushing.

Standard inner diameter 28.005 \~ 28.020 mm   
Maximum inner diameter 28.020 mm   
If inner diameter is more than the maximum value,   
replace 6th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/94c7091af73bf49dce0901936f5284534c53dd452967388060e18558a69babdb.webp)

11. Check the 5th gear shaft bushing.

(a) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of 5th gear shaft bushing. Standard outer diameter 37.49 \~ 37.50 mm Minimum outer diameter 37.49 mm If outer diameter is less than the minimum value, replace 5th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/c74fdeaa3b7592b3f21b6c8683b4629a4e3ce6db0c2782fadc994047f686e6f9.webp)

(b) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 5th gear shaft bushing. Standard inner diameter 31.705 \~ 31.720 mm Maximum inner diameter 31.720 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 5th gear shaft bushing.

![](images/865ef7cf1485ae92a95b86a1edffbc4a2ae4acffe850fbc75412c91f47ba9d2d.webp)

12. Check the 6th gear set.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 6th gear set. Standard inner diameter 40.109 \~ 40.125 mm Maximum inner diameter 40.125 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 6th gear set.

![](images/bcdb0e94c875f095aaa1bc1054cecc3228219f8b58d8cfcf17e03212d876f80e.webp)

13. Check the 5th gear set.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 5th gear shaft bushing. Standard inner diameter 42.509 \~ 42.525 mm Maximum inner diameter 42.525 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 5th gear set.

![](images/a676b6677612aaa1f19ba666f4354b835cced80639750eb159b3004eba544ef2.webp)

14. Check the 4th gear set.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 4th gear set. Standard inner diameter 42.509 \~ 42.525 mm Maximum inner diameter 42.525 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 4th gear set.

![](images/488f42cbb69413b7575d5af6c316e65684f0a79eedefad648232e6dae8dc6420.webp)

15. Check the 3rd gear set.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 3rd gear set. Standard inner diameter 42.509 \~ 42.525 mm Maximum inner diameter 42.525 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 3rd gear set.

![](images/789b2ea9df30ad2f748a546f72d8e9cfcf7c25287245a6a0bda03babdbd4b506.webp)

16. Check the No.5 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Check for wear and damage.   
(b) Apply gear oil to 5th gear cone.   
(c) Turn No.5 synchronizer gear ring in one direction while pushing it to 5th gear cone.

(d) Check that the gear ring locks. If synchronizer gear ring does not lock (a), replace No.5 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/d8f7a645cc39d8c4c1c731d7539b85622dbc907bb7ad28dd2180c4946d69f8cc.webp)

(e) Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between No.5 synchronizer gear ring and spline gear end.

Standard clearance 0.73 \~ 1.53 mm   
Minimum clearance 0.73 mm   
If clearance is less than the minimum value, replace   
No.5 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/5cfd8031ee5e6bab6e54372bec5c06ddb122271017eb627e564f96f31ae07f3d.webp)

17. Check the No.4 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Check for wear and damage.   
(b) Apply gear oil to 4th gear cone.   
(c) Turn No.4 synchronizer gear ring in one direction while pushing it to 4th gear cone.

(d) Check that the gear ring locks. If synchronizer gear ring does not lock (a), replace No.4 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/618eae9ffb84f89d4a2cd35fa2df7838be9a2a335203c9a528b11b12456e28ba.webp)

(e) Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between No.4 synchronizer gear ring and spline gear end.

Standard clearance 0.78 \~ 1.58 mm   
Minimum clearance 0.78 mm   
If clearance is less than the minimum value, replace   
No.4 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/e8db4eddddb195a9ff4e5472050df649193ec7cbad60de65ec5ff2e712f9a20c.webp)

18. Check the No.3 synchronizer gear ring.

(a) Check for wear and damage.   
(b) Apply gear oil to 3rd gear cone.   
(c) Turn No.3 synchronizer gear ring in one direction while pushing it to 3rd gear cone.

(d) Check that the gear ring locks. If synchronizer gear ring does not lock, replace No.3 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/7abdd5d9ffee43caeb3dadab55acc92c8fa8e1b8c0f5488148433debea3f56ca.webp)

(e) Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between No.3 synchronizer gear ring and spline gear end. Standard clearance 0.78 \~ 1.58 mm Minimum clearance 0.78 mm If clearance is less than the minimum value, replace No.3 synchronizer gear ring.

![](images/d4fe817e258c1031dfa38bfc86ebaa68f90b85152fbd82f05263119407db413a.webp)

19. Check the No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Check sliding condition between No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.2 synchronizer gear hub.

(b) Check that spline edges of No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve are not worn.

(c) Using vernier calipers, measure width (A) of fork groove of No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve and thickness (B) of fork claw of No.2 fork shaft subassembly, then calculate clearance.

# Standard clearance

0.1 \~ 0.5 mm If clearance is not as specified, replace No.2 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.2 fork shaft subassembly.

![](images/8d8769d8f09f66b606b955b81b6c3d3f6f0cb80c731af4e775838f482184958f.webp)

20. Check the No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Check sliding condition between No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.3 synchronizer gear hub.   
(b) Check that spline edges of No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve are not worn.

![](images/f309bc52b938466778b95ef050dbfa3fc6d6b0af840f44447d8cb901fe699b28.webp)

(c) Using vernier calipers, measure width (A) of fork groove of No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve and thickness (B) of fork claw of No.3 fork shaft subassembly, then calculate clearance (a).

Standard clearance 0.1 \~ 0.5 mm

If clearance is not as specified, replace No.3 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.3 fork shaft subassembly.

![](images/425a838c868d9ff70628c3f784f7f7fd84f3da3729c88a62f2bbbc1145e3e1db.webp)

# Output Shaft Sub-assembly

Remove the 6th driven gear.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove output shaft rear bearing and 6th driven gear from output shaft.

# Caution:

Output shaft rear bearing is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/60895f2a3eccf49b6f8c77ca8e127ae9fc7e5107c8168f5dcc276c8eaa20323c.webp)

2. Remove the output shaft spacer.

(a) Remove output shaft spacer (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/a13127a7d5bd2898d54c880e8b968edc0fdcce46c97fd8038c15f11bcb2dd565.webp)

3. Remove 5th and 4th driven gears.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove 5th driven gear and 4th driven gear from output shaft.

![](images/f61237008dea5ce279a2159b48f264031792a96a13d50c2c0bb85b587c1c55f7.webp)

4. Remove the gear shaft.

(a) Remove gear shaft bushing (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/fd1dcd6bf3a496a9bb1ba1ec9599d182f1667a455f70bfa3c124ea959f5942a3.webp)

5. Remove 3rd and 2nd gears.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove 3rd driven gear and 2nd gear from output shaft.

![](images/163fce26d8b11eb5a8957c01e50d1cc71dd18cd2a4d37ef7f03e46dc3bae075f.webp)

6. Remove the 2nd gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 2nd gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from 2nd gear shaft bushing.

![](images/784dec163ec84de0e75d8b71b0bccab4aa79aab9fda101bc26a81fb75fb039cc.webp)

7. Remove the 2nd gear shaft bushing.

(a) Remove 2nd gear shaft bushing (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/c2c9a84635e2b3c99a6871659e4fd92d7122fd5ff596fed52432e9105106395b.webp)

(a) Remove No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (2nd gear side) from No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/8ffd5124c174f220d2904547a1424526a86a8737d6a7a6bfb2703db5944a0694.webp)

9. Remove the No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve. (a) Remove No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve (arrow) from No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/36a5fda18d508e2895cab959702aa0c121927f5cc965adc6c69ad0349ec0ce11.webp)

10. Remove the synchronizer slider.

(a) Remove 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) from No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/be2a34cdd9f96a8418e940a13ea0b91b97c35b4e5af6f04d0732afd59616ab74.webp)

11. Remove the No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

(a) Remove No.1 synchronizer gear hub (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/2191829fd86cd42bc7ff428b5c3bea876399ab14fc36ee4cef8fe727814e2bd5.webp)

12. Remove the No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (1st gear side).

(a) Remove No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (1st gear side) from No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/957256f483303059ca1c1ab9f7c922ebff6e7a4d52427e7d036969abe7a70b02.webp)

13. Remove the 1st gear.

(a) Remove 1st gear (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/aadff915e13247af88a3abb5ac0f05ae678b3b5621a9a952e0aef9da1cce9da2.webp)

14. Remove the 1st gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Remove 1st gear needle roller bearing (arrow) from 1st gear shaft bushing.

![](images/cda022915534b03862f58b645405dba7612188bb6d1df4f7db06c15500597397.webp)

15. Remove the 1st gear shaft bushing.

(a) Remove 1st gear shaft bushing (arrow) from output shaft.

![](images/c75cfdca97ea9516d8d70e1ea43b96b5289bdfd751cdc4a1db2649a87222d7d0.webp)

16. Remove the output shaft front bearing.

(a) Using special tool and press, remove output shaft front bearing from output shaft.

# Caution:

Output shaft front bearing is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/43d056a8b7ba4e35523c2a595e54a44a4f53e6ded8d498b726731006b9fa8dfc.webp)

# Assembly

1. Install the output shaft front bearing inner race.

(a) Using special tool and press, install new output shaft front bearing inner race to output shaft.

# Caution:

Output shaft front bearing is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/c8776f81390a3e760840c1ba923718e386963beea005c53ff1f3ba51215e9b92.webp)

2. Install the 1st gear shaft bushing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 1st gear shaft bushing (arrow), and install it to output shaft.

![](images/f7e2ca0fff5a32349dc08671154fd2e0de7a9c607b655d62bc5b9346634d3384.webp)

3. Install the 1st gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 1st gear needle roller bearing (arrow), and install it to output shaft.

![](images/c341f4d57d211e60c2d663da7f8686f4a0c453cb8f1da6bc057b44be33657572.webp)

4. Install the 1st gear.

(a) Apply gear oil to 1st gear (arrow), and install it to output shaft.

![](images/81c44526278bbeb2d6efe9987f012bc23f9b496565669e40c96b576c9a11a907.webp)

5. Install the No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (1st gear side).

(a) Apply gear oil to 1st gear cone and No.1 synchronizer set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring), and install inner ring, middle ring and outer ring to 1st gear in sequence.

# Caution:

Install claws of middle ring to grooves of 1st gear. Align claw of inner ring with groove of outer ring before installing outer ring.

![](images/05388880dc7a316a290819201d8736ef4fdf8d2786d15fc382abdf984d0940b1.webp)

6. Install the No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

(a) Install No.1 synchronizer gear hub to output shaft.

# Caution:

Align notch of No.1 synchronizer gear hub with boss of outer ring.

![](images/17c75391eac6eede234c7cc22b8cd1fba65f67010e2c33cb579f99d3fa2e7f63.webp)

7. Install the synchronizer slider.

(a) Install 3 synchronizer sliders (arrow) to No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/fca9e6628526e16f334628755c29413fdd04d193446df8e3d8061b7ba23d8c8b.webp)

8. Install the No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Apply gear oil to No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.1 synchronizer gear hub, and install No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve (arrow) to No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

![](images/5ecd7d80a33313f30fd7931a35d59bb25449614f7b779aca89f89494aaa46059.webp)

9. Install the No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (2nd gear side). (a) Apply gear oil to No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring).

(b) Install outer ring to No.1 synchronizer gear hub.

# Caution:

Align boss of outer ring with notch of No.1 synchronizer gear hub before installing outer ring.

(c) Install middle ring to outer ring.

![](images/c1fc2f2339b6d58185caab76d92e7ba8afaf444fd6409c6ade15873fd2ade523.webp)![](images/725865c8f3dd44a9f5368f6b1e1339d3a1bae13852546ea5cd4efe4fed491b62.webp)

# Caution:

(d) Install inner ring to middle ring.

Align notch (c) of outer ring (b) with boss of inner ring before installing inner ring (a).

10. Install the 2nd gear shaft bushing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 2nd gear shaft bushing (arrow), and install it to output shaft.

![](images/3949e88ddc833285eb92a129d5a1d489feea19afaaf1f72e45f144087f2c8eab.webp)

11. Install the 2nd gear needle roller bearing.

(a) Apply gear oil to 2nd gear bearing (arrow), and install it to output shaft.

![](images/157ed8e8bc52ef82313f6a855bae84cc5c8fac668b115226ee67b3ea365b370b.webp)

12. Install the 2nd gear.

(a) Apply gear oil to 2nd gear, and install it to output shaft.

# Caution:

Align claw (a) of middle ring with groove (b) of 2nd gear before installing 2nd gear.

![](images/11e6d01dc3464a603fa3ea49f3fd08c985d3ae71a6bbf3bd4b9b2bbd93dbe620.webp)

13. Install the 3rd driven gear.

(a) Using special tool and press, install 3rd driven gear to output shaft.

![](images/cb8e1c00d4ffac3a2e508bd4f84fc18424363740267afe2bd59da7426ec2ed1d.webp)

14. Install the output shaft spacer.

(a) Install output shaft spacer (arrow) to output shaft.

![](images/7e5a1d5e8e28657f672e1d5612aaff7c9dcc8f12bee1b86fbd59e43e4647c840.webp)

15. Install the 4th driven gear.

(a) Using special tool and press, install 4th driven gear to output shaft.

![](images/27dbdedab3ca35add01d1bdd82de974e747a04b84d1cd112320176a252bd7f6a.webp)

16. Install the 5th driven gear.

(a) Using special tool and press, install 5th driven gear to output shaft.

![](images/cc77a2783cdc91397b9bd952cf48495651191157ff527b70c9afbd756a0bfabd.webp)

17. Install the output shaft spacer.

(a) Install output shaft spacer (arrow) to output shaft.

![](images/3786794d86aec7431950cd533d95bc3ad13e64bcaa0e4818ee9cf4f02f47ee9d.webp)

18. Install the 6th driven gear.

(a) Using special tool and press, install 6th driven gear to output shaft.

![](images/742adf491d63b3e97428e9cbbf57778f650a1c0e2ab54bdf51ac32faff5397db.webp)

19. Install the output shaft rear bearing.

(a) Using special tool and press, install new output shaft rear bearing to output shaft.

# Caution:

Output shaft rear bearing is a non-reusable component, and replace it after removal.

![](images/21732b9c3cd76cf52f764236b7297529299d1da79c352ff3edf03d1832ad8146.webp)

# Output Shaft Sub-assembly Inspection

1. Check the 1st gear axial clearance.

(a) Check the 2nd gear axial clearance.

Standard clearance 0.20 \~ 0.38 mm   
Maximum clearance 0.38 mm   
If clearance is more than the maximum value,   
replace No.1 synchronizer gear hub, 1st gear shaft   
bushing or 1st gear.

![](images/c275c549c7c4a89e8ad25e3067e13041a7561808bb97e4cc88669de53e51c7b1.webp)

2. Using a dial indicator, measure 2nd gear axial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 2nd gear axial clearance. Standard clearance 0.15 \~ 0.33 mm Maximum clearance 0.33 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace No.1 synchronizer gear hub, 2nd gear shaft bushing, 2nd gear or 3rd driven gear.

![](images/a2aa503e8de6a36ff0ccf3044508370b09796e5c22abefc0a45e4c069030abd2.webp)

3. Using a dial indicator, measure 1st gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 1st gear radial clearance. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.047 mm Maximum clearance 0.047 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 1st gear, 1st gear needle roller bearing or output shaft.

![](images/6153d6ad978a0114de8a3d6091e9b99c77f6bdaf9b71517a2f495163947c6fa9.webp)

4. Check the 2nd gear radial clearance.

(a) Using a dial indicator, measure 2nd gear radial clearance. Standard clearance 0.009 \~ 0.047 mm Maximum clearance 0.047 mm If clearance is more than the maximum value, replace 2nd gear, 2nd gear needle roller bearing or output shaft.

![](images/618474760e98af07f205b86a6ed80654ebd1ad5e396219de2d997988f348db55.webp)

5. Check the output shaft.

(a) Using a dial indicator and 2 V-blocks, check output shaft runout. Maximum runout 0.03 mm If runout is more than the maximum value, replace output shaft.

![](images/1d3791c8b3aa1f598d230e69cada6a99825f02fc2288aed8be65b1dc8cf9dcfb.webp)

(b) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of output shaft journal surface at specified locations.

![](images/9eb2dea2b21f21a40155dc06193f5f5061c64c9c57537326785745d46454258c.webp)

If outer diameter of any location is less than the minimum value, replace output shaft.

![](images/252c2911b9815da326fcaad923ead7adb686691860c0b61c6690b5a88c0a4bd7.webp)

6. Check the 1st gear.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 1st gear.

Standard inner diameter 52.909 \~ 52.925 mm   
Maximum inner diameter 52.925 mm   
If inner diameter is more than the maximum value,   
replace 1st gear.

![](images/1b45d490978b6ad14c74902133bf9794b23f37df0acc5b26cbeff4ad49b3c636.webp)

7. Check the 2nd gear.

(a) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 2nd gear. Standard inner diameter 52.909 \~ 52.925 mm Maximum inner diameter 52.925 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 2nd gear shaft bushing.

![](images/5de2442828c6547c6ee3ad629cda2e22be747e383674ea02bdbba02686bd8cfc.webp)

8. Check the 1st gear shaft bushing.

(a) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of 1st gear shaft bushing. Standard outer diameter 47.89 \~ 47.90 mm Minimum outer diameter 47.89 mm If outer diameter is less than the minimum value, replace 1st gear shaft bushing.

![](images/d5587e3d309a35e8b3438041382710f38a776c941a9aae693d442f16f25eec94.webp)

(b) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 1st gear shaft bushing. Standard inner diameter 40.805 \~ 40.820 mm Minimum inner diameter 40.820 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 1st gear shaft bushing.

![](images/534a44177ce9ab5049f82ae229ecab6f8de083b1bc0cc5c66ec03e4a0236d66f.webp)

9. Check the 2nd gear shaft bushing.

(a) Using a micrometer, measure outer diameter of 2nd gear shaft bushing. Standard outer diameter 47.89 \~ 47.90 mm Minimum outer diameter 47.89 mm If outer diameter is less than the minimum value, replace 2nd gear shaft bushing.

(b) Using a cylinder gauge, measure inner diameter of 2nd gear shaft bushing. Standard inner diameter 38.005 \~ 38.020 mm Maximum inner diameter 38.020 mm If inner diameter is more than the maximum value, replace 2nd gear shaft bushing.

![](images/f9d1131a7421726bba3247418a9c38e96023d891b4500067f3734b33358e9679.webp)

10. Check the No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (1st gear).

(a) Apply gear oil to 1st gear cone and No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring).   
(b) Install inner ring (a) to 1st gear.   
(c) Install middle ring (b) to 1st gear.

(d) Install outer ring (c) to 1st gear.

![](images/0031b0a952d3b04acfb8986fa659766b92b1efe5e08f91927c2032d5274c67b0.webp)

(e) Check for wear and damage.   
(f) Turn No. 1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) in one direction while pushing it to 1st gear cone.

(g) Check that No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) locks. If No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) does not lock (a), replace it.

(h) Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) and spline end.

Standard clearance 0.915 \~ 1.855 mm   
Minimum clearance 0.915 mm   
If clearance is less than the minimum value, replace   
No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle   
ring and outer ring).

![](images/cb79847a0aab4999bbfdc2a44faa26506416a960333e69f2a5d9c1202660c36c.webp)

11. Check the No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (2nd gear).

(a) Apply gear oil to 2nd gear cone and No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring).   
(b) Install inner ring (a) to 2nd gear.   
(c) Install middle ring (b) to 2nd gear.

(d) Install outer ring (c) to 2nd gear.

![](images/5dfb3ebd35681c9838929656a0c429bc4afcc7d42ed80a16a12617e047c6e829.webp)

(e) Check for wear and damage.   
(f) Turn No. 1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) in one direction while pushing it to 2nd gear cone.

(h) Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring) and spline end. Standard clearance 0.92 \~ 1.86 mm Minimum clearance 0.92 mm If clearance is less than the minimum value, replace No.1 synchronizer gear ring set (inner ring, middle ring and outer ring).

![](images/64b3f66aaebc4b66f665208be0fcdc5348347595f1807d897165ee098662c05a.webp)

12. Check the No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve.

(a) Check sliding condition (arrow) between No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.1 synchronizer gear hub.   
(b) Check that spline edges of No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve are not worn.

![](images/40f292887e206e5cde64846c5f3bfc41c9259704f4ce9d0b13bf283045b71964.webp)

(c) Using vernier calipers, measure width (A) of fork groove of No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve and thickness (B) of fork claw of No.1 fork shaft subassembly, then calculate clearance (a).

Standard clearance 0.1 \~ 0.5 mm

If clearance is not as specified, replace No.1 synchronizer gear sleeve and No.1 fork shaft subassembly.

# GENERAL INFORMATION

Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) is widely used in mid-class to high-class vehicles all over the world due to its good shifting performance. CVT can not only realize the best matching between the drive train and engine operating condition within a fairly wide speed ratio range, but also improve the fuel economy of vehicle. At the same time, it also improves the combustion process and reduces exhaust emissions. CVT25 has adopted a large number of new technologies to further realize energy conservation and emission reduction:

1 It adapts advanced double-acting vane pump with high volumetric efficiency and low leakage, which is built in flow control valve, reducing power loss.   
2. Independent hydraulic circuit control is adopted to provide accurate operating pressure for each system, greatly improving system efficiency.   
3. Latest imported steel belt is adopted to further increase the speed ratio range and improve transmission efficiency. Especially work efficiency at OD speed ratio and LOW speed ratio is significantly improved.   
4. Hydraulic torque converter adopts high heat capacity lock clutch with low-speed slip differential lock function and integrates high-performance shock absorbers, which can realize good performance for low-speed power and economy.

# Basic Principle

CVT realizes stepless speed change by continuously changing the contact diameter between the drive and driven conical pressure plates and the steel belt. Operation is as follows:

Transmission Control Unit (TCU) sends command signals to the five solenoid valves in hydraulic system according to the requirements under the vehicle driving conditions (vehicle speed, load, engine speed, etc.).   
2. The solenoid valve continuously adjusts the operating state according to the commands from TCU. The combination of five solenoid valves in different operating states enables the flow direction and pressure of the hydraulic oil to be adjusted and changed in time, and precisely controls the action of hydraulic actuators (e.g. cylinders, pistons, spool valves, etc.).   
3. When the piston cavity pressure of hydraulic drive and driven conical pressure plates is continuously changed, the conical pressure plate generates corresponding axial movement according to the pressure changes, thereby changing the rotating radius of the steel belt, realizing continuous change of the transmission speed ratio and achieving the purpose of stepless speed change.

# Transmission Control Module PIN

Transmission Control Unit (TCU) receives the input signals from switches and sensors, primarily controls the operation of shift and lock solenoids. The drive gear is regulated by an electronic shift system. The TCU processes the input signal and adjusts the transmission hydraulic system by using received information.

![](images/da138ec617dde3c660244ddde22ef5962ee2499bf5b8e42ab1a2985df1231ce4.webp)
