If piston pin diameter is not within specified range, replace piston pin.

![](images/760e1a79a4a0d59aaaa322f3aaaa24bc1e74559787f606334ad93ed941b17da9.webp)

### Check the crankshaft main journal diameter.

1. Measure crankshaft main journal diameter with an external micrometer, and measure again after rotating the crankshaft 90°.

![](images/3f6172e4062038dd39d23f8f712882af882e7b4e345fbf31c9b9cf8f7b471dc2.webp)

### Hint:

![](images/81f34be06049dbfd1c040623647e40f07421b1182e58625e0bd6639b7bb5975d.webp)

### Check matching clearance of crankshaft main bearing.

1. Clean crankshaft main journals and main bearing shells.

![](images/f97b146732f8f516e4f60b56e76ead54d49c76cd6a8a986b6aff015bd6c8c4b4.webp)

### Torque: 1st step: 45 ± 5 N·m 2nd step: 180° ± 10°

![](images/279de4a84f6fb91477f6dd45c72ef1ca0e3426160fb208e66a47005b1a1eb3c5.webp)

### Hint:

If matching clearance of crankshaft main bearing is not within specified range, install new main bearing shells. Replace crankshaft assembly if necessary. Replace bearing shells in pairs.

![](images/1b3a92951e09985d3d9ec80bb669a88644632651d8ec60f6df4a3459967e4337.webp)

### Check the crankshaft axial clearance.

1. Clean crankshaft main journals and main bearing shells.   
2. Install crankshaft frame and tighten main bearing cap fixing bolts to specified torque in order.

Torque: 1st step: 45 ± 5 N·m 2nd step: 180° ± 10°

![](images/af7c78f838116ffc7b181dd957f48dd753e82af6cedf9b342494e339d0e941cf.webp)

![](images/7b1d84b6addde6f679895e39acae0ae409c00896a3a3b9b7a64414473ab0004a.webp)

### Check the crankshaft main journal coaxiality.

1. Install crankshaft onto tester and keep it level.

![](images/341dfbeb85db5f549634696444031f24ca7f431e4b61aad0cf7228cd972f468d.webp)

### Hint:

If crankshaft main journal coaxiality is not within specified range, replace crankshaft assembly.

![](images/d2133d0a0208b7d6411700ec2f24855f3f48c16674d978ebfa225adf2e8993f5.webp)

### Check diameter of crankshaft connecting rod journal.

Using an external micrometer, measure diameter of crankshaft connecting rod journal.

![](images/3a1a059b1edb83c83618fa893f701d7b2bb5e0d907fa758e3dbb6c942528ddd0.webp)

### Hint:

![](images/0fcc1e4e0d559b4666520b91fb6eb57e12dc7826e42ecc0fd85c4392b8c68a78.webp)

### Check radial clearance of crankshaft connecting rod bearing shell.

1. Clean connecting rod journals and connecting rod bearing shells.

2. Place a feeler gauge (1) on connecting rod journal.

![](images/08fdb02b50ab829f6c9fae40a4b3ed0b3f0fa67917858d742129a6e88b261aeb.webp)

Torque: 1st step: 20 25 N·m 2nd step: 85° ± 5°

Caution: DO NOT turn crankshaft during installation.

4. Remove the connecting rod bearing cap.

5. Using gauge scale of feeler gauge, measure the widest part of compressed feeler gauge to obtain radial clearance of connecting rod bearing shell.

![](images/5752c3e92eb4acb7b2ad160d773236120b900ae2534ad88a23cdcb597e3b7bdd.webp)

### Hint:

![](images/41ad712f000fb39553d8d6c2885b8a8efa49ae608c2a3fff9ce616f38e9e70dd.webp)

### Check axial clearance of connecting rod.

Torque: 1st step: 20 25 N·m 2nd step: 85° ± 5°

2. Install a dial indicator (2) with its plunger contacting the side of connecting rod cap (1). Reset dial of dial indicator to zero.

3. Push connecting rod cap forward and backward (do not move crankshaft forward and backward) and read value on dial indicator.

### Hint:

If axial clearance of connecting rod is not within specified range, replace piston connecting rod assembly. Replace crankshaft assembly f necessary.

![](images/d2e35a0e185f660e8d39d896766327bdb486b1551dfef96d5fccf3784aa71255.webp)

### Selection of Main Bearing Shell Selection of crankshaft main bearing shell

Related letter marks are available on cylinder block (consisting of A, B, C). Such as "BBBBA" in illustration, each letter from left to right is corresponding to the size of each crankshaft main bearing hole. First letter "B" indicates the first main bearing hole and the fifth letter "A" indicates the fifth main bearing hole.

2. Related marks are available on first balancer at front end of crankshaft (consisting of A, B and C). Such as "BBBBA" in illustration, each letter from left to right is corresponding to the size of crankshaft each main journal. First letter "B" indicates the first main journal and the fifth letter "A" indicates the fifth main journal.

![](images/f8a940624a556b5682b8c5dca799513df06f79460f166cea9e2cde32bb22348f.webp)

### Selection of connecting rod bearing upper shell

Connecting rod bearing upper shells are divided into red shell and blue shell. Related letter marks are available on connecting rod bearing shell cap (consisting of A and B).

2. As shown in illustration, mark "A" on connecting rod indicates red shell, "B" indicates blue shell.

![](images/636e1067301f07e0d0613246948266daa8a6dbcef28e4ef559c59a1ff9fcf767.webp)

![](images/d0ef658ab369e0556edf458b32038fc25844779bc98d7d953878e0be2c07f4b3.webp)

### Selection of connecting rod lower shell

![](images/775ab8ea94076594faa3d174a9c55c8570d1e98d92e8800d242bd001dd1cccf9.webp)

![](images/da39bbb214e45fbaacf07f95b44a6fb1a932ee1fdead8e9b2ae5a1317fd82489.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Connecting rod upper and lower bearing shells   
> cannot be interchanged.   
> It is necessary to use a set of connecting rod bearing shells that are provided by the same manufacturer on the same engine.   
> Apply a coat of engine oil to inner surface of   
> connecting rod bearing shell before installation. Back side of bearing shell should be clean without any oil or foreign matter during assembly, and make sure that back side and inner surface are clean.

### Removal & Installation of Accessory Pulley

![](images/625adcaf18b7d8bc87be60de3c07fa208de0a18f65ae2e29cab2a670e27017d2.webp)

K10010

![](images/2499e409a9585b3255918f00059a246d646bf0f713807fb00b99cf75797482a0.webp)

### Removal Warning:

Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing accessory drive belt. Appropriate force should be applied when removing accessory drive belt. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly.

4 Insert tool into tensioner pin hole and pull it upward in direction of arrow as shown in illustration, then remove accessory drive belt assembly (1).

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Prevent hand from contacting belt tensioner when raising it upward, so as to avoid damage.
>
> ![](images/e4cf2eb24aa12dd611f99422aec9c269e99c7cb964b79807c9906bd1a0afc5a5.webp)

### Installation Caution:

Before installation, remove the dirt from accessory drive belt. After installation, check if scale on tensioner arm is almost corresponding to the middle scale of tensioner base. Check that belt fits well to grooves on bottom of pulley properly. Avoid improper installation and misalignment.   
1. Install the accessory drive belt properly according to its moving direction.   
2. Use a tool to stuck tensioner installation hole. Lift up and install drive belt on each pulley to oper tensioner freely.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing idler pulley assembly. Appropriate force should be applied, when removing idler pulley assembly. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Remove the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19). 5. Remove fixing bolt and idler pulley assembly.
>
> ![](images/d748f91ec318030a90b45f8f2469a9c85eb3fce2ff8ef1c2d96b75962d04a64f.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Pretighten it by 2 to 3 threads first. After installation, turn crankshaft to run accessory drive belt by several turns, and check if crankshaft turns smoothly and belt runs well. If it cannot turn smoothly, reinstall accessory drive belt. Make sure to correctly install accessory drive belt, and it does not interfere with other components. 1. Install the idler pulley assembly fixing bolt. Torque: 47 ± 5 N•m 2. Install the accessory drive belt. 3. Install the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing tensioner assembly. Appropriate force should be applied, when removing the tensioner assembly. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Remove the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19). 5. Remove 3 fixing bolts from tensioner assembly.
>
> ![](images/66ef546a2f208a8e861ba1ece0fa30d68a70677453a7730ac89a9e07bf98711f.webp)
>
> 6. Remove the tensioner assembly.

### Installation

1. Install 3 tensioner assembly fixing bolts.   
Torque: 20 ± 5 N•m   
2. Install the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19).   
3. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
4. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

### Cylinder Head Cover

Removal Warning:

Blow dirt and debris away from surface of cylinder head cover with compressed air. Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing cylinder head cover. Appropriate force should be applied when removing cylinder head cover. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch. 23. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. Remove the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 5. Remove the turbocharger heat insulator bracket. 6. Remove 2 fixing bolts and engine hood cover bracket.

![](images/61a328068bae9bfbf11ba72cb967ab74bb16f3a93fb7140bc5e36009063bd361.webp)

7. Disconnect ignition coil connector (1), VVT control valve connector (2), camshaft position sensor connector (3).

8. Remove inlet pipe III from cylinder head cover.

![](images/3f0a660a754a3004914f5532493be71b7d6478d43d80db195a0121fecc7f6d81.webp)

9. Loosen the clamp and disconnect connection between hose and cylinder head cover.

10. Loosen elastic clamp and disconnect connection between crankcase ventilation hose and cylinder head cover.

![](images/80624faefe105bd37c4986d00a02896d193eb12563920606f0255aa996779d99.webp)

11. Remove 8 fixing bolts and ignition coil.   
12. Remove 2 fixing bolts and camshaft position sensor.

13. Remove 2 fixing bolts and expansion tank inlet pipe.

![](images/066d724152a928a149fa34155f735003d60b8797cb6e076a4dcf41df4f8a933c.webp)

14. Remove the cooling pipe assembly.   
15. Remove 1 fixing bolt from heat insulator.

16. Remove 16 fixing bolts cylinder and cylinder head cover.

![](images/a9233bdec21ac57b4230abd11f9d312cd8ea69be0253267af038a65f475f24b1.webp)

17. Remove fuel filler cap (1) and cylinder head cover gasket (2) from cylinder head cover assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Remove oil and seal gum on cylinder head cover and cylinder head before installation.   
> Check if gasket is damaged or loses elasticity. If so, replace gasket.
>
> 1. As shown in illustration, apply seal gum (Loctite 5900H) to "T" position of junction area between timing chain cover and cylinder head.

### Hint:

Pay attention that seal gum should not be applied too thick, to prevent excessive seal gum entering into inside of engine when press fitting the cylinder head cover.   
Install cylinder head cover assembly 15 minutes elapse after applying seal gum. Diameter of seal gum line: 2.5 - 5 mm.

![](images/c092bd78fa897ace24b98ec28c381a5082c101529b588a7f549878eea01eecc2.webp)

2. Install cylinder head cover and manually install bolts by 4 to 2 threads.

3. Tighten 16 cylinder head cover fixing bolts in order shown in illustration.

Torque: Pretighten shock absorber unit by 1 to 2 threads manually then tighten it with torque of 8 + 3 N·m

![](images/db939808236084a74ad12c5b1d42da72d28a6b9b94846c1e7381d20d829a67d2.webp)

4. Install the cooling pipe assembly.   
5. Install the expansion tank inlet pipe.   
6. Install the camshaft position sensor.   
7. Install the ignition coil.   
8. Install the crankshaft ventilation tube.   
9. Install the inlet pipe III.   
10. Connect ignition coil connector and VVT control valve connector and camshaft position sensor   
connector.   
11. Install the turbocharger heat Insulator bracket.   
12. Install the engine hood cover bracket.   
13. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
14. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

### Removal Warning:

Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing crankshaft front oil seal. Appropriate force should be applied when removing crankshaft front oil seal. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 5. Remove the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19).

6. Remove fixing bolt from torsion absorber.

### Hint:

Use tool to lock torsion absorber and fixing bolt.

![](images/27ebd745e293b497559aaafc43236cb34a1b16b149881c73cce9928712540dc6.webp)

7. Remove the torsion shock absorber.

8. Carefully remove the crankshaft front oil seal with proper tool.

### Hint:

Be careful not to scratch junction surface, when removing crankshaft front oil seal.

![](images/8ab8f068fd70821c1faa5eea0dcaf92a08f4250ea0d92a27240e6667460aae10.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Apply a small amount of engine oil to the crankshaft front oil seal guide tool before installing a new oil seal.   
> Remove dirt on junction surface and apply a small amount of engine oil to oil seal external circular surface and oil seal guide tool (except the oil seal with surface applied wax) before assembly. Be sure to prevent the lip of crankshaft front oil seal from being scratched during installation. If it is damaged, replace it immediately.
>
> 1. Install crankshaft front oil seal (3) to crankshaft front oil seal installer (2), then install crankshaft front oil seal in place with crankshaft front oil seal guide tool (1).

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Make sure oil seal surface is 0 to 0.5 mm lower than end surface of timing chain cover oil seal hole. Never allow tilting it by more than 5°, oil seal external rubber breakage or flanges during oil seal press fitting.
>
> ![](images/d973830f6fc4bd862c125d17921e8425ced9550c062b6fe9198ab2a9fbd4d1df.webp)
>
> 2. Install fixing bolt to torsion absorber.   
> Torque: 1st step: 180 ± 10 N·m 2nd step: 150° ± 5°   
> 3. Install the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19).   
> 4. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
> 5. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

### Crankshaft Rear Oil Seal

Removal Warning:

Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing crankshaft rear oil seal. Appropriate force should be applied when removing crankshaft rear oil seal. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 4. Remove the engine trim cover. 5. Remove the transmission assembly. 6. Remove the flywheel assembly.

7. Remove the crankshaft rear oil seal with proper tool.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be careful not to scratch cylinder block, when removing oil seal.
>
> ![](images/4961d4a5b6486246b38cbb2f79f33d550b48b54b461c11647d2130e01873c772.webp)
>
> 8. Remove the crankshaft rear oil seal.
>
> Installation Caution:
>
> Be sure to clean dirt around oil seal retainer and on inside wall before installation.   
> Check oil seal for damage before installation. If there is any damage, replace it.   
> Be sure to prevent the lip of crankshaft rear oil seal from being scratched during installation.   
> Be careful not to damage oil seal retainer during installation.
>
> 1. Install guide tool (1) to crankshaft.
>
> 2. Install new oil seal (2) to crankshaft rear oil seal guide tool, then install new oil seal evenly and fully into oil seal retainer with a crankshaft rear oil seal installer (3).

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Make sure oil seal surface is 0.5 to 1 mm lower than end surface of timing chain cover oil seal hole.   
> Ensure that oil seal lip has no damage during   
> assembly.   
> Never allow tilting it by more than 5°, oil seal external rubber breakage or flanges during oil seal press fitting.
>
> ![](images/947a07a5541125cffc0355debbb16026734ab7e4141a64f9a8748fe9851f1643.webp)
>
> 3. Install the flywheel assembly.   
> 4. Install the transmission assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when installing flywheel assembly. Appropriate force should be applied, when removing flywheel assembly. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 4. Remove the transmission assembly. 5. Install flywheel holding tool to lock flywheel assembly.
>
> 6. Remove 6 fixing bolts and flywheel assembly. Caution: Flywheel fixing bolts must be disposed after removal. Never reuse them.
>
> ![](images/ea08b75e2e28a8fa835cefec43d4dbf38e0c8a1191ad56e5cff22cd0b1ee2221.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Lightly push flywheel after alignment during assembly. Do not tap flywheel with a hammer. Replace flywheel fixing bolts with new ones. 1. Install 6 fixing bolts to flywheel assembly, and pretighten the bolts. 2. Installing flywheel holding tool, then tighten each flywheel bolt diagonally in order.
>
> Torque: 1st step: 35 ± 5 N·m 2nd step: 30° ± 5°

### Engine Timing Chain

### Removal Warning:

Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing engine timing chain. Appropriate force should be applied when removing engine timing chain. Be careful not to operate roughly.

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch.

2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

3. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

4. Remove the engine trim cover assembly.

5. Remove the cylinder head cover (See page 07-27).

Use an engine equalizer to hang lifting eye of engine when supporting the engine oil pan with jack.   
Avoid engine tilting to right side for easy removal of engine right mounting cushion assembly.

12. Remove the engine right mounting cushion.

14. Remove crankshaft balancer locating hole fixing bolt from engine block.

> 17. Disconnect variable oil pump connector and detach wire harness fixing clip.

>
> 18. Remove the oil pan assembly.
>
> 19. Remove the oil dipstick guide.

> 20. Remove 19 fixing bolts and cylinder head cover.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Carefully observe sprocket head cover for cracks or oil leakage. If exists, replace sprocket head cover assembly.

> ![](images/efd524eb7c52406b39253bfaae384ab9ae729f80b4b7d601d1f72f8b83b13f13.webp)
>
> 21. Remove 2 fixing bolts and hydraulic tensioner assembly.

> ![](images/e73f1e9482a2d54496c1b2a4446ca15faf519221c2512ad7cb66f88f3eaa533b.webp)
>
> 22. Remove 1 fixing bolt and movable guide rail assembly.
>
> 23. Remove 2 fixing bolts and fixing guide rail assembly.
>
> 24. Remove 2 fixing bolts and upper chain guide rail assembly.
>
> ![](images/1d7881614b224e9fa0697b7eaba201ce0fc9a4928fce387a17da3f527915829e.webp)![](images/561254fd28dfcf59ed665d4cb583d17dc2bf896d026b4fe5c8d2879c54b35976.webp)
>
> 25. Remove the engine timing chain.   
> 26. Remove 1 fixing bolt from oil pump chain movable guide rail and remove oil pump chain.

### Installation

Use a proper wrench to hold intake camshaft and loosen fixing bolt from intake phaser assembly.

2. Install oil pump chain and 1 movable guide rail fixing bolt.

Torque: 12 ± 2N•m

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> The movable guide rail should rotate smoothly around the bolt after assembling and either end of spring should hook the oil pump housing.
>
> ![](images/e2b831198b8d5d76f473e97fdb447c365f85e21130abd71431e3a7f6b0a51bb3.webp)
>
> 3. Install 2 fixing bolts to upper chain guide rail assembly.
>
> Torque: 8 ± 3N•m
>
> 4. Install 2 fixing bolts from fixing guide rail assembly.
>
> Torque: 8 ± 3N•m
>
> 5. Install 1 fixing bolt to movable guide rail assembly.
>
> Torque: 20 ± 5 N•m

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> The movable guide rail should rotate smoothly around the bolt after installation.
>
> 6. Install the timing chain.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Ensure timing chain is set to intake and exhaust phasers and crankshaft sprocket. Make sure that timing chain and upper guide rail are in level.
>
> 7. Install hydraulic tensioner assembly, and tighten 2 fixing bolts.
>
> Torque: 8 ± 3N•m
>
> Caution: Pull up hydraulic tensioner upper steal ring pin after installation and tightening.
>
> 8. Use a proper wrench to hold intake camshaft and tighten fixing bolt of intake phaser assembly.
>
> Torque: 1st step: 60 ± 3 N·m 2nd step: clockwise rotation angle 95° ± 5°

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Tighten exhaust phaser fixing bolt first, and then tighten intake phaser fixing bolt. Failure to tighten in order may cause "tooth missing" phenomenon in timing chain.
>
> ![](images/ae4359fc305f5856d856080bcfb2d0dce68a5a997b5c44ae075366c99dc9b150.webp)
>
> 9. Remove crankshaft timing tool and camshaft timing tool, then rotate crankshaft clockwise 2 turns at least to check if timing system can operate normally.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Never rotate crankshaft counterclockwise.
>
> 10. Apply seal gum to inside of timing chain cover mounting bolt hole.
>
> ![](images/03fa74508fb85f3994be31bc637a56779b7c652dda8b0d1f8acb1ccea85e43e6.webp)

### Seal gum: Loctite 5900H

11. Install and tighten 19 cylinder head cover fixing bolts in order shown in illustration.

Torque: 8 ± 3 N•m

![](images/6aa3affb2f98d5a7755310bd84311e84db3badb55a76759947a31a502a5d5772.webp)

12. Install 3 fixing bolts to engine front end bracket.   
Torque: 80 ± 5 N•m   
13. Install the oil dipstick guide.   
14. Connect variable oil pump connector and secure wire harness clip.   
15. Install the crankshaft balancer positioning hole fixing bolt.   
16. Install the torsion shock absorber.   
17. Install the idler pulley assembly.   
18. Install the tensioner assembly (See page 07-27).   
19. Install the engine accessory belt.   
20. Install the cylinder head cover (See page 07-27).   
21. Install the front compartment lower protector assembly.   
22. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
23. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Adjust timing before installing camshaft. When installing intake and exhaust phaser assemblies, tighten bolts on exhaust side first, and then tighten bolts on intake side. 12. Clean intake and exhaust camshafts and camshaft bearing caps. Apply engine oil to camshaft cam surface and add a proper amount of engine oil to camshaft bearing hole.
>
> 3. Install intake, exhaust camshaft assemblies and intake and exhaust camshaft bearing caps.

### Hint:

Install according to marks on bearing cap: "I" indicates intake camshaft bearing cap and "E" indicates exhaust camshaft bearing cap.

![](images/2504d631e78b8eebf8ffa410f4ecca882c633b25fc7abadd504dfbb8d87094bf.webp)

4. Tighten the camshaft bearing cap fixing bolt manually then tighten camshaft bearing cap fixing bolt. Torque: For the 1st bearing cap bolt 20 + 3 N·m, for bearing cap bolt 8 + 3 N·m

![](images/b22825d07264432e6fa65aa0864dac769ffb74b3630c2d31a83e82144b918651.webp)

5. Install the engine timing chain.   
6. Install the accessory drive belt (See page 06-19).   
7. Install the cylinder head cover (See page 07-27).   
8. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
9. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

### Cylinder Head

![](images/4533f4f865dbbd6faed7c09b6b623f5aa8c7b7b88b9a279dad476e6a2aa4295a.webp)

K10060

★: Non-reusable Parts   
![](images/5278dea36741cb1050af4bf5aa002a067fb9f56f9333c525310e192c46872959.webp)

### Removal Warning:

Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing cylinder cover. Appropriate force should be applied when removing cylinder cover. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly.

4. Drain the engine oil   
5. Drain the coolant.   
6. Remove the battery assembly.   
7. Remove the battery tray assembly.   
8. Remove the intake hose assembly.   
9. Remove the air filter assembly   
10. Remove the cooling pipe assembly.   
11. Remove the intake manifold assembly.   
12. Remove the fuel rail injector assembly.   
13. Remove the main catalytic converter.   
14. Remove the turbocharger assembly.   
15. Remove the accessory belt.   
16. Remove the tensioner assembly (See page 07-27).   
17. Remove the idler pulley assembly.   
18. Remove the cylinder head cover (See page 07-27).   
19. Remove the engine timing chain.   
20. Remove camshaft and rocker arm.

21. Remove 10 fixing bolts from cylinder cover in order shown in illustration.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When engine is in high temperature, removal and installation may cause deformation to cylinder head, so perform removal and installation at normal   
> temperature.   
> Failure to remove cylinder head fixing bolts in order may cause cylinder head fixing bolt deformation. Make scraping marks on removed bolts and gasket, and they cannot be reused.
>
> ![](images/a437896d4272f38e05ddab1236d9abe160cf0f56011ac103d2a5bc3a01ae6dab.webp)
>
> 22. Remove cylinder head and cylinder head gasket.

### Disassembly

Remove 2 fixing bolts and intake and exhaust phaser oil control valve.

![](images/035fddb9197a738fbece8c8e973f39b90dc71df5364da6eb51eb20d48b1bca9d.webp)

2. Remove 2 fixing bolts and lifting eyes.

3. Using a valve spring compressor, compress valve spring to a position so that valve cotter can be removed.

4. Using a magnetic rod, remove valve cotter.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Due to the valve cotter is small, please operate carefully when removing it to avoid loss.
>
> ![](images/7abd7878c29b04d996dad164c9ec699df2610a263eb1eecd8b0f0eef1abcbfd1.webp)
>
> 5. Remove valve spring upper seat (1), valve spring (2) and intake and exhaust valves (3) from cylinder head.
>
> 6. Using a valve oil seal remover, remove the valve oil seal.
>
> ![](images/29eba4bff793ebe7ed7e365124e7f8edfbdd21aa95de6831701cacc728d138bd.webp)
>
> 7. Using a magnetic rod, remove valve spring lower seat.
>
> Assembly Caution:
>
> Soak valve oil seal in oil for several minutes before installing valve oil seal. Before installing valve spring, check valve spring lower seat for proper installation. Clean all components to be assembled thoroughly before assembly. 1. Install valve spring lower seat to valve guide end to fit it with cylinder head.
>
> 2. Install valve oil seal to valve oil seal special tool and press it on valve guide. Tap the tool end with a hammer to press in oil seal.
>
> 3. Clean valve surface, install exhaust valve into cylinder head guide hole.

### Hint:

Slightly rotate valve collar until valve conical face fully contacts retainer conical face.

![](images/adcb4d6b49122344f3092e2086961713702d7d0b9c3e1315ebecb7ed5d8961d0.webp)

4. Install valve cotter (1) to valve cotter installer (2).

![](images/ceb6c5ba70467c94367cdf15f6c98d6bcc998bcea8bf55385379c54f82ae6057.webp)

Installation Caution:

DO NOT damage or lose dowel pin on cylinder block. Remove residual seal gum and oil on cylinder head and cylinder block. Replace the cylinder head gasket. Check that cylinder head gasket is neat and clean without any chips and scratches, and the side stamped with part number faces upward. Install cylinder head gasket to flat surface of cylinder block with a dowel pin. Clean junction surface between cylinder head and combustion chamber, and remove any accumulated oil at bottom of cylinder block thread hole. During installation, piston should not be located at the top dead center, in order to prevent it from being impacted by opening valve, when installing the camshaft. Replace cylinder head fixing bolt, and make scraping marks on removed bolt. 1. Tighten bolts in place by hands. 2. 1st step: Tighten bolts to 35 ± 5 N·m in order from (1) to (10) shown in illustration. 3. 2nd step: Rotate bolts clockwise by 90 ± 5° in tightening order.

4. 3rd step: Rotate bolts clockwise by 90 ± 5° in tightening order again.

![](images/d06661889942f7342c1f599a97ec874811d66c536394a1c066ee9d4d73b5b043.webp)

5. Install the camshaft and rocker arm.   
6. Install the engine timing chain.   
7. Install the cylinder head cover (See page 07-27).   
8. Install the idler pulley assembly.   
9. Install the tensioner assembly (See page 07-27).   
10. Install the accessory belt.   
11. Install the turbocharger assembly.   
12. Install the precatalytic converter assembly.   
13. Install the fuel rail injector assembly.   
14. Install the intake manifold assembly.   
15. Install the cooling pipe assembly.   
16. Install the intake hose assembly.   
17. Install the battery tray.   
18. Install the battery assembly.   
19. Install the air filter assembly.   
20. Add the coolant as specified.   
21. Add the engine oil as specified.   
22. Install the engine trim cover assembly.   
23. Install the engine compartment trim cover assembly.

### Cylinder Block Unit

![](images/8a7060da775abbff3f27519c09b0f9f946bd02b9cd2f392187c8d2346e61b2fc.webp)

### ★: Non-reusable Parts

K10040

![](images/0f3a2d9f959767710c9732993073436ca2dc51261b10107f2f09d709675b3351.webp)

### Removal

1. Remove engine assembly from vehicle body.   
2. Separate transmission from engine.   
3. Remove the flywheel assembly.   
4. Remove the turbocharger assembly.   
5. Remove the turbocharger inlet pipe.   
6. Remove the turbocharger oil return pipe.   
7. Remove the electric water pump.   
8. Remove the intake manifold assembly.   
9. Remove the engine accessory belt.   
10. Remove the idler pulley assembly.   
11. Remove the tensioner assembly (See page 07-27).   
12. Remove the torsion shock absorber.   
13. Remove the timing chain cover.   
14. Remove the alternator assembly (See page 25-14).   
15. Remove the water pump module assembly.   
16. Remove the oil filter module assembly.   
17. Remove the A/C compressor bracket.   
18. Remove the engine timing chain.   
19. Remove the cylinder head assembly.   
20. Remove the oil pan assembly.   
21. Remove the oil deflector.   
22. Remove the oil pump chain.   
23. Remove the variable oil pump.   
24. Remove the knock sensor fixing bolt and remove the   
knock sensor.

25. Turn crankshaft, so that pistons of cylinders 1 and 4 are at bottom dead center, remove fixing bolts from connecting rod bearing caps of cylinders 1 and 4, and remove connecting rod bearing caps of cylinders 1 and 4.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Removal procedures of cylinders 2 and 3 are the same as cylinders 1 and 4.
>
> ![](images/516126450174d503f5eff9fd93850c2d06570d0ff4e62bd36affefe711a972e5.webp)
>
> 26. Using a hammer handle, push out piston connecting rod assembly from cylinder block.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Please operate carefully when pushing out piston, to avoid cylinder liner damage.   
> Mark the removed piston connecting rod assemblies, so as to distinguish them.   
> Connecting rod bolts and connecting rod bolt holes must correspond one to one without exchange.   
> Replace with new bolts during assembly.
>
> 27. Push out bearing upper shell slightly in direction of arrow to remove it.
>
> 28. Push out bearing lower shell slightly from connecting rod bearing cap in direction of arrow to remove it.
>
> ![](images/b3f049007576649375d5b86c57975579cd9c5857ebe296fb0fe14e7d8dcbd238.webp)
>
> 29. Using a piston ring remover, remove first compression ring and second compression ring.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Before removing piston ring, check piston ring side clearance. If it is necessary to be reused, be sure to mark piston ring position.
>
> 30. Remove oil ring rail and expander.
>
> 31. Using a flat tip screwdriver, pry out elastic circlips at both sides of piston pin carefully from notch. Carefully pry out elastic circlips on both ends of piston pin.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Elastic circlip has a large tensile force. Be careful during removal to prevent personal injury.
>
> ![](images/575e701489453e63b27308262c9db83e21ab55061d989bcf77125eac95a49cab.webp)
>
> 32. Remove the piston pin assembly.
>
> 33. Remove 10 fixing bolts from crankshaft frame in order shown in illustration.
>
> ![](images/385a42a5c65cf2fd7b4e4c886b1307505209432ffddeff7c3ecbf86312a4f32c.webp)
>
> 34. Remove 10 fixing bolts from crankshaft main bearing cap in order as shown in illustration.
>
> ![](images/b2cec78bf98f6ce46a3b1fd74594f7cc0d22f59ab6653c39f6b062f35090f0f1.webp)
>
> 35. Remove the crankshaft frame.
>
> Caution: When removing the crankshaft frame, be sure not to damage surrounding components.
>
> 36. Remove the crankshaft assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Take care when removing crankshaft, ask other operators to assist when necessary. Avoid scratching contact surfaces between crankshaft and bearing shell.
>
> 37. Remove crankshaft thrust washers from cylinder block.
>
> 38. Push out crankshaft main bearing upper shell slightly from cylinder block in direction of arrow to remove it.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Pay attention to the notch position. Push out bearing shell carefully. It is difficult to push out bearing shell and parts may be damaged if pushing in opposite direction.
>
> ![](images/b10ec562076e4390be30b37334dc199829638836b383bd2bc1ffed2b20c9425b.webp)
>
> 39. Remove crankshaft main bearing lower shell from frame slightly in the direction of arrow.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Pay attention to the notch position. Push out bearing shell carefully. It is difficult to push out bearing shell and parts may be damaged if pushing in opposite direction.
>
> 40. Remove 4 fixing bolts and piston cooling nozzles.
>
> ![](images/63750ac5792d418e250cf6a56e8b9b94855616729977ecca903de3cfb0b32dd1.webp)

### Installation

1. Install 4 fixing bolts to piston cooling nozzles. Torque: 6 - 8 N•m   
2. Carefully install crankshaft main bearing upper shell (1) in direction of arrow, and notch of each main bearing upper shell should be aligned with cylinder block. Oil passage hole (2) on crankshaft main bearing upper shell should be aligned with passage hole on cylinder block after installation.

![](images/dd0d14a9168990695cfa735208419ffda31cbb77343e42fdc390a91b5147a775.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Apply a proper amount of engine oil to inner surface of main bearing shell before installation.   
> Install crankshaft main bearing lower shell in the same way of crankshaft main bearing upper shell.
>
> 3. Install crankshaft thrust washer to front and rear thrust surfaces of 3rd main bearing seat respectively.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> The side of crankshaft thrust washers (1) without groove should face cylinder block side while the other side with groove should face crankshaft side.
>
> 4. Apply seal gum to installation surface of crankshaft frame.
>
> Seal gum: Loctite 5900H
>
> Diameter of seal gum line: 2.5 - 3.5 mm

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> ![](images/dbca9976bdd3ed52de0d0004fe0629379c27bd0967a3bd3d11567b09e89064ea.webp)
>
> DO NOT apply seal gum to bearing shell when   
> applying seal gum.   
> Seal gum should not be applied too thick. Avoid seal gum entering bearing shell installation area due to compression.
>
> 5. Place crankshaft on cylinder block carefully.
>
> 6. Install crankshaft main bearing cap fixing bolts in place by hands, and then tighten 10 crankshaft main bearing cap fixing bolts in order shown in illustration.
>
> Torque: 1st step: 35 ± 5 N·m 2nd step: 120 C ± 15
>
> 7. Evenly tighten 10 fixing bolts in order shown in illustration.
>
> Torque: 25 ± 5 N•m
>
> ![](images/f66eb2c0bf558e232a1e3d7fce4059db4b86064827040c628f4557da5e7f8e76.webp)
>
> 8. Using a small screwdriver, install new elastic circlip to one end of piston pin hole.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Relative angle between elastic circlip opening and removed notch is 180° ± 40°.
>
> 9. Align front marks on piston and connecting rod, push piston pin with thumb until it contacts with elastic circlip.
>
> 10. Install elastic circlip to the other end of piston pin hole, and check for free rotation between piston and connecting rod assembly.
>
> ![](images/d89122fa7be18f0356d8393fa54338c2d013f57cb00763b11f57524120fe54d0.webp)
>
> 11. Apply a small amount of engine oil to piston ring groove and piston. Pay attention that the sides with words of first compression ring (1) and second compression ring (2) should face upward.
>
> 12. When installing the oil ring, first install the expander into oil groove, then install upper and lower rails with opening staggered by 90° from the expander closed gap, and the upper and lower rails at 180°. Then install the second compression ring, and install the first compression ring finally with two compression rings staggered by 90° from upper rail opening. The piston ring should rotate in the ring groove freely without any stuck condition.
>
> 13. Rotate piston ring several turns after addling engine oil to piston ring groove, and note that the position of ring notch should be the same with that described above; clean crankshaft connecting rod journal and cylinder with a non-woven fabric cloth.
>
> 14. Carefully install the connecting rod bearing upper shell in direction of arrow, and keep notch of each connecting rod bearing upper shell face the cutout of connecting rod bearing.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Apply a proper amount of engine oil to connecting rod bearing shell inner surface before installation.
>
> ![](images/51434b1a6bf3851d7ab6c331b1defdf4196a98ef20962385896450ff79d6edbc.webp)
>
> 15. Carefully install connecting rod bearing lower shell in direction of arrow, and keep notch of each connecting rod bearing lower shell face the cutout of connecting rod bearing cap.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Back side of connecting rod bearing shell should be clean without any foreign matter during assembly.
>
> 16. Rotate crankshaft to top dead center of cylinder 1 and cylinder 4.
>
> 17. Apply a coat of engine oil to piston surface and cylinder inner wall.
>
> 18. As shown in illustration, install piston connecting rod assembly to cylinder with piston installer. Pay attention to front marks on piston and connecting rod during assembly, without being reversed.
>
> 19. Install the connecting rod bearing cap.
>
> ![](images/416b285ec520ee5a84498997ad69dde12c64ed717b53c3ad1f8883e5315435ce.webp)
>
> 20. Install connecting rod bearing caps in place, and install connecting rod bearing cap fixing bolts in 2 steps.
>
> Torque: 1st step: 20 - 25 N·m 2nd step: 85° ± 5° Caution:
>
> Apply a small amount of engine lubricant to connecting rods, connecting rod bearing caps and thread joint surfaces.
>
> ![](images/7d96df8745227a0c559b69c6925c326a8234f2b19cf1652646678f25a789e4db.webp)
>
> 21. Install the knock sensor.   
> 22. Install the oil pump assembly.   
> 23. Install the oil pump chain.   
> 24. Install the oil deflector.   
> 25. Install the oil pan assembly.   
> 26. Install the cylinder cover assembly.   
> 27. Install the engine timing chain.   
> 28. Install the A/C compressor bracket.   
> 29. Install the oil filter module assembly.   
> 30. Install the water pump module.   
> 31. Install the alternator assembly (See page 25-14).   
> 32. Install the timing chain cover   
> 33. Install the torsion shock absorber.   
> 34. Install the tensioner assembly (See page 07-27).   
> 35. Install the idler pulley assembly.   
> 36. Install the engine accessory belt.   
> 37. Install the intake manifold assembly.   
> 38. Install the intake manifold assembly.   
> 39. Install the turbocharger oil return pipe.   
> 40. Install the turbocharger inlet pipe.   
> 41. Install the turbocharger assembly.   
> 42. Install the flywheel assembly.   
> 43. Install the transmission assembly.   
> 44. Install the engine assembly to vehicle body.

### Engine Assembly

![](images/ae05aeff3a716eedf3de47675e8a8110dae6e40f8b5b77712f402e3e29f73f5c.webp)

### Removal Warning:

Remove engine and transmission as an assembly. Install protector to prevent body from being scratched. Plug inlet port of intake pipe to prevent foreign matter from entering after removing intake system components. Or the foreign matter will block cylinder intake passage when starting to seriously damage the engine. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Remove the engine compartment trim cover assembly. 3. Remove the engine trim cover assembly. 4. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 5. Drain the coolant. 6. Recover/Drain the refrigerant. 7. Drain the transmission oil. 8. Remove the air filter assembly 9. Remove the intake hose assembly. 10. Remove the battery assembly. 11. Remove the battery tray. 12. Remove the engine compartment lower protector assembly. 13. Remove the compartment lower protector assembly III. 14. Remove the intercooler outlet pipe assembly II. 15. Remove the intercooler outlet pipe assembly 16. Remove the front wheel tire. 17. Remove the left/right side rail welding.

18. Remove the front left drive shaft assembly.   
19. Remove the front right drive shaft with bearing bracket assembly.   
20. Disconnect oxygen sensor and remove the precatalytic converter assembly.

21. Remove the front sub frame welding assembly.

22. Loosen elastic clamps and disconnect engine inlet pipe connections.

23. Disconnect the compressor evaporator pipe line and disconnect condenser compressor pipe line.

24. Loosen elastic clamps and disconnect engine outlet pipe connection.

![](images/7239c2c3f144e4d2236b09c8dcfdfb0f2069dfe70af5478a746399e842ad4198.webp)

25. Loosen elastic clamps and disconnect vacuum pipe connection.

26. Loosen elastic clamps and disconnect heater outlet and inlet pipe connection.

27. Disconnect the inlet pipe II connection.

![](images/260f1864f66276c298c0b9c7b4f165e46e92ee63e30a37df72ebb55ebd744795.webp)

28. Disconnect the fuel vapor pipe Ⅴ connection.

29. Loosen elastic clamp and disconnect connection between expansion tank and water supply pipe.   
30. Loosen elastic clamp and disconnect connection between hose and expansion tank.

![](images/b11530dbacc2015df5d70e35488dd5faed546c3eef2752744a34ad843b7f1632.webp)

31. Loosen 2 fixing nuts between positive battery wire harness and engine compartment fuse and relay box and disconnect wire harness.

32. Disconnect connector between positive battery wire harness and engine electronic fuel injection wire harness.

33. Disconnect the TCU connector.

34. Disconnect fixing nut and move away the ground wire.

![](images/4a9a5e4ee9bc5b16496b6d1bbde1adb87f0ba1f3eae95588ddb71f5e03727540.webp)

35. Disconnect ECU connector (1), and disconnect connector (2) between electronic engine injection wire harness and exterior wire harness, remove ground wire harness fixing nut (3) and move away ground wire harness.

36. Remove 2 fixing nuts and 1 fixing bolt from left mounting cushion.

37. Remove 2 fixing nuts and 1 fixing bolt from right mounting cushion.

![](images/df856365b3d49373f783740dbeef6c1b397cdff5dc4a1d7ba2a6fcd843ef1bf0.webp)

38. Check that engine assembly is separated with external components.   
39. Remove engine and transmission assembly.   
40. Remove electronic engine injection wire harness and positive battery wire harness from engine assembly.   
41. Separate connection between engine assembly and transmission assembly.   
42. Install engine assembly to engine service platform.   
Installation   
1. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

### Operation

Fuel supply system consists of fuel tank, electric fuel pump assembly, delivery pipes, fuel rail and injectors, which is used for fuel storage, filtration, delivery and injection. The function of fuel supply system is to provide gasoline with sufficient pressure to fuel injectors by using electric fuel pump assembly, and the injector sprays a certain amount of gasoline which burnt mixed with gas to the top of intake valve in intake manifold in accordance with control signals from ECU.

### Fuel Supply System Line Connection Diagram

![](images/d9f2918fdc66b9dedf718d2f2ea82792511ab4e17d122b682f580398b653335b.webp)

![](images/f3f677cc5cf6df7622d84052d70eb4d6614e13cd988a218a615760b6536b55a6.webp)

When engine operates properly, the electric fuel pump assembly (1) sucks fuel from fuel tank. Some fuel enters the fuel rail (3) and is supplied to injectors, some fuel flows back to the electric fuel pump assembly pressure regulator (2) directly. When fuel supply system pressure is high, the diaphragm spring in the regulator is jacked up by pressure, then the valve opens and fuel flows out from regulator. When pressure reaches normal value, the regulator shuts off and fuel stops flowing out. Finally, the system pressure reaches a steady state.

### Hint:

![](images/b7c67ca7768f39a17ed81701b22d07fb2f59b57f01d24d8529830f94b8bf157d.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When engine is not operating, the fuel pressure in fuel supply system is still high. Before repairing or disconnecting the fuel line or fuel supply system components, it is necessary to release the fuel supply system pressure to prevent fuel from spraying out accidentally. Failure to follow these instructions may result in serious personal injury.
>
> Perform the following procedures to release the fuel pressure in fuel supply system:
>
> (a) Recognize and remove the electric fuel pump assembly relay from engine compartment fuse and relay box.   
> (cb) Start and run the engine until it stalls. Restart the engine until it does not run.   
> (d) Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch.   
> (e) Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
> (f) Insert the electric fuel pump relay into the original place.

### Fuel Supply System Pressure Test

Fuel Pressure Specifications

![](images/a5036a4130096a04eb231a782c24dc16c845c08f2fdd70cdd68005ef66aa775b.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Make sure that battery voltage is not less than 12V. There is sufficient fuel in fuel tank for test. Make sure that fuel supply system lines are securely connected, preventing the fuel supply system from leaking.   
> 1. Detect the fuel system pressure.   
> 2. Remove the engine trim cover.   
> 3. Disconnect the inlet pipe II connector and connect the fuel supply system pressure tester between inlet pipe II and fuel rail.
>
> ![](images/ead5f97de60bde3f2d5fef31deb9c431980e010722bbfcec16e464c9470f7c4d.webp)
>
> 4. Start engine and run it at idle, and then read the value on pressure tester.
>
> (a) Standard pressure at idle should be 400 kPa.   
> (b) If measured pressure value is lower than 380 kPa or higher than 420 kPa, check vehicle fuel supply line for leakage or kink, injector for blockage, function of electric fuel pump for abnormality. Hint: Replace injector or electric fuel pump assembly if necessary.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When fuel pressure is in normal during idling, the test of fuel flow can be performed.
>
> 1. Test method:
>
> (a) Disconnect the inlet pipe II connector and connect the fuel supply system pressure tester between inlet pipe II and fuel rail.
>
> ![](images/4f6a9786c927b6f0692917d533a5bfeb680dc3e20bde8593da6870a7d5fdf7b5.webp)
>
> (b) Start engine, increase engine speed (such as throttle fully opens), if the pressure of pressure gauge is lower than 0.1 Mpa (100 kPa) of system pressure, flow is insufficient.
>
> (c) If flow is insufficient, line blockage or bend, fuel pump wear or mesh blockage may be the problem cause.

### Hint:

Replace the electric fuel pump first if necessary. If line is blocked or bent, check, repair or replace it and retest flow, if it is eligible, the problem is eliminated. If it is ineligible, replace fuel pump and wash impurities in fuel tank.

### Inspection

1. Check the resistance of injector.

(a) Measure resistance between 2 terminals (injector side) of injector with a digital multimeter.

![](images/5f22fd2c88ad83e1f0f215eb31a2a68e3d1499d7ce2dba1178287103a60c8232.webp)

![](images/52123ece7b5e04aacd45fb6096c7e787aba656b67b5cd7becc39d1c29bd2d974.webp)

2. Check leakage test and injection test of injector.

(a) Remove injector and then install the injector to injector cleaning analyzer, adjust the pressure to operation pressure, and observe the injector for leakage, if so, sealing is poor.

(b) If there is no cleaning analyzer, a free-unpick cleaning device also can be used, adjust pressure to 4 bar, and place a white paper under injector. Observe the injector for leakage Caution:

When installing injector, grease will be applied to sealing ring to install injector easily, if the part is in high temperature for a long time, grease will melt, and adsorb around injector, so it may be wrong when judging injector for leakage. It is recommended to clean around injector to check injector for leakage.

(c) If the color of one injector nozzle is different from the color of other injector nozzles, the injector may be leaked or have a poor atomization.

(d) Fuel injection angle

(1) Poor atomization: Fuel injected by injector is radial, and injection angle from injection nozzle is irregular.   
(2) Good atomization: Fuel injected from injector is fuel mist, and injection angle from injection nozzle is cone.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Install a new O-ring sealing on injector.   
> Before installing the injector, apply clean grease or oil to the O-ring sealing surface for easy installation, preventing damage to the O-ring.   
> When applying grease or oil, do not contaminate the injector internal and injection holes.   
> It is not allowed to use any tool (hammer, etc.) to strike the injector when installing it.

### Warnings

1. As the pressure of high pressure fuel system is high, the pressure must be released before removal.   
2. During removal, make sure the areas near stored parts are clean and free of dirt.   
3. Perform removal after engine cools down.   
4. Operation staff should wear protective glasses and rubber gloves during repair and avoid inhaling   
much fuel gas.

### Precautions

1. If fuel leakage occurs when operating the fuel supply system, please handle the leaked fuel in time. 2. When operating the fuel supply system, work area should be in good ventilation and keep fire sources or open flames away from the work area, in which fire extinguisher should be equipped.

### System Overview

System Components Diagram

![](images/b25d8a23a4559d83b6496f34769031b9a2d5d7ac143e07e15dc38c981cfe88f1.webp)

### ★: Non-reusable Parts

FU0000101

![](images/11f1d7eeb97fbfb55ac69bf06858a40d4fd51720f06f0208206fd25fbd98e5b6.webp)

Fuel supply system of SQRF4J16 engine uses direct injection in cylinder. The high pressure fuel pump is riven by square cam that is connected to intake camshaft.

The vehicle adopts a direct injection system with mainstream Bosch 4-hole nozzle and injection pressure of up to 200 bar, and also uses a side nozzle layout (i.e. Airflow guide injection).

The function of fuel supply system is to pump fuel to high pressure fuel pump by electric fuel pump assembly, so as to provide enough pressure of gasoline for the fuel injector through the pressure boosted by high pressure fuel pump. Injector sprays fuel which burnt mixed with gas to combustion chamber in accordance with control signals from ECU.

The high pressure fuel distribution pipe assembly is integrated with high pressure fuel distribution pipe (fuel rail), high pressure fuel injector and high pressure sensor. Its operation is to optimize design through structure of high pressure fuel distribution pipe, the accurate fuel rail pressure signal feedback can uniformly and precisely distribute fuel for engine through injector.

Roller tappet will transmit the movement of drive cam to high pressure fuel pump plunger base.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/4fd677acd41925941d6d179ebc83b99a3ec6c7a46bd10c0f155a06bb6b40065c.webp)

When engine operates properly, the electric fuel pump assembly sucks fuel from fuel tank, and then delivers it to high pressure fuel pump assembly; after the pressure is boosted by high pressure fuel pump, fuel will be supplied to injectors through the high pressure fuel pipe.

### Main Function

Electric fuel pump consists of pump body, DC motor and housing. Its basic operation principle is that DC motor drives the rotor in pump housing to rotate at high speed after it is energized. The section at lower end of rotor shaft combines with the section at the inner hole of impeller, so that rotor shaft drives impeller to rotate as rotor rotates. During high speed rotation of impeller, the low pressure vacuum is created at the inlet part, and then the filtered fuel is sucked from the inlet of pump cover. The sucked fuel enters the pump housing after being pressurized by fuel pump impeller and then it is pushed out of outlet to provide fuel with a certain pressure for the fuel system.

### Main Function

High pressure fuel pump is an element specially used for direct injection engine. It functions to increase the system pressure and provide high pressure fuel for the fuel rail assembly. High pressure fuel pump supplies fuel for system as demands, thus providing a better fuel economy. It is made of stainless steel material and has a wide fuel application; also, it has the advantages of light weight, small volume, zero evaporative emission, etc.

The high pressure fuel pump uses a single plunger pump design integrated with regulator, flow control valve and pressure relief valve. Its operation principle is to drive high pressure pump plunger to move up and down by cam, thus achieving oil suction and outlet. Using the pressure sensor on fuel rail, ECU controls the flow of high pressure fuel pump through flow control valve according to the set control procedure, so as to perform closed loop control of pressure in high pressure fuel rail. Regulator functions to suppress the pressure pulsation at the low pressure end and improve the stability of system. Pressure relief valve will open when high pressure fuel rail pressure exceeds the safety limit, so as to protect the system.

### Main Function

High pressure fuel pipe connects the high pressure fuel pump with the fuel rail injector assembly and delivers high pressure fuel to fuel rail injector assembly.

### Main Function

The high pressure fuel distribution pipe assembly is integrated with high pressure fuel distribution pipe (fuel rail), high pressure fuel injector and high pressure sensor. Its operation is to optimize design through structure of high pressure fuel distribution pipe, and the accurate rail pressure signal feedback can uniformly and precisely distribute fuel for engine through injector.

### Check the high pressure fuel pump.

21. Check if high pressure fuel pump connector is abnormal. Check resistance between both pins of high pressure fuel pump connector.   
3. Measure resistance of high pressure fuel pump solenoid valve coil.

![](images/b0e272696122fa0805cd6630f0952c0588f0af2e49fced85b11381b41d4be93f.webp)

### Check the fuel rail injector assembly.

1. Check if wire harness connector of fuel rail injector assembly is abnormal. 2. Check connecting area between fuel rail and fuel injector for fuel leakage, and check mounting hole of fuel injector for air leakage or fuel leakage. 3. Use ohm band of multimeter to measure resistance between both pins of injector.

Normal value: 1.5Ω ± 5% (23 ℃ )

### Check the fuel rail pressure sensor.

Use ohm band of multimeter to measure resistance among 3 pins of fuel rail pressure sensor (pay attention to the positive and negative orders).

![](images/f197eaa30247008abc63b05ddaa582a3578eace399374041e583ad35b234d33a.webp)

### Check the high pressure fuel pipe.

Check high pressure fuel pipe surface for fuel leakage signs, and check for looseness and fuel leakage in high pressure fuel pipe nuts on both sides.

### Check the roller tappet.

1. Check i appearance of roller tappet is complete, if wear is serious, and if roller bearing can rotate smoothly.   
2. Check if roller tappet diameter is obviously out of tolerance. If it is out of tolerance, replacement is recommended. Diameter: 26mm (-0.020, 0.055)

### Hint:

If above problems occur, replacing with a new roller tappet is recommended.

### High Pressure Fuel System Pressure Release

1. Method 1: Stop vehicle for 8 hours or more.

2. Method 2: Unplug high pressure fuel pump connector, and idle the engine for 10 seconds. In this case, the malfunction light on instrument cluster of vehicle will come on. After repair, connect high pressure fuel pump connector and operate it again for a period of time, then the fault will disappear.

### Low Pressure Fuel System Pressure Release Operation Step

1. Method 1: Turn ENGINE START STOP switch OFF and leave vehicle for 30 minutes.

2. Method 2: Turn ENGINE START STOP switch OFF, remove fuel pump relay, start engine and make it stop automatically in Idling condition, then start engine twice or three times again, and release pressure residuals from fuel pipe by starting injection.

### Installation Caution:

High pressure fuel pipe is a non-reusable part, never reassemble it for a secondary use. Before installing high pressure fuel pipe, make sure that the part model is correct, the sealing caps on both ends of high pressure fuel pipe are intact. Never use any high pressure fuel pipe without sealing cap. Do not use sharp tools during installation to avoid scratching high pressure fuel pipe joint. During installation of high pressure fuel pipe, pay attention to avoid collision with the fuel rail injector joint and end of high pressure fuel pump joint. Before installing high pressure fuel pipe, confirm if fixing bolts of fuel rail injector are tightened. If they are tightened completely, loosen them by 2-3 turns in sequence of cylinders 1-4-2-3, and then install the high pressure fuel pipe. 1. Unplug protective cap of high pressure fuel pipe, and tighten both ends of high pressure fuel pipe to high pressure fuel pump and fuel rail joint respectively by hand in correct direction, then use specific torque wrench to pre-tighten the high pressure fuel pipe nut to 20 + 2 N·m (the first tightening side is not specified). 2. Tighten mounting bolts of fuel rail injector to 25 ± 3 N·m in tightening sequence of 3-2-4-1. 3. Tighten high pressure fuel pipe nut to 30 ± 2 N·m

### Removal Warning:

As the pressure of high pressure fuel system is high, the pressure must be released before removal. Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents when repairing. During removal, make sure the areas near stored parts are clean and free of dirt. There is residual fuel in high pressure fuel pump. Please pay attention to the leakage of fuel during removal to avoid fire.   
• Perform removal after engine cools down.   
1. Release the high pressure fuel system pressure.   
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
3. Remove the engine trim cover.   
4. Remove the intake hose assembly.   
5. Remove high pressure fuel pump and roller tappet.   
6. Disconnect the high pressure fuel pump connector (arrow).

7. Disconnect connection between inlet pipe III (arrow) and high pressure fuel pump.

![](images/8a1d841e9b7658fd396992d5bc3854b57e43e7376960c26667642a5f057af8c9.webp)

8. Loosen high pressure fuel pipe joint (arrow), and disconnect connection between high pressure fuel pipe and high pressure fuel pump.

9. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow) from high pressure fuel pump.

Torque: 13 ± 1 N·m

> During removal, loosen fixing bolts in turn, and then remove bolts completely. Never remove a bolt completely in one time.

During installation of high pressure fuel pump, never tighten a bolt firmly in one time, and they must be tightened in turn. Apply a coat of oil to O-ring of high pressure fuel pump, install roller tappet and high pressure fuel pump and then place them into mounting hole. When replacing, be sure to align anti-rotating pin of roller tappet with anti-rotating groove in mounting hole.

### Installation

#

Caution: Before installation, make sure the part model of fuel rail injector is correct and available, and parts are new. Before installation, make sure sealing caps of fuel rail joint are complete. Never use fuel rail injector assembly without sealing cap. Before installation, make sure injector mounting hole on engine cylinder head is clean and free of foreign matters. Never lubricate Teflon grommet at injector head. During installation, align injector with mounting hole on cylinder head, and press it into mounting hole in axis direction of injector at a constant speed. If a press-fitting device is used, keep the force balance when pressing to prevent system from being damaged due to the unbalanced stress. The maximum pressing force should not be greater than 800N. After fuel rail is pressed into place, loosen the pressfitting device and insert bolt into the mounting hole on fuel rail injector, and screw 3-5 teeth into the screw hole on cylinder head. If no press-fitting device is available and fuel rail cannot be pressed into place, it is allowed to use a fuel rail bolt to bring it in, and use step-by-step tightening method to press the fuel rail injector into place. It is not allowed to tighten a bolt into place in one time. Loosen bolts by 3-5 threads after fuel rail is pressed into place. Tighten fixing bolts of fuel rail after fuel pipe is installed and tightened. It is necessary to perform self-learning of fuel injector after fuel rail injector is replaced. Install 4 fixing bolts to fuel rail injector assembly. Torque: 25 ± 3 N·m Caution: Tightening sequence of bolts: 3-2-4-1. (From cylinder of engine, bolts are arranged in order of 1, 2, 3, 4).   
2. Tighten coupling nut between high pressure fuel pipe and fuel rail injector assembly. Torque: 30 ± 2 N·m   
3. Other installation is in the reverse order of removal.

### Overview

Components Description

![](images/968c2ae72bcc69caf4aed754f7edfeed8cf0852fd9212a37c3a8e8d13e4b4e05.webp)

![](images/4ce022d1ad03efa2d89aa576cef89367c1c3626106caa71a6d9573428f24b9d8.webp)

### Operation

Emission control system recovers and burns fuel vapor to prevent the vapor in fuel tank from being discharged into the atmosphere. It monitors the oxygen content in exhaust gas, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas. Activated charcoal canister assembly plays an important role in the emission control system and it is used to absorb and filter moisture and fuel vapor. Fresh air enters the bottom of activated charcoal canister assembly while fuel vapor enters the top of activated charcoal canister through fuel vapor pipe. When engine stops operating, the fuel vapor and fresh air will be stored in the activated charcoal canister assembly. When engine runs and canister solenoid valve opens, the fuel vapor will enter intake manifold and burns in the cylinder. Oxygen sensor consists of upstream oxygen sensor and downstream oxygen sensor. Upstream oxygen sensor is installed on exhaust manifold assembly, and downstream oxygen sensor is installed on front exhaust pipe assembly. Oxygen sensor can detect the oxygen content in exhaust gas, and determine whether combustible air-fuel mixture is completely burnt out or not, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas.

### System Overview

System Components Diagram

![](images/5adbcc0aabc9e3786d2d9f7b3f3038bf29b4af0cc5c1ff47c46d5fada0246985.webp)

![](images/6d332cfc8a2c7b11f880af7c95479ba5a3357d07e860e4e8e09b48524911ed5f.webp)

Emission control system recovers and burns fuel vapor to prevent the vapor in fuel tank from being discharged into the atmosphere. It monitors the oxygen content in exhaust gas, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas. Activated charcoal canister assembly plays an important role in the emission control system and it is used to absorb and filter moisture and fuel vapor. Fresh air enters the bottom of activated charcoal canister assembly while fuel vapor enters the top of activated charcoal canister through fuel vapor pipe. When engine stops operating, the fuel vapor and fresh air will be stored in the activated charcoal canister assembly. When engine runs and canister solenoid valve opens, the fuel vapor will enter intake manifold and burns in the cylinder.

Oxygen sensor consists of upstream oxygen sensor and downstream oxygen sensor. Oxygen sensor can detect the oxygen content in exhaust gas, and determine whether combustible air-fuel mixture is completely burnt out or not, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/958a0a11e3e96832088387655cc57be0bb7037806be5db59803b480258310b3d.webp)

EC0000201

![](images/a68d9257e28373e5e991540e6df4dfbe9fe47bcd7813591a650994758d564f9b.webp)

When the engine starts, the fuel vapor adsorbed on activated charcoal canister passes through the charcoal canister solenoid valve through fuel vapor pipe, part of them directly enters the intake manifold through check valve to participate in combustion; the other part reaches the check valve through the desorption pressure sensor and is split here, one part enters the intake manifold through intercooler outlet pipe and electronic throttle valve, and the other part enters the inlet hose assembly.

### Diagnostic Principle of Fuel Tank Evaporation Leakage

After closing the charcoal canister close valve, pump the fuel tank into a certain negative pressure through the intake manifold vacuum degree. If the negative pressure cannot be established, it is considered that there is a large leakage, i.e. a coarse leakage. Then close the charcoal canister solenoid valve, and form a closed space between charcoal canister solenoid valve rear pipe and fuel tank. When there are holes and no holes, the attenuation gradient of vacuum degree in this closed space is different, so it can be judged whether there is leakage.

### Low Load Desorption Mode

When the pressure in intake manifold is lower than atmospheric pressure, after the charcoal canister solenoid valve operates, the fuel vapor in charcoal canister is directly desorbed by the pipeline connected to intake manifold.

### High Load Desorption Mode

When the pressure in intake manifold is higher than atmospheric pressure, the fuel vapor in charcoal canister is desorbed by the pipeline connected to supercharger inlet pipe. In order to increase the effect of high load desorption, a venturi tube is installed in high load desorption pipeline to increase the desorption flow.

### Main Function

Venturi effect is adopted in the venturi tube. The principle of venturi tube is to change the air flow from coarse to fine, so as to speed up the air flow rate and form a "vacuum area" at the rear side of venturi tube outlet; this vacuum area will produce certain adsorption to the outside.

### Charcoal Canister Desorption Pressure Sensor

Main Function Refer to Engine Management System.

### Main Function

Charcoal canister solenoid valve consists of solenoid coil, armature, valve body and other parts. Air volume through charcoal canister solenoid valve is related to the electric pulse duty ratio output from ECU to charcoal canister solenoid valve and the pressure difference between charcoal canister solenoid valve inlet and outlet. When there is no electric pulse, charcoal canister solenoid valve closes.

### Main Function

The inside of charcoal canister is filled with active carbon with strong adsorption. The excess fuel vapor in fuel tank is no longer discharged into the atmosphere, but introduced into the charcoal canister by hose. The active carbon absorbs the fuel vapor. When the vehicle starts, the activated charcoal canister solenoid valve is opened, and the absorbed fuel vapor is poured into the intake manifold for combustion, so as to achieve the purpose of fuel saving and environmental protection.

### Main Function

Filter the dust for the activated charcoal canister to avoid being blocked.

### Main Function

The upstream oxygen sensor is a ceramic body and is integrated with a micro pump for oxygen ion transportation. The pump supplies enough oxygen to the electrode on the exhaust gas contact side to keep the voltage on both sides constant, about 450 mV. The electronic controller converts the power consumption of pump into excess air coefficient. The output current is almost linearly related to λ, and λ = 0.65 \~ infinity, so it is also called a linear oxygen sensor. It can not only determine whether λ is greater than 1 or less than 1. Moreover, the specific value of λ can be measured in the lean and rich regions, so that the excess air coefficient in a larger range (i.e. broadband) can be measured, and continuous control of λ < 1 to λ > 1 can be realized.

### Main Function

The sensing element of downstream oxygen sensor is a ceramic flat body with pores. The outer side of ceramic is surrounded by engine exhaust, and the inner side is open to atmosphere. The sensing ceramic body wall is kind of solid electrolyte, which has a heating electrode inside. The work of oxygen sensor is realized by converting the difference of oxygen ion concentration inside and outside the sensing ceramic body into voltage signal. When the temperature of sensing ceramic body reaches 350 ℃ i has the characteristic of solid electrolyte. Because of its special material, oxygen ions can freely pass through the ceramic body. Using this characteristic, the concentration difference is converted into a potential difference to form an electrical signal output. If the mixed gas is rich, the oxygen ion concentration difference inside and outside of ceramic body is high, and the potential difference is high. A large number of oxygen ions move from inside to outside, and the output voltage is high (close to 800 mV 1000 mV); if the mixed gas is lean, the oxygen ion concentration difference inside and outside of ceramic body is low, and the potential difference is low, only a small amount of oxygen ions move from inside to outside, and the output voltage is low (close to 100 mV). The signal voltage changes abruptly near the theoretical equivalent air-fuel ratio (λ = 1).

### Overview

Description

![](images/c631282511a7daa4c7c45d12238a92d1749e481abc43bc3aca2dcc4591002214.webp)

IT0101001

![](images/1f33b995ac328e3a4d7ec1153077248314f24bbb107993938a37c40ead0b6514.webp)

Intake system mainly consists of air direct pipe, air filter assembly, intake hose, turbocharger, booster pressure sensor, electronic throttle assembly, intake pressure/temperature sensor, and intake manifold with intercooler set, etc.

### Operation

Intake system uses air filter to remove particulates and dust in the air, uses the turbocharger to pressurize the air, and then the air flows into intake manifold assembly through electronic throttle assembly. At the same time, the air is cooled by the intercooler installed inside intake manifold and mixes with fuel at the end of intake manifold assembly port to form flammable gas mixture, which is transmitted to each cylinder uniformly to coordinate with engine operation. Electronic throttle assembly is a critical part for engine intake system. Its main function is to control intake air volume by adjusting intake passage area according to driver's driving intention to meet intake requirements in different engine operating conditions, and send back position signals of throttle valve plate to control unit to achieve accurate control and run the engine under optimal control state.

### Inspection

Check the intake manifold gasket.

![](images/3245ab920fefbb0e326085f57eab10e46e92b11ea47b44d1042daab69205c181.webp)

Check the intake manifold gasket, and replace if it is deteriorated or damaged.

2. Check the intercooler gasket.

![](images/95d8283bb78464a9e413e0165035cf8d7f01da670b8fba034cb87e0a4b5130e6.webp)

Check the intercooler gasket, and replace if it is deteriorated or damaged.

3. Check flatness on intake manifold fitting surface. (a) Clean and check contact surface between intake manifold assembly side and cylinder head.

(b) Using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge, measure intake manifold flatness. If warpage on surface is greater than 0.8 mm, replace intake manifold assembly.

![](images/d64050e0ed35dfb2f26c30ed0a41d7176912120274f273b0ca662324e27e8201.webp)

Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.

4. Check warpage on cylinder head surface on installation side of intake manifold.

(a) Clean and check contact surface between intake manifold assembly and cylinder head side.

(b) Using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge, measure warpage on cylinder head side surface. If warpage on surface is greater than 0.04 mm, replace cylinder head assembly.

![](images/4335471d306c3db87b902f653f13c341bdf4b0283380949f1efe7055db627e00.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Clean the fitting surface of intake manifold assembly.   
> Replace the intake manifold gasket if it is damaged during installation.
>
> 1. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Check for foreign matter in intake manifold when installing. Avoid inhaling foreign matter after engine running, causing damage to the components.

### System Overview

System Components Diagram

![](images/28b56dca1eecbcde8787dd20d521542243b8fd863d234fba85174ae10209a942.webp)

IT0000101

![](images/44e217e1314f4431eaba47a2cc43dd7e3cef83712c6d5e4de154dc695936a71f.webp)

![](images/33a66718cffc85b96d0adb8babcc425fdbecfa8093f746a95b466f0320254aef.webp)

IT0000201

![](images/55fc8dbb6ee5dbb04303da1b0ec991e77ea0f3cb72b8e3e6ff98fa5930d37713.webp)

Intake system uses air filter to remove particulates and dust in the air, the air is pressurized by the turbocharger and cooled by the intercooler, then flows into the intake manifold assembly through the electronic throttle assembly, and the cooled fresh air is evenly delivered to each cylinder by the intake manifold to cooperate with the engine. Electronic throttle assembly is a critical part for engine intake system. Its main function is to control intake air volume by adjusting intake passage area according to driver's driving intention to meet intake requirements in different engine operating conditions, and send back position signals of throttle valve plate to control unit to achieve accurate control and run the engine under optimal control state.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/9ccd4667c8d879f185254b333241ff66509b846abf840ce57bc1b95cfbad8a33.webp)

IT0000301

### Main Function

The main function of air flow meter is to detect the intake air volume or intake air temperature of the engine. According to the intake air volume, it is converted into an electrical signal and calculated in ECU. It controls the engine speed (injection time and ignition time control) together with the throttle position sensor.

### Main Function

Its function is to reduce the high temperature air temperature after supercharging, so as to reduce the heat load of engine, increase the intake air volume, and then increase the engine power. For the engine, intercooler is an important component of supercharging system.

### Main Function

Distribute the fresh air cooled by intercooler to each cylinder.

### Air Filter Assembly

Main Function

The air filter is mainly used to remove particulate impurities in the air.

5. Push the valve plate by hand, and check if it rotates smoothly. If it is stuck, clean again according to the cleaning procedures.   
6. After cleaning, wipe off the cleaner in throttle valve body with absorbent paper.

### Electronic Throttle Learning Method

Perform throttle body self-learning once after installing electronic throttle body (turn ENGINE START STOP switch to ON and then to OFF after waiting for 30 seconds, and then perform ignition normally). Start vehicle and observe if it operates normally after self-learning is finished.

### Operation

![](images/1a9b78682064170415abadf1127936f0fb24e6180176eb5975c0b46ef8a3cc13.webp)

Turbocharger use motor to drive the turbo impeller to rotate, then drive compressor impeller to pressurize the air pressed through air filter and send it into cylinder. As more air enters into cylinder, more fuel is allowed to be injected, which results in higher engine power. In addition, the turbocharger can also make the engine get power compensation when it works in highland.

### Inspection

Basic inspection:

Check there are no cranks causing by overheating, biting, deformation or other damage on turbocharger turbo housing, otherwise, replace turbocharger.   
Check there are no deposition and blocking on turbo oil hole.   
Check there are no blockage, squash, deformation or other damage on oil inlet and return pipes of turbocharger.   
Check there are no oil leakage (inside leakage and outside leakage) on turbocharger.   
Check that charcoal canister check valve between charcoal canister and turbocharger front intake hose and check valve between brake booster and intake manifold are correctly installed with the arrow above points to conduction direction (fault prone points).   
Check that all lines are connected securely without leakage, aging, breakage, etc.

2. Turbocharger daily inspection

(a) Check the sealing and tightness of connecting lines between air filter and turbocharger, turbocharger and engine exhaust pipe.   
(b) Check f turbocharger oil inlet pipe and return pipe are damaged or throttling, and if the connecting bolts of joints are loose.   
(cd) Check quality of oil, clean or replace the oil element. Check the air filter and clean or replace the element regularly.   
(e) Check if engine crankcase blow-by gas is too large, breather is smooth, ensure crankcas pressure is normal.

3. Other requirements of turbocharger

(a) Avoid low engine idle for long time (maximum should not exceed 20 minutes).   
(b) Never use the operation with "Accelerate Stall Neutral coasting",before the engine lubricating oil pressure is established, the engine must be kept in idling condition (3 to 5 minutes).   
(c) Before stopping the engine, let it gradually decrease its temperature and speed from maximum value (3 to 5 minutes).

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Replace high temperature nut and washer, and clean foreign matters on connection part. Check for air leakage, if so, check if each nut or bolt is tightened; if component is damaged, replace it. 1. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

### Precautions

### System Overview System Components
