![](images/d7497cf46251a3e0e59e3bc87b94296d4048f4e7bcb6a0833f315a343d13595a.webp)

Exhaust system controls engine exhaust, reduces vehicle emissions by precatalytic converter and main catalytic converter, and eliminates exhaust noise by muffler. When exhaust system discharges exhaust gas, oxygen sensor monitors oxygen content in exhaust gas. Engine control module adjusts air-fuel ratio of combustible gas mixture according to feedback signals of oxygen sensor and combining with other sensor signals to control vehicle emissions and achieve optimal fuel economy.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/add9c2bd81fabf6c032545462a8836a4d015150380da26d093e266c07f0a2117.webp)

The fresh air filtered by the air filter enters the intercooler after being pressed by the turbocharger, and then enters the cylinder after being cooled by the intercooler. The exhaust gas drives turbo impeller to rotate, and then drives compressor impeller to press the inlet fresh air.

### Main Function

Turbocharger use the exhaust gas from the engine to drive the turbo impeller to rotate, then drive compressor impeller to pressurize the air pressed through air filter and send it into cylinder. As more air enters into cylinder, more fuel is allowed to be injected, which results in higher engine power. In addition, the turbocharger can also make the engine get power compensation when it works in highland.

### Main Function

Catalytic converter is the most important external purification device fixed in vehicle exhaust system, which can convert harmful gases such as carbon monoxide, hydrocarbons and nitrogen oxides from exhaust gas into carbon dioxide, water and nitrogen by oxidation and reduction.

### Main Function

Reduce the exhaust noise of the engine, and make high temperature exhaust gas can be safely and effectively discharged.

### Exhaust system gas leakage inspection

1. Check there are no cranks causing by overheating, biting, deformation or other damage on exhaust turbocharger turbo housing, otherwise, replace exhaust turbocharger.   
23. Check there are no deposition and blocking on turbo oil hole. Check there are no blockage, squash, deformation or other damage on oil inlet and return pipes of exhaust turbocharger.   
4. Check that charcoal canister check valve between charcoal canister and exhaust turbocharger front intake hose and check valve between brake booster and intake manifold are correctly installed with the arrow above to point to conduction direction (fault prone points).   
5. Check there is no sticking in actuator mechanism, and if actuator connector is connected normally.   
6. Check there is no obvious deformation in turbocharger impeller, and the rotation is normal without blocking.

### Turbocharger daily inspection

1. Check the sealing and tightness of connecting lines between air filter and turbocharger, turbocharger and engine intake/exhaust pipe.   
2. Check if turbocharger oil inlet pipe and return pipe are damaged or throttling, and if the connecting bolts of joints are loose.   
3. Check the air filter and clean or replace the element regularly.   
4. Check if engine crankcase blow-by gas is too large, breather is smooth, ensure crankcase pressure is normal.

### Other requirements of turbocharger

1. Avoid low engine idle for long time (maximum should not exceed 20 minutes).   
2. Never use the operation with "Accelerate Stall Neutral coasting",before the engine lubricating oil pressure is established, the engine must be kept in idling condition (3 - 5 minutes).   
3. Before stopping the engine, let it gradually decrease its temperature and speed from maximum value (3 - 5 minutes).

Be sure to wear safety equipment to prevent accidents, when removing muffler heat insulator I. Appropriate force should be applied when removing muffler heat insulator I. Be careful not to operate roughly. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Raise the vehicle to a proper position.
>
> 3. Remove 4 clamping washers from muffler heat insulator I.
>
> ![](images/9b228e44f4d014614ca83c63ff029249c2e588539d78df5a4998bbdf8d95b5db.webp)
>
> 4. Remove muffler heat insulator I.
>
> Installation Caution:
>
> The clamping washers are installed in diagonal order.   
> 1. Tighten the stud between muffler heat insulator and rear floor body with 4 clamping washers.

### Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.

![](images/1499433875aa00d87afb6714de62eddbe36e3599dba24f2463aa4b59b3918467.webp)

### Operation

Engine cooling system adjusts engine operating temperature by the flow of coolant and makes engine operate normally under various operating conditions. Engine cooling system is a forced circulation system, which supplies circulation pressure for cooling system by water pump and forces coolant to circulate in the engine cylinder block, and distributes excessive heat to radiator by the flow of coolant, and radiates it to the air by cooling fan. Also, engine cooling system provides heat to the heater core in cabin to improve driving comfort.

### Cooling System Operation Flowchart

![](images/2b697bf761b0f637789c7deb138b08bd4704f985eba183af03654ff5017937de.webp)

Small circulation: When coolant temperature is below 82 ± 2 ℃ electronic thermostat assembly closes. Coolant only circulates inside the cylinder block and warms up other engine parts that need heat. Water pump assembly circulates engine coolant through cylinder block, oil cooler assembly, turbocharger and cylinder head. The coolant does not radiate heat through radiator.   
Large circulation: When coolant temperature is higher than 95 ℃ electronic thermostat assembly opens fully and all coolant flowing out of cylinder block enters radiator for radiating. It then returns to cylinder block for circulation by water pump. Due to radiating in radiator, engine coolant temperature decreases quickly to prevent engine from overheating.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When testing cooling system, please pressurize the system to specified pressure. Otherwise, system components may be damaged.   
> Before testing cooling system, do not perform operation until coolant temperature drops to normal level. Otherwise, it may cause scald.

### Test Procedures

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch.

![](images/17ca7248877726bc2b27213c31b1efac4cd848704686005d35beb4eee5aba02e.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Make sure there is no leakage in connecting part of coolant system pressure tester, in order to avoid pressure leakage during test.
>
> 4. Pressurize cooling system to 1.2 bar with the cooling system pressure tester, and then observe the pressure changes. If system pressure does not drop within 2 minutes, it indicates there is no leakage in system. If pressure changes greatly, it indicates that there is a leakage in system; find the leaking area and perform troubleshooting.

> DO NOT use inferior coolant.   
> DO NOT mix different colors or types of coolant.   
> Be careful when adding coolant; avoid spilling coolant on any area of engine.

> 1. Open expansion tank cap and add coolant until coolant level reaches the "MAX" line.

> If there is no coolant in expansion tank after engine just starts, perform the followings: Stop the engine; Wait until coolant cools down; Add coolant to "MAX" line on expansion tank.
>
> Run the engine at 2500 rpm until coolant level becomes stable.
>
> 3. Stop engine and wait until coolant temperature drops to the ambient temperature. Check that coolant level is between "MAX" and "MIN" lines. If coolant level is below the "MIN" line, repeat all the above procedures. If coolant level is above the "MAX" line, drain coolant until the level is between "MAX" and "MIN" lines.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Carry out turbocharging inter-cooling device cooling system bleeding after replacing coolant or removing and installing turbocharging inter-cooling system related components.   
> Never loosen outlet pipe set upper pressure cap in warmed up engine, to prevent coolant from spilling out, causing burns.

> 4. Rotate expansion tank cap counterclockwise in cold engine.

### System Overview

System Components Diagram

![](images/04bb79bb1cf372bff346ea2a52a8d6978c9b72645e340cbc65739f0e84e49bd4.webp)

P10010

![](images/b28d8be78ff4bb77611babce80aca1734c07823e51bf07eab3481831a72ceefe.webp)
Engine cooling system adjusts engine operating temperature by the flow of coolant and makes engine operate normally under various operating conditions.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/9b9a2a887ee86ac93d51ec06653952eb56fd41f6b19e2a49fe43deba6edc2d20.webp)

When the engine is cold started, the switch type coolant pump enters the control mode, stops working to make the coolant temperature rise rapidly; when the coolant temperature reaches a certain temperature, it enters the normal temperature mode.   
When the coolant temperature does not reach the opening temperature of electronic thermostat, the coolant enters cylinder block directly through the cooling pipe; the engine coolant circulates in cylinder block, oil radiator assembly, turbocharger and the cylinder head, and the coolant does not radiate through the radiator.   
When coolant temperature reaches the opening temperature of electronic thermostat, all coolant flowing out of cylinder block enters radiator for radiating. It then returns to cylinder block for circulation by water pump. Due to radiating in radiator, engine coolant temperature decreases quickly to prevent engine from overheating.

### Main Function

It is a liquid composed of antifreeze additive, additive and water to prevent metal from rusting. It needs to have the performance of antifreeze, corrosion resistance and heat conductivity.

### Main Function

The expansion tank is an integral part of the vehicle cooling system. When the engine is running, the coolant will circulate continuously in the cooling water channel, and will flow through the expansion tank at halfway. If the pressure is too high or the coolant is too much, the excess gas and coolant will flow out of the bypass water channel of the expansion tank to avoid the high pressure of the cooling system.

### Main Function

The radiator is composed of three parts: Inlet chamber, outlet chamber and radiator core. The coolant flows in the radiator core and the air flows outside the radiator core. The hot coolant cools down because radiating heat to air, and the cold air heats up because absorbing the heat from the coolant, so the radiator is a heat exchanger.

### Main Function

It is used for engine cooling and coolant cooling to ensure that the engine will not fail due to high temperature.

### Main Function

When the engine water temperature is low, the electromagnetic coil is controlled to turn on and the water pump stops working. When the engine water temperature exceeds a certain value, the electromagnetic coil is controlled to disconnect and the water pump starts to work. In the case of cold start at normal temperature, it basically enters into control mode at the beginning: It is normally closed for most of the time and turns occasionally. With the rise of coolant temperature, the normally closed time is shortened and the normally turned time is longer. After reaching a certain temperature, it switches to the normal temperature mode.

### Main Function

The electronic thermostat can calculate the target temperature according to engine running speed, load state, intake air temperature, coolant temperature, etc., accurately regulate the coolant temperature to ensure that the engine always works at a reasonable temperature.

According to the calculated value of the sensor signal, ECU provides the signal working voltage to heating resistance element in electronic thermostat, which makes the paraffin expand and displace. Through this displacement, the temperature regulating unit mechanically adjusts the large circulation and small circulation of water temperature.

The operation of electronic thermostat shall meet the following conditions at the same time:

1. When is low speed and low load, controls to open at 105°C to improve fuel economy.   
23. When is high speed and high load, controls to open at 95°C to ensure engine safety. In case of line fault, it can be opened mechanically, with initial opening temperature of 100°C ± 2°C and full opening temperature of 110°C ± 2°C.   
4. Opening stroke of thermostat: 8mm.

### Main Function

The electronic water pump is a centrifugal pump driven by a brushless DC motor. There is no dynamic seal in the whole part, the rotor and the impeller are injection molded into one. The electronic water pump mainly includes the following parts: Stator set, rotor set, rear cover set, motor housing set, water pump housing and mounting frame set.

### Idling

Always perform the idling test when the the water pump is running. During idling detection, if the power consumption is lower than the set value, idling is recognized. After idling identification, the water pump stops running. After a certain period of time, it will try to restart, repeat the stop and idling detection. For stop time information, refer to the later instructions. When idling, the water pump sends idling alarm signal according to the definition. If it is still idling after 20 attempts of restart, the water pump stops running and does not attempt to restart again. In order to make the water pump run again, it needs to power on and reset (for example, set UPump = 0V for 1s), or perform the following operations: Set the speed = 0 for more than 4s, and then set the speed > 0.

2. Send the idling alarm signal after the third time of idling identification. The first idling signal will be delayed for 5s at most due to the previous waiting for the normal operation signal to be sent. After the water pump operates without fault for 5s, the idling alarm signal stops sending.

### Blocking

If the speed is lower than 100 rpm, it is judged as engine blocking, and the water pump is stopped. After a certain period of time, it will try to restart, repeat the stop & idle and blocking detection. For stop time information, refer to the idling instructions. When blocking, sends blocking alarm signal according to the definition. If it is still blocking after 20 attempts of restart, the water pump stops running and does not attempt to restart again. In order to make the water pump run again, it needs to power on and reset (for example, set UPump = 0V for 1s), or perform the following operations: Set the speed = 0 for more than 4s, and then set the speed > 0.

2. Send the blocking alarm signal after the third time of blocking identification. The first blocking signal will be delayed for 5s at most due to the previous waiting for the normal operation signal to be sent. After the water pump operates without fault for 5s, the blocking alarm signal stops sending.

### Over temperature

1. If the PCB temperature exceeds 130°C, it will detect that the temperature is too high, the power supply of the pump will be cut off automatically. When the PCB temperature is lower than 125°C for more than 20 seconds, the pump will restart according to the PWM input signal. When the temperature is too high, the over temperature alarm signal will be sent.   
2. The alarm signal will be sent after the over temperature is determined for one second. Because the normal operation signal needs to be sent first, the first over temperature signal will be sent after 5 seconds. When it is confirmed that there is no over temperature problem, the over temperature alarm signal stops sending.

### Low speed

If the speed is less than 800 rpm for more than 4s, it is considered as low speed.

2. After low speed event identification, the water pump stops running. After a certain period of time, it will try to restart, repeat the stop & idle and low speed detection. For stop time information, refer to the idling instructions. At low speed, sends low speed alarm signal according to the definition. If it is still low speed after 20 attempts of restart, the water pump stops running and does not attempt to restart again. In order to make the water pump run again, it needs to power on and reset (for example, set UPump = 0V for 1s), or perform the following operations: Set the speed = 0 for more than 4s, and then set the speed > 0.   
3. Send the low speed alarm signal after the third time of low speed identification The first over temperature stopping alarm signal will be delayed for 5s at most due to the previous waiting for the normal operation signal to be sent. After operating without fault for 5s, the low speed alarm signal stops sending.

### Operation

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Prolonged and repeated contact with engine oil will result in the removal of natural oils from skin, leading to dryness, irritation and dermatitis. In addition, the used engine oil contains potentially harmful contaminants, which may cause skin cancer. Precautions should be followed when replacing engine oil to minimize the risk of your skin making contact with used engine oil.
>
> Wear protective clothing and gloves;   
> Wash your skin thoroughly with soap and water, or use waterless hand cleaner to remove any used engine oil.   
> Never use gasoline, thinners or solvents.

### Hint:

Check oil level indicated by oil dipstick, when engine is stopped after it reaches operating temperature. 1. Park vehicle on level ground, stop the engine after warming up and wait for 5 minutes

2. Open the hood and pull out the oil dipstick in direction of arrow as shown in illustration and wipe it clean with a piece of cloth

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Please put a piece of cloth under the oil dipstick end to prevent oil from splashing onto engine and body.
>
> ![](images/2f98e465d548e8ed65d84e7c63a87ec6c57d3f111e02764c508bf3d32494c217.webp)
>
> 3. Reinsert the oil dipstick in place and leave it for 3 s to 5 s.
>
> 4. Pull out the oil dipstick again and check if oil level is proper Hint: If engine oil level is too low, check for leakage and add oil up to the level mark
>
> (a) If oil level is at or above the "MAX" mark, drain the excessive engine oil.
>
> ![](images/5d4627c1a29b821e7c0abec339a36c41d30293416b525007a31565d6cb5e15cb.webp)
>
> (b) If oil level is between "MIN" mark and "MAX" mark, it shows that oil level is prop (c) If oil level is below the "MIN" mark, it is necessary to add engine oil.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When adding engine oil, oil level should not be above the "MAX" mark.   
> Do not start the engine during the measurement.

### Oil Pressure Inspection Preconditions

1. Engine oil level is normal   
2. Oil filter is used within 5000 km   
3. Engine reaches the normal operating temperature

### Inspection

Disconnect the oil pressure switch connector (1) and remove the oil pressure switch (2).

2. Screw the oil pressure tester into threaded hole of oil pressure switch as shown in the illustration.

![](images/9054129816412d7d63854aa6b286d7acf8dad78c37717c56f231414b8b0d9b84.webp)

3. Start the engine. When the engine inspection conditions are met, read the oil pressure values at idling speed and high speed respectively. If lubrication system pressure is low, clean the oil pan and oil strainer mesh, and then test again. If lubrication system pressure is still low, replace the oil pump assembly. Oil pressure at idling speed (700 ± 50 r/min): above 0.7 bar. Oil pressure at high speed (2000 ± 50 r/min): above 2.5 bar.   
4. Install the oil pressure switch. Hint: Apply a small amount of seal gum to threads when installing the oil pressure switch.   
5. Connect the oil pressure switch connector and check engine oil for leakage.

Engine Oil Drainage Warning/Caution/Hint

In addition, the used engine oil contains potentially harmful contaminants, which may cause skin cancer. Therefore, always take proper skin protection measures when performing vehicle service.

Move away your hand quickly to prevent burn by oil with a certain temperature. Wasted engine oil should be handled by specialized department according to local laws and regulations. Never discard it at will

### Installation

2. Apply a small amount of seal gum to threads when installing the oil pressure switch.

(a) Use a torque wrench to tighten it to specified torque, as shown in illustration, there is a gap (a) about 2 to 5 mm between oil pressure switch flange surface and oil filter module housing. Tightening torque 20 ± 2 N·m

Check if oil filter module assembly seal ring is installed to correct position. Add oil to specified position. 1. Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> DO NOT drain oil and remove oil pan until engine cools down. Prolonged and repeated contact with engine oil will be harmful to your skin. If engine oil spills on your skin, wash it off immediately with water. In addition, the used engine oil contains potentially harmful contaminants, which may cause skin cancer. Therefore, always take proper skin protection measures when performing vehicle service. DO NOT remove oil pan until engine cools down.
>
> 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch.   
> 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
> 3. Recover the refrigerant.   
> 4. Drain the engine oil.   
> 5. Remove the engine accessory belt.   
> 6. Remove fixing bracket between compressor assembly and compressor.   
> 7. Remove bracket between electric water pump assembly and electric water pump. Hint: It is not necessary to disconnect inlet and outlet hoses when removing electric water pump assembly. Move it to one side and fix it accordingly after removing bolt.
>
> 8. Remove the oil pan assembly (MT).
>
> (a) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) between oil pan assembly and transmission assembly. Tightening torque 50 ± 5 N·m
>
> (b) Remove 15 fixing bolts from oil pan in order as shown in illustration. Tightening torque 20 + 5 N·m
>
> ![](images/7e335ea97b6cb61a01f6c2ec8e5499bf9de4deae427fd08b3f1cbde772f4b057.webp)
>
> (c) Tap all around oil pan slightly with a rubber hammer, remove oil pan. Caution:
>
> Because the seal gum is sealed between oil pan and cylinder block, never use hard objects, such as a hammer, to tap it during removal, but it can be tapped slowly from left and right with a rubber hammer.   
> A transmission carrier can be used to support the oil pan during removal, to prevent personal injury from sudden dropping of oil pan.   
> DO NOT damage or miss dowel pin when removing oil pan.
>
> (d) Remove the residual seal gum on oil pan and engine frame with flat scraper. Caution: When removing seal gum on installation surface between oil pan and engine frame, threaded hole can be cleaned with cleaner properly.
>
> 9. Remove the oil pan assembly (CVT).
>
> (a) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) between oil pan assembly and transmission assembly, and remove dust plate. Tightening torque 50 ± 5 N·m
>
> (b) Remove 15 fixing bolts from oil pan in order as shown in illustration. Tightening torque 20 + 5 N·m
>
> ![](images/f9d8feacb6527964609a51d029cfcc27c37566465726129fd65166d1c8237c0b.webp)
>
> (c) Tap all around oil pan slightly with a rubber hammer, remove oil pan.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Because the seal gum is sealed between oil pan and cylinder block, never use hard objects, such as a hammer, to tap it during removal, but it can be tapped slowly from left and right with a rubber hammer.   
> A transmission carrier can be used to support the oil pan during removal, to prevent personal injury from sudden dropping of oil pan.   
> DO NOT damage or miss dowel pin when removing oil pan.
>
> (d) Remove the residual seal gum on oil pan and engine frame with flat scraper. Caution:
>
> When removing seal gum on installation surface between oil pan and engine frame, threaded hole can be cleaned with cleaner properly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> When applying seal gum, check the type and expiration date of seal gum.   
> Remove impurities, iron chips and residue of seal gum on oil pan.   
> Remove oil stain and residue of seal gum on the threaded hole of oil pan and cylinder block.   
> Seal gum should not be applied too thick; otherwise it will overflow into oil pan due to squeezing, which will block the oil strainer.

### System Overview System Components Diagram

![](images/63d08ffe46b3df1d008e9cd7020d330d6a7a71efa0c6ca078d379b7abbef2ae0.webp)

LU0000101

★: Non-reusable Parts   
![](images/7acf09f1a1a3d3dd6208da5e3aaabcd710f9a8e42666fe8ec89cd4279576cb09.webp)

Oil pump of SQRF4J16 engine is installed in oil pan. Crankshaft transmits power to it through chain. Oil pump is a two -stage variable displacement pump, and its displacement is controlled by ECU through oil pressure regulating solenoid valve. Two-stage variable displacement oil pump lubrication system is composed of two-stage variable displacement oil pump, solenoid valve, variable displacement oil pump control module in vehicle ECU and feedback oil passage, etc.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/b104bdb936cc2f5779a30ecafd77b819c0cc4b530c666132a0bd4776da60ebd2.webp)

LU0000201

Crankshaft drives oil pump to sucks oil from oil pan. Engine oil is filtered by oil filter and delivered to crankshaft connecting rod mechanism and cam valve mechanism, including some accessories such as turbocharger through main oil passage.

### Main Function

Oil pump of SQRF4J16 engine is installed in oil pan. Crankshaft transmits power to it through chain. Oil pump is a two-stage variable displacement pump, and its displacement is controlled by ECU through oil pressure regulating solenoid valve. Oil pump adopts vane type variable displacement structure, and main structure is stator and rotor; There are two oil pressure chambers on the outer ring of stator to apply pressure control to the stator, so that it can deflect clockwise or counterclockwise around the fulcrum, changing the eccentricity ratio of vane pump and adjusting displacement.

### Main Function

Oil filter module assembly is used to filter the metal debris, oil impurities and lubricant oxides in the lubricant.

### Main Function

Oil cooler is on the circulation oil passage of lubrication system. During engine running, as oil viscosity becomes lean with temperature increasing lubricating ability is reduced. Oil cooler is used to cool the lubricant, keep the oil temperature within normal operating range, reduce oil temperature and maintain a certain viscosity of lubricant.

### Main Function

Oil pressure switch is installed on the main oil passage of engine block and used to detect the value of engine oil pressure. When the value is lower than the specified value, oil pressure warning light is turned on.

### Main Function

It is used to remove impurities such as dust, metal particles, carbon deposits and soot particles in oil to protect the engine.

### Oil Level Measurement by Dipstick

1. Park the vehicle in a relatively horizontal position.   
2. Keep engine running at least 2 minutes and leave is stopped for 3\~5 minutes.   
3. Pull out the dipstick, wipe off the measurement part and insert it into dipstick tube slowly, then leave if for 3\~5 s.   
4. Pull out the dipstick steady and place the measurement part horizontally. Visually check if oil stain position on measurement part is within "MIN" mark and "MAX" mark.   
5. It is recommended to repeat operations in step 3 and 4 for 3 times to improve the reliability of test results.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Do not start the engine during the measurement.   
> The upper and lower limit of dipstick measurement part correspond to the volume of lubricant in oil pan is 4.5 L and 3.5 L.   
> If the oil stain position is within the upper and lower scale of measurement part, it shows that oil level is proper. Treatment is not required, but user can add an appropriate amount of lubricant according to actual conditions.

### Operation

Ignition system mainly consists of sensors, Engine Control Module (ECM), ignition coils, spark plugs, etc. Ignition advance angle is controlled by Engine Control Module (ECM) directly. As an integrated module, the ignition coil cannot be disassembled. SQRE4T15C uses coil-on-plug system. Secondary high-voltage terminal of each ignition coil is connected to spark plugs in engine cylinder respectively via high-voltage post. Ignition coil primary low-voltage terminal is connected to Engine Control Module (ECM) via wire harness. Engine Control Module (ECM) receives the Top Dead Center (TDC) position of each cylinder piston via input signal of phase sensor, and uses the speed sensor signal to make ignition coil to operate.

### Repair Precaution

Visual inspection can reduce the unnecessary test and diagnostic time, so pay attention to the following inspection items:

1. Check the line and hose for obvious looseness, and if they are disconnected or routed improperly.   
2. Make sure that the battery connections are clean and fixed firmly.   
3. Check if the generator wire and belt are installed correctly and securely.   
4. Check if the engine wire harness connectors are inserted fully.   
5. Check if all electrical connectors are installed correctly and securely.

6. Check the following electrical connections.

(a) Engine speed sensor   
(b) Oxygen sensor   
(c) Intake pressure/temperature sensor   
(d) Oil pressure switch   
(e) Ignition coil   
(f) Canister solenoid valve   
(g) Camshaft position sensor (h) Electronic throttle   
(i) Intake Variable Valve Timing (VVT) control valve (j) Exhaust Variable Valve Timing (VVT) control valve (k) Fuel injector

7. Check the routing of all vacuum hoses.

8. Confirm that the following vacuum hoses are connected securely without any leakage (a) Canister solenoid valve (b) PCV valve (c) Brake booster   
9. Check the fuel pump hose and wire connection to make sure that they are connected securely.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents when repairing. Try to prevent body paint surface from being scratched during removal and installation. It is prohibited to use short circuit spark test to test ignition function during repair, otherwise it may damage the module. During using, do not remove ignition coil from spark plug with bare hands with power on, and do not contact the metal part directly, to avoid electric shock. 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch. 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 3. Remove the engine trim cover. 4
>

### System Overview

Fuel System Components Diagram

![](images/18ea10f95c074f9358c9a8d9636b292e3f8ea607bc5d337199a53aa240d3c26e.webp)

IT0001001

![](images/4e13b7ec763596ea725aa7ef8e09cac8dd1e60549112bc638455580d1bef2664.webp)

Ignition system mainly consists of sensors, engine control module, ignition coils, spark plugs, etc.   
Ignition advance angle is controlled by engine control module.

As an integrated module, the ignition coil cannot be disassembled. It uses coil-on-plug system. Secondary high-voltage terminal of each ignition coil is connected to spark plugs in engine cylinder respectively via high-voltage post. Ignition coil primary low-voltage terminal is connected to engine control module via wire harness.

Engine control module receives the top dead center position of each cylinder piston via input signal of phase sensor, and uses the speed sensor signal to make ignition coil to operate.

### System Schematic Diagram

![](images/3644764045135bc214a57dfd6c276e307615f9ef46bd864f08ae06c860e33572.webp)

IG0000201

### Main Function

Ignition coil consists of primary winding, secondary winding, iron core and housing etc. The primary winding will energize when its ground passage is on. If ECU cuts off the primary winding circuit, it will stop energizing and a high voltage will be induced in the secondary winding which causes spark plugs to discharge.

![](images/a47ee610b413814c55bbce7235dea0fa40189e91bbc847a516e7be8f9fea783d.webp)

### Main Function

A spark plug is a component for delivering high-voltage current to cylinder to ignite the combustible air mixture. It mainly consists of wired nut, insulator, wired screw, central electrode, side electrode and case. The side electrode is wield to case.

### Operation

Starter consists of three parts: control mechanism, drive train mechanism and DC motor.

1. Control mechanism (solenoid switch): Controls engagement and disengagement between starter drive gear and engine flywheel gear and switches on/off the DC circuit; Also the solenoid switch has function of additional resistance of short circuit ignition coil when starting.   
2. Drive train mechanism: When engine starts, it engages starter drive gear with flywheel gear ring and transmits starter torque to the engine crankshaft; after engine starts, drive gear will automatically disengage from the flywheel gear, so that engine cannot drive starter at high speed, avoiding damage to the starter.

3. DC motor: Converts electrical energy from battery into electromagnetic moment.

### Hint:

If result is not as specified, replace the starter relay.

### Ground Inspection

1. Power assembly ground and body ground inspection.

(a) Check the power and body ground wire fixing bolts for looseness, and the ground parts should be in good contact with no heat or burnt smell.

(b) Using ohm band of digital multimeter, one test lead is connected to the negative cable, and the other test lead is connected to the body ground or power assembly ground. The resistance measured at A is ≤ 0.3Ω, and the resistance measured at B is ≤ 1Ω, the values at A and B cannot differ greatly. If it does not meet the requirements, check the body ground and power assembly ground cable.

![](images/96039ca7e76bdc824cac0d44c15b994607d45eb6d8949022b0b6541fe1745543.webp)

### Precautions for Starting System

1. Before starting engine, shift transmission to P/N, neutral position (MT), and apply parking brake while depressing brake/clutch pedal.   
2. Make sure that battery is fully charged to reduce repeat operating time of starter.   
3. Do not start engine for more than 5 seconds each time, repeated starting interval should not be less than 10 - 15 seconds, and consecutive starting is not allowed for more than 3 times.   
4. If starter cannot stop, turn off ENGINE START STOP switch immediately, or remove the negative battery cable to find the problem.   
5. Check the starter circuit frequently to make sure that each wire of starting system is connected securely and in good insulation.   
6. Generally, perform maintainable service for starter when servicing the vehicle. Also, maintenance interval can be shortened or extended depending on actual conditions.   
7. Remove the negative battery cable before removing starter.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents when repairing. Try to prevent body paint surface from being scratched during removal and installation.   
> 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and ENGINE START STOP switch.   
> 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
> 3. Remove the air filter assembly.   
> 4. Remove the electric water pump assembly. Hint: Remove the electric water pump set bolt without having to remove water pipe. Move electric water pump aside after removal so that starter assembly can be taken out easily.
>
> 5. Remove starter assembly.
>
> (a) Remove positive cable fixing nut rubber protector (1) from starter. Remove the set bolt. Tightening torque 13 ± 2 N·m   
> (b) Disconnect the starter assembly connector (2).
>
> (c) Remove 2 set bolts between starter assembly and transmission assembly (arrow). Tightening torque 45 ± 5 N·m
>
> ![](images/571744139a4dfcaaff59f43726197229a69781645ca99c37151ed677c9b7e864.webp)
>
> (d) Remove starter assembly.

### 22 Inspection

1. Check the starter clutch.

![](images/6ce7538e8a0218ece706c43c0397c0d71656c60a7c7c9caa25660838e68d7f82.webp)

2. Check the starter solenoid switch.

(a) Check the pull-in coil.

(b) Check the hold-in coil.

![](images/584b1ec13d61e0fdfd76ad8ed107e53fb335f4837efdbf49270250d5c165db60.webp)

3. Check the starter assembly.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> These measurements must be performed within 3 to 5 seconds to avoid coil burnout. Place the starter assembly onto a vise. The jaws of vise should be covered by aluminum sheet or brass plate; otherwise, the starter assembly will be easily damaged when clamping it.
>
> (a) Perform pull-in test. Remove the nut and disconnect the field coil lead from terminal C.
>
> As shown in illustration, connect battery to solenoid switch, and check that starter clutch pinion sticks out normally.
>
> ![](images/ff70cd8518a68a569180bf85e0127ec6b5bf16c1281d778598d7b144e935a9f9.webp)
>
> If starter clutch pinion does not move, replace the starter assembly.
>
> (b) Perform hold-in test.
>
> Keep the starter clutch pinion sticking out and the connection condition of battery mentioned above, and disconnect the negative battery cable from terminal C.
>
> Check if starter clutch pinion keeps sticking out. If starter clutch pinion moves inward, replace the starter assembly.
>
> (c) Check if starter clutch pinion returns back. Disconnect the negative battery cable from starter body. Check that starter clutch pinion returns back. If starter clutch pinion does not return back, replace the starter assembly.
>
> ![](images/0b821a4dcfdcb6f8efb58854fba875970fb152326b3af7d9565799ba1e07e8b7.webp)
>
> ![](images/f47ee072c6abcf5516ea5bd23eec1043d908290cf0b50357bb849bf40a8a0e4a.webp)
>
> (d) Check if starter rotates smoothly.
>
> Connect the field coil lead to terminal C, and tighten it with a nut. As shown in illustration, connect battery to   
> starter. Check that starter rotates smoothly when   
> the starter clutch pinion moves outward.

### Precautions

### System Overview

Fuel System Components Diagram

![](images/095a45d362ee30bf20d6d52ee8c36fa66a08dc601907b9c8a59a53bd1dd1d413.webp)

![](images/1d545db52963832b56264d52664fd4b7d5139ace901dee193b431c174c86a017.webp)

Starting system consists of battery, ignition switch and starter, etc. Starting system converts electrical energy from battery into mechanical energy, allowing engine to crank initially, and disconnects power transmission between starter and engine when engine runs normally.

### Main Function

Starter consists of three parts: control mechanism, drive train mechanism and DC motor.

Control mechanism (solenoid switch): controls engagement and disengagement between starter drive gear and engine flywheel gear and switches on/off the DC circuit; Also the solenoid switch has function of additional resistance of short circuit ignition coil when starting.

Drive train mechanism: When engine starts, it engages starter drive gear with flywheel gear ring and transmits starter torque to the engine crankshaft; after engine starts, drive gear will automatically disengage from the flywheel gear, so that engine cannot drive starter at high speed, avoiding damage to the starter.

DC motor: converts electrical energy from battery into electromagnetic moment.

### Battery External Normal Malfunction

1. Housing is cracked

(a) Housing cracked is the most serious and destructive malfunction. When vehicle is subjected to strong vibration, lead acid battery overheating, too high pressure or electrolyte frozen expansion, the housing of lead acid battery will be damaged. For such malfunction, replacing battery is the sole way for treatment.

2. Electrode is loose

(a) The cause of loosen electrode is that excessive force is applied during removal and installation of wire harness and inspection of contact. It is necessary to replace the battery assembly.

3. Connecting part of electrode is corroded or burnt (a) The cause is that anti-corrosive solvent is not applied when installing battery. You can apply vaseline oil after cleaning up. If the electrode is seriously corroded or burnt, replace it with a new one.

4. Battery swells

(a) Check if the generated electricity is normal and if the charging voltage is too high. (b) The causes are that battery is aging and resistance is excessively high. It is necessary to replace the battery.

### Battery Fluid Leakage Test

1. Test method

(a) PH paper is used for judgment. PH paper model definition: PH 1 - 14

![](images/b35928b84f7512d7e6a3af5b34e4b1d3a8e8b304e31c1f9b2a378997f60409cd.webp)

2. Judgment method

(a) Take a piece of PH paper (never allow it contacting with other fluid before test) to wipe the leaking area, so as to make the fluid adhere on the PH paper. Then compare it with the color bar to judge the PH value.   
(b) If the PH value is less than 7, it is an acidic liquid, which indicates battery leakage.   
(c) If the PH value is 7 or higher, it is non-acidic liquid (neutral or alkaline) which indicates "Petroleum jelly" fluid or other fluids leakage on battery surface.

### On-vehicle Inspection

1. Check that battery terminals are not loose or corroded. If battery terminals are corroded, clean them.

2. Check battery for damage, deformation or leakage. If damage, deformation or leakage is found, replaced the battery.

Check battery voltage.

(a) Turn ENGINE START STOP switch to ON, and turn it off 20 to 30 seconds after turning on headlight. Release the surface charge on battery. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter.

### System Overview

Fuel System Components Diagram

![](images/3c6935e393f7464ad9bfec1eb0dc16efccdbeb63f1f47b9ff9ea42a993236194.webp)

![](images/a9312b6687fb1319571b197508c1b5c24294eb564b2cc20efaba191dfd69e172.webp)

Charging system is consist of battery, alternator, adjuster and charging state indicator device. Alternator is the main power supply component while vehicle is operating. It is used to supply power to all the electric equipment (except for the starting system) and charge the battery. Since alternator is rotated through drive belt which is driven by the engine, voltage will changes depending on engine speed. To meet electric device power supply and battery charging requirements, charging system is equipped with voltage regulator. The voltage regulator maintains voltage output stability of alternator by adjusting exciting current in alternator while engine speed and load is changing. Charging state indicator is used to show the charging system operation and indicate whether the battery is in a charging or discharging state.

System Schematic Diagram Charging System Schematic Diagram

![](images/01d40cb6029702911065f22d57211e3741b20d55cfa297408fc6b2020a4d4486.webp)

Three-phase alternating current generated by alternator is converted to direct current from alternating current by rectifier, and direct current is transmitted to the vehicle electrical system and battery.

### Main Function

Provide starting current large enough to starter when starter is to be started; When alternator is overloaded, it can help alternator to supply power to electric device; When starter is not started, temporarily supply power to electric device; Moreover, battery is a large capacity capacitor which protects vehicle electrical device.

### Battery Operation/ Warning Description and Safety Specification

1. Following the related specifications on appliances connected with battery, in repair manual and owner's manual.   
2. Battery acid is highly corrosive, so it is necessary to wear protective gloves and goggles when working.   
3. Keep away from open fire, spark, light devices without protective measures and no smoking. Never generate any sparks when operating cable/wire and electrical devices. Avoid short circuit in battery.   
4. Wear eye protective mask/glasses.   
5. Never allow the children approaching acid and battery.   
6. Deliver the used battery to designated recycling site. Never throw the used battery into household garbage.

### Inspection

Battery Specification 12V 60AH

Check the charging system charging voltage

Leave vehicle under no load test condition and idle the engine. Measure battery voltage with a digital multimeter. Standard Voltage: 13.5V - 14.8V.   
Hint:   
If result . not as specified, replace the alternator.

Standard voltage: 13.2V - 14.8 V

### Usage of Battery Tester

1. Connect the battery tester to battery.

### Hint:

2. Operate tester to select "Battery Test" and click "Enter".

![](images/544156b57a0d4ede92d1dcac1e573f8dbc86e18028024988806ced5615867790.webp)

3. Select "CCA" and click "Enter".

4. Operate "L and R buttons" on tester to adjust and set the battery rated CCA (such as 560CCA, this value indicates the battery low temperature starting performance) and click "Enter".

![](images/765490f400875964c52ca8886db5251aa2d132731aa362daba291df85aa9406b.webp)

5. The battery condition is displayed on tester. Hint: Recharge or replace battery according to the tested data.

### Battery Fluid Leakage Test

1. PH paper is used for judgment. Hint: Paper Model: PH 1 - 14.   
2. Take a piece of PH paper (never allow it contacting with other fluid before test) to wipe the leaking area, so as to make the fluid adhere on the PH paper. Then compare it with the color bar to judge the PH value.   
3. If the PH value is less than 7, it is an acidic liquid, which indicates battery leakage. If the PH value is 7 or higher, it is non-acidic liquid (neutral or alkaline) which indicates "Petroleum jelly" fluid or other fluids leakage on battery surface.

![](images/6618bde70e1a8953b1d49df9d18ec809db3d575e7dda285d10a36050ccf2706a.webp)

### Battery On-vehicle External Power Supply Charging

If battery external power supply charging is necessary, external charging device positive terminal clamp has to clamp battery positive terminal, and external charging negative terminal clamp has to be grounded instead of battery negative terminal.

### Alternator Inspection

When alternator is operating, place tool to the area near alternator, if obvious magnetic force can be felt, it indicates alternator operates normally, otherwise, repair it.

### Operation

This transmission has six forward gears and one reverse gear, which is achieved by three sets of synchronizers and two shafts (input shaft and output shaft). All forward gears use conventional engagement, and reverse gear uses a sliding idler gear device. Corresponding gear will engage with gear hub separately when transmission is shifted to each different gear position, thus realizing the power transmission. Drive gear of final drive, which is on the output shaft, drives the driven gear of final drive and the differential assembly to rotate, thus propeller shaft is driven to rotate wheels. All forward gears use an inertial synchronizer gearshift mechanism, thus providing smooth and easy gear shifting and longevity. Shift fork adopts alloy steel material and resinous material to achieve high wear resistance. Gearshift mechanism of transmission makes gearshift flexible, accurate and clear by equipped locating steel ball and spring. In addition, pre-synchronizing mechanism is used for reverse gear, enhancing the ride comfort and reliability.

### Proper Use and Maintenance for Transmission Correct Operation for Transmission

1. Gently shift the shift lever and never apply excessive force.   
2. Never start off at high speed.   
3. Do not always put hand on shift lever during driving, to prevent premature wear of shift fork.

### Assembly Standards and Precautions for Transmission

1. Wash all parts (except for rubber part, gasket, oil seal and bearing) before assembly.

2. Various oil seals, shaft retainers and elastic pins cannot be reused.   
3. Apply lubricant to each friction surface and apply grease to each oil seal lip.   
4. Never transmit pressure through rolling body when assembling each bearing.   
5. Never tilt the lip oil seal during assembly.   
6. Openings of spring expander on both sides should be staggered when assembling synchronizer set.   
7. There should be no lubricant leakage at each area when transmission is in normal operating position.

### Transmission Oil Replacement

Transmission Oil Draining Warning/Caution/Hint

Replace transmission oil only when engine stops and transmission cools down. Replace drain/limit bolt washers with new ones before installation.   
1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ENGINE START STOP switch.   
2. Raise vehicle to a proper height.   
3. Place a recovering container under transmission drain hole.   
4. Use a tool to remove transmission limit bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer.

![](images/492789356d12e2952cdb92a08eb8d70e35fbf17575579ea35c458edece5b3eb5.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Limit bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.
>
> 5. Use a tool to remove transmission drain bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer. Replace drain bolt washer and tighten drain bolt after draining transmission oil.
>
> ![](images/0b9868d071d665eef9d94b181c95c1687d3cffda2ff24352c67f4227e19906aa.webp)
>
> Tightening torque 39 ± 11 N•m

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Drained transmission oil should be collected with a recovering container.   
> Only use transmission oil approved by Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.   
> Drain bolt and bolt washer are non-reusable components, and replace them after removal.

### Transmission Oil Filling

1. Make sure that drain bolt is tightened in place.   
2. Use a socket wrench to remove transmission filler bolt (arrow), and remove bolt washer.

### Removal

1. Remove the shift knob.

(a) Rotate shift lever ball counterclockwise until shift knob is removed.

2. Remove the shift knob boot assembly.

(a) Using an interior crow plate, separate shift knob boot assembly and auxiliary fascia console. (b) Move shift knob boot upward until it separates from shift mechanism R gear slider, then remove shift knob boot assembly.

### Installation

Install boot assembly onto conical surface of lifting lever of shift mechanism, then clamp boot onto auxiliary fascia console vertically.

2. Rotate shift lever ball clockwise along shift lever, make word on ball face straight ahead when a larg rotating force is felt obviously, then stop rotating.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Boot assembly and auxiliary fascia console are engaged in place.   
> Make word on shift lever ball face straight ahead.   
> After assembling shift lever ball, be sure to raise the lifting lever to the maximum stroke and release it, observe if lifting lever is stuck by internal circle of ball, then repeat the operations 5 times, if lifting lever moves smoothly in this process, it is qualified.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Installation is in the reverse order of removal.   
> 1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.   
> 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.   
> 3. Remove the battery.   
> 4. Remove the air filter assembly.   
> 5. Remove the battery tray.   
> 6. Remove the engine lower protector.   
> 7. Remove front left and right tires.   
> 8. Drain transmission fluid.   
> 9. Remove ground wire above transmission case.   
> 10. Disconnect connection between select and shift cable and transmission.
>
> (a) Remove fixing lock pin and disconnect connection (arrow) between shift cable and transmission shift swing arm; remove fixing lock pin and disconnect connection (arrow) between select cable and transmission select swing arm, then disengage select and shift cable dampers (1) from flexible shaft bracket limit hole.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Make white marks on both joints face downward (toward transmission) during installation. (b) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) between select and shift cable fixing bracket and transmission case.
>
> ![](images/ac1ebbebfc037ef271f43734db3099aaa958f180fa91263ef6537b2d7d176ff3.webp)
>
> ![](images/a44fc5ee051167b9ce8083dbcf3da53ed1a8ed4a34215e4e82d83a5e87ff0cf5.webp)
>
> 11. Disconnect the reverse switch connector (arrow).
>
> ![](images/18355e78dc88afb24278e7c81bbdc5d9c241dfa3cd89b2da3db7302c78e27dd7.webp)
>
> 12. Remove the turbocharger intake pipe.   
> 13. Remove the vacuum pump.

### 26-30

14. Remove the starter.

15. Remove the crankshaft position sensor.

(a) Disconnect the crankshaft position sensor connector. (b) Remove fixing bolt (arrow) and crankshaft position sensor.

![](images/a3172f614a55f96b929e7ccbc0b2a642fb770c8c1d72c87df17c0005f6871d0f.webp)

16. Using a tool, pry off clip (arrow) from clutch release bearing joint to separate clutch pipe and transmission.

![](images/b9ea0b9098d1153ba8130bb1d140bda5c4f1c1746ef39a38c0253ed606a8e2a4.webp)

17. Remove the drive shaft.   
18. Remove the left side rail welding assembly.   
19. Remove the rear mounting.   
20. Use an engine equalizer to hang the engine.   
21. Remove the left mounting.   
22. Remove the transmission.

(a) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) from upper part of transmission. Tightening torque 50 ± 5 N•m

![](images/9d5cb1d56d698a0187be01b9174b42c797f6ab3787b821fbef1c255c32ec82c0.webp)

(b) Raise vehicle and use a transmission carrier to support transmission assembly.

(c) Remove 3 coupling bolts (arrow) from lower part of transmission, and remove sealing plate. Tightening torque 60 ± 5 N•m

(d) Remove coupling bolts (arrow) between engine and transmission from both sides.

![](images/27cb5d47ec29f24cbe82bb2c49ec4f14dab448b0db9bea872740d0f8b3707e2f.webp)

Tightening torque 60 ± 5 N•m

(e) Pull transmission to separate it from engine.

### Reverse Idler Gear Set Inspection

Using a feeler gauge, check reverse idler gear set. Standard inner diameter 25.056 \~ 25.074 mm Maximum inner diameter 25.074 mm If inner diameter is more than maximum value, replace reverse idler gear set. 2. Using a micrometer, check reverse idler gear shaft.

![](images/bfccb5fa018a1e7d88a48524b5626cc4dbcfb8efb993d3bea6d773b91f3bf953.webp)

Minimum outer diameter 24.984 mm   
If outer diameter is less than minimum value, replace reverse idler gear shaft.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Before assembling components, wash them clean.   
> Remove seal gum residues from cases.   
> Make sure that joint surface of cases is clean and free of oil, then uniformly apply seal gum.   
> Make sure joint surface of case and shift assembly is clean and free of oil, then uniformly apply seal gum.   
> Tighten bolts to specified torque.
>
> 1. Install the differential right bearing inner race.
>
> (a) Using special tool and press, install new differential right bearing inner race to differential sub-assembly.
>
> ![](images/52f86a244f39887d9f6385fbe54194d51e335caf79bc5d4e2ff863d89837ccc8.webp)
>
> (b) Using special tool and press, install oil seal deflector together with differential right bearing outer race to clutch case.
>
> ![](images/2b48b1afa19d7a95c0807572756012c2dd45d8e75fc51c49046318a2a0081b1f.webp)
>
> 2. Install the differential left bearing inner race.
>
> (a) Using special tool and press, install new differential left bearing inner race to differential sub-assembly.
>
> ![](images/d80ff593e7e1c65d850d3239e629d53f50f3d3d7260a4de0abd646cea610f319.webp)
>
> (b) Using special tool and press, install adjusting shim together with differential left bearing outer race to clutch case.
>
> ![](images/8f1908f1c718b3d3970fdae353cd3093cf12632cce08fe7870294fbc12ff455b.webp)
>
> 3. Adjust the differential bearing preload.
>
> (a) Apply gear oil to differential sub-assembly (arrow) and install it to clutch case.
>
> (b) Install transmission case with 16 bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 29.4 ± 5.9 N•m
>
> ![](images/4745b7300c6bad19d4e819a97ea625d894c94a296c9204118678e445b186796c.webp)
>
> (c) Using special tool and torque wrench, rotate differential sub-assembly clockwise and counterclockwise 2 or 3 times to seat the bearing.
>
> (d) Using special tool and torque wrench, measure preload. Preload for new bearing 0.98 \~ 1.69 N•m Preload for used bearing 0.795 \~ 1.372 N•m
>
> If preload is not as specified, replace adjusting shim with one of different thickness which can make preload within specified range.
>
> ![](images/45d11e55fc69c5989ca29819c4537b634b69cc0b4d22e8d96182f640b6dd51e8.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Select thicker adjusting shim to increase preload, or select thinner adjusting shim to decrease preload. Make a record, as torque value is needed when adjusting output shaft bearing preload.
>
> (e) Remove 16 coupling bolts from transmission and separate transmission case.
>
> (f) Remove differential sub-assembly from clutch case.
>
> 4. Install the output shaft front bearing outer race.
>
> (a) Install output shaft oil guide nozzle (arrow) to clutch case.

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Align output shaft oil guide nozzle boss (a) with groove on clutch case.
>
> (b) Using special tool and press, install new output shaft front bearing outer race to clutch case.
>
> ![](images/e0489a14ae9fd6d72f758799703553f5c99bcf95260d359c671c23f884f84798.webp)
>
> 5. Install the output shaft rear bearing outer race.
>
> (a) Using special tool and press, install adjusting shim and new output shaft rear bearing outer race to transmission case.
>
> ![](images/932ee030dc75be599400957572e18768584866ba141dc6cc27d4ddf60f135ac5.webp)
>
> 6. Adjust the output shaft bearing preload.
>
> (a) Apply gear oil to differentia case (arrow) and install it to clutch case.
>
> (b) Apply gear oil to output shaft sub-assembly (arrow) and install it to clutch case.
>
> ![](images/36bb6ae4d49071510f90c0d0f17f0978c8f1c4a1e50c9cd57d5c52ac7cfa4962.webp)
>
> (c) Install transmission case with 16 bolts (arrow). Tightening torque 29.4 ± 5.9 N•m
>
> ![](images/5cd69164bea12f6fab83bd66deac48d0045aa73fe4b8af5310a64282bad9f152.webp)
>
> (d) Using special tool and torque wrench, rotate differential sub-assembly clockwise and counterclockwise 2 or 3 times to seat the bearing.
>
> (e) Using special tool and torque wrench, measure preload. Preload for new bearing 0.98 \~ 1.69 N•m Preload for used bearing 0.795 \~ 1.372 N•m If preload is not as specified, replace adjusting shim with one of different thickness which can make preload within specified range.
>
> ![](images/5679cf0589622f9a33bb7c972766c8f78fa2719bff5e79825a45f018df67b28a.webp)
>
> ![](images/c86b169dc84f47c41dfa9f82b28fcb88ce20498db27245d3e07873d9e360dc47.webp)

> ⚠️ **Внимание:** 
> Select thicker adjusting shim to increase preload, or select thinner adjusting shim to decrease preload.
>
> 7. Install the outer shift lever oil seal.
>
> (a) Using special tool and hammer, install new outer shift lever oil seal to transmission case. Standard depth 0.5\~1.0 mm   
> (b) Apply MP grease to outer shift lever oil seal lip.
>
> ![](images/8bbd38d9906bd4503ce7973e898a526f65b6d08524fb705b86f883d0b1d2e91f.webp)
>

>
